meta.title: How TDOT works
meta.note: Draft v1 — built from the app itself, to be checked by the team

lanes.name: Client
lanes.desc: What the client receives and does

stages.name: A lead comes in
stages.desc: Email, website form, phone or walk-in

stages.name: Booking
stages.desc: Invite, reminders, the client books a time

stages.name: Consultation paid
stages.desc: Paid online, recorded, or waived; package and agreement

stages.name: Case opens
stages.desc: Case number, folders, checklist, family, portal

stages.name: Documents & questionnaire
stages.desc: Client uploads and answers; staff review

pages.name: Sign-in page
pages.what: Type the shared team key to open the staff pages.

pages.name: Leads
pages.what: New leads waiting for a consultation booking ("Awaiting booking"), newest first; "＋ Add lead" for callers and walk-ins.

pages.name: Lead page
pages.what: One lead: Basic details, Their inquiry, Residential address, Owner & where the client is, Attachments, Lead status, Booking invite email, Outcome & remarks, Quick actions, AI triage notes, 💬 Updates.

pages.name: Consultations
pages.what: Booked consultations, clients after the consultation, and the monthly figures. "Leads" here is a link to the Leads page.

pages.name: Consultation record
pages.what: One client from booking to retainer: Intake context, Eligibility profile, AI triage notes, 💬 Updates, Consultation (Record outcome, Remarks, Communications & agreement), Attribution & follow-up, Consultation fee, Case status, Retainer plan.

pages.name: Cases
pages.what: Every case on the Cases board in one searchable table ("📋 All Cases").

pages.name: Summary
pages.what: The Needs attention list, headline numbers, Action Required, charts, team workload and Cases Requiring Attention.

pages.name: Case page
pages.what: Everything about one open case (the "case cockpit").

pages.name: Document review page
pages.what: Review each uploaded document: accept, request rework, mark Not Applicable, open in OneDrive. The buttons along the top filter the list. Needs "Sign in with Monday" (the team key alone does not open it).

pages.name: Questionnaire review page
pages.what: Read the client's questionnaire answers, flag answers for correction and send the correction request.

pages.name: Client portal — staff view ("Case Review")
pages.what: What the client sees, with staff extras: 📌 Case status, 🕓 Your case journey, 📝 Questionnaire, 📂 Documents, 💳 Payments, ✉️ Client access ("Resend portal access email →").

pages.name: Engine Controls
pages.what: Run the overnight case checks by hand, test the Monday connection, resend one "case is ready" email, and a Document Code Generator that writes missing codes onto the Template board. Not in the top bar.

pages.name: Booking page (client)
pages.what: Client page: the client picks a consultation time and pays.

pages.name: Pre-consultation form (client)
pages.what: Client page: the form the client fills in before the consultation.

pages.name: Website intake form (client)
pages.what: Client page: the public inquiry form that creates a lead.

pages.name: Consultation request form (client)
pages.what: Client page: a separate public form saved to its own Monday board (not the Leads page).

pages.name: Questionnaire (client)
pages.what: Client page: the client's questionnaire, opened from their portal link.

pages.name: Document upload (client)
pages.what: Client page: upload documents to the checklist.

pages.name: Staff guide (How TDOT works)
pages.what: This guide, inside the app: the 📘 Guide button in the header. Signed-in staff only.

steps.access: All staff. Every lead is shown to everyone on this page (no per-person filtering).
before: You are signed in to the staff pages.

options.label: Lead (column)
options.does: Client name. A red URGENT tag shows when the client reported a removal order, a CBSA/IRCC letter, or gave a deadline date. An amber tag shows what the client asked for when it is not 'Book consultation' (e.g. 'Request quote', 'Existing file update').

options.label: Service
options.does: Confirmed case type, else the service they asked for, else the case type interest.

options.label: Source
options.does: How they reached us (Website, Phone, Email, WhatsApp, Instagram, Other). The lead owner's name is shown under it.

options.label: Received
options.does: The Toronto day the lead arrived.

options.label: Tier
options.does: T0–T3 from the priority rules (blank for staff-added and email leads).

options.label: Priority
options.does: Critical (red) / High (amber) / Medium / Low / Existing Client.

options.label: Booking
options.does: Not Yet / Slot Held (blue) / Abandoned (grey).

options.label: Invite
options.does: 'Sent YYYY-MM-DD' (green) once the booking invite went out, else '—'.

options.label: Current status
options.does: Where the lead is with us (not their immigration status). See 'Read a lead's Current status'. Hover a remark to read its full text.

options.label: 🗑 (bin icon at the end of a row)
options.does: Opens the careful-delete window for that lead (see 'Delete a lead').

options.label: (click a row)
options.does: Opens that lead's page.

options.label: Search by name…
options.does: Shows only leads whose name contains the text.

next: The list is a copy of the Lead Board refreshed every 3 minutes, so a brand-new lead or a change can take a few minutes to show.
watch_out: A lead leaves this list in three cases: it is booked (it moves to Consultations); a retainer is under way or the Outcome is Retain (it moves to Retainers & follow-ups); or the client is retained (it moves to Cases). Leads whose Outcome is Follow-Up, Newsletter or Not Wanted stay on this list.

The page says 'Once a consultation is booked, the lead moves to Consultations'. But if someone booked a time by hand and did not set Booking to 'Booked', the lead stays here, with its Current status reading 'Booked'.
Empty list: 'No leads awaiting booking — new intake submissions land here.' With filters on: 'No leads match your filters.'
Requests sent through the separate public consultation form are NOT on this list (see 'Client fills in the public consultation request form').

A website lead with Priority 'Existing Client' (and no tier) is a current client with an open file, not a sales lead. The app does not pass it to their case team (only a reported removal order or enforcement letter raises the urgent-lead alert). Do not send a booking invite. See 'Pass on a request from an existing client'.
steps.title: Look at the Leads list
steps.summary: The Leads list shows every lead that has not booked a consultation yet, newest first. New website forms, phone-ins, walk-ins and email leads all appear here.
steps.where: Top bar 📥 Leads → Leads page (/admin/leads) → section 'Awaiting booking (N)'

steps.access: All staff

options.label: Lead → 'A → Z' / 'Z → A'
options.does: Sorts by name.

options.label: Lead → 'Urgent only'
options.does: Shows only URGENT leads.

options.label: Service (tick boxes)
options.does: Filter by service; 'Not set' = none.

options.label: Source → 'How they reached us' and 'Owner' tick boxes
options.does: Filter by source ('No source') and by lead owner ('No owner').

options.label: Received → 'Newest first' / 'Oldest first'
options.does: Default sort is Newest first.

options.label: Received → 'Today' / 'Last 7 days' / 'Last 30 days' / 'This month' / 'Last month'
options.does: Quick date ranges, Toronto days.

options.label: Received → 'From' / 'To' (date boxes)
options.does: Custom range; both days included, Toronto time.

options.label: Tier → 'A → Z' / 'Z → A' + tick boxes
options.does: Sort and filter by tier ('No tier').

options.label: Priority → 'Most urgent first' / 'Least urgent first' + tick boxes
options.does: Order Critical, High, Medium, Low ('No priority').

options.label: Booking (Not Yet / Slot Held / Abandoned)
options.does: Filter by booking state.

options.label: Invite (Sent / Not sent)
options.does: Filter by invite state.

options.label: Current status → 'Latest first' / 'Oldest first' + tick boxes
options.does: Choices: New, Invite sending, Invite failed, Invite sent, 1st reminder sent, 2nd reminder sent, a remark, Booking not finished, Booking in progress, Paid / fee recorded, Booked, Expired, and each Outcome value ('No status').

options.label: Find…
options.does: Appears inside a panel when it has more than 8 choices; narrows the choices.

options.label: Clear (in panel)
options.does: Clears that column's filters.

options.label: Done / ×
options.does: Closes the panel (Esc also closes it).

options.label: Chip × / 'Clear all'
options.does: Removes one filter / all filters (sorting is kept).

next: The count next to 'Awaiting booking' shows '(shown of total)'. Filters are remembered while the browser tab stays open (opening a lead and coming back keeps them).
watch_out: The number next to each choice counts leads with the OTHER filters applied.
Filters reset when the browser tab is closed.

Header signs: the sorted column shows ▲ or ▼ next to its name; a column with a filter on shows the filter (funnel) button in blue with the number of filters; a choice that would show no leads is greyed with 0; a panel with no choices says 'Nothing to choose from.'; the Lead panel reminds you 'Search by name in the box above the table.' With a filter, date range or search on, the heading reads 'Awaiting booking (12 of 48)' — shown out of total.
steps.title: Filter and sort the Leads list from the column headers
steps.summary: Each column header has a small funnel button that opens a filter panel for that column, with counts. Active filters show as chips above the table.
steps.where: Leads page (/admin/leads) → any column header → funnel button

steps.access: All staff

options.label: Outcome: <outcome> (Retain / Follow-Up / Newsletter / Not Wanted)
options.does: An Outcome always wins over everything else.

options.label: Booked
options.does: Booking is 'Booked', or the lead shows signs of a booking made by hand (a time in Booked Slot, consultation held, a meeting link, a Square appointment, consultation agreement sent, or pre-consultation form submitted).

options.label: Paid — no time booked yet / Fee recorded — no time booked yet / Fee waived — no time booked yet
options.does: Paid online, or staff recorded / waived the fee, but no time is booked.

options.label: Booking in progress
options.does: The client is holding a time while paying.

options.label: Invite sent / 1st reminder sent / 2nd reminder sent / Booking not finished / Expired (or the latest remark's label)
options.does: Whichever of these happened LAST is shown. 'Booking not finished' = a held time ran out unpaid. 'Expired' = invited 7 days ago and still not booked (both reminders are over).

options.label: Invite failed / Invite sending
options.does: The invite email failed / is being sent.

options.label: New
options.does: Nothing has happened yet.

next: The app reads the Lead Board's updates every 10 minutes (45 days back) to build this; the app's own invite, reminder and remark notes show at once.
watch_out: Right after the app restarts, the column shows only what the lead's columns say until the updates are read (about 30 seconds).
'Expired' is a display only — no email is sent and nothing changes on the board. Decide the lead's Outcome yourself.
steps.title: Read a lead's Current status
steps.summary: One line per lead telling the latest thing that happened with us: invite, reminders, a remark, a booking in progress, paid, booked, expired, or the Outcome.
steps.where: Leads page (/admin/leads) → column 'Current status' (the date or booked time shows under the label; a remark also shows who posted it)

steps.access: All staff
before: At least the caller's full name.

options.label: Full name *
options.does: Required (up to 120 characters).

options.label: Email
options.does: Optional; must look like an email. Without it no booking invite can be sent.

options.label: Phone
options.does: Optional; at least 7 digits if typed.

options.label: Residential address
options.does: Optional; prints on the consultation agreement and the retainer.

options.label: In Canada now? Yes / No
options.does: Decides the HST on the consultation fee (no HST for clients outside Canada). Left blank = HST is charged until it is set on the lead page.

options.label: Which country? *
options.does: Shown only when 'No' is picked; required then.

options.label: Added by
options.does: Staff name list; becomes the lead owner. Hidden when you are signed in with Monday — then it reads 'Added by <your name> (signed in with Monday) — you become the lead owner.'

options.label: How they reached us
options.does: Phone / WhatsApp / Email / Instagram / Other.

options.label: Case type interest
options.does: '— not sure yet —' or a case type from the list.

options.label: Note
options.does: What they told you on the call; saved as the lead's inquiry text.

options.label: Cancel
options.does: Closes the window (Esc or clicking outside also closes it).

options.label: Create lead
options.does: Checks for duplicates and the Not Wanted list, then creates the lead and opens its page.

next: A lead row is created on the Lead Board with Conversion status 'New', a personal booking-link code and a OneDrive lead folder.
An update is posted on the lead: who added it, the source, the case type, the HST answer, and what is still missing (email / phone / address / In Canada).
No email goes to the client yet. Next: send the booking invite from the lead page.
watch_out: Messages you can see: 'Enter the full name — it is the only required field.' · 'That email doesn’t look right — fix it or leave it empty.' · 'That phone number is too short — fix it or leave it empty.' · 'Choose the country the client is in now (or leave "In Canada now?" unanswered).' · 'Choose your name in "Added by" from the list (or leave it empty).'
If the connection drops you see that the lead may or may not have been created — check the Leads list before trying again, so you do not make a duplicate.
'In Canada now?' and 'Added by' are asked fresh every time the window opens, so a shared front-desk computer never credits the last person.

Other refusals shown in red under the Note box: 'Full name is required.' and '"<type>" is not a canonical case type — pick one from the list.' While the lead is being created the button reads 'Creating…'.
steps.title: Add a lead for a phone-in or walk-in caller
steps.summary: Type a caller's basics to create a normal lead. Only the full name is required; you then send the booking invite from the lead's page. No case is opened.
steps.where: Leads page (/admin/leads) → '＋ Add lead' → window 'Add a lead' → 'Create lead'

steps.access: All staff
before: You clicked 'Create lead' and the email or phone matched something.

options.label: Existing lead: <name> (link)
options.does: Opens that lead in a new tab.

options.label: Open case: <case number> (link)
options.does: Opens that case in a new tab.

options.label: Client account: <name>
options.does: Shows a matching client account (no link).

options.label: On the Not Wanted list (red block)
options.does: Shows the listed person, the reason, who added it and whether the email or phone matched. A warning only.

options.label: Create lead (click again)
options.does: Creates the lead anyway. If the person is on the Not Wanted list, the new lead gets the update 'Staff saw the warning and added this lead anyway.'

next: Changing the email or phone after the warning cancels the 'create anyway' — the next click checks again.
watch_out: Nothing is blocked by the Not Wanted list and the client is never told.
If the Not Wanted list could not be read, a softer box says 'The Not Wanted list could not be checked' — nothing is blocked.
steps.title: Handle the 'already in the system' or Not Wanted warning when adding a lead
steps.summary: The first 'Create lead' click stops and shows a warning instead of creating the lead when the email or phone already belongs to a lead, an open case or a client account, or when the person is on the Not Wanted list.
steps.where: Leads page → '＋ Add lead' → orange box under 'Note'

steps.access: All staff

options.label: All leads
options.does: Back to the Leads list.

options.label: ✉ (Email client)
options.does: Opens your own email program addressed to the client (only when an email is on file).

options.label: Received · Booking · Tier · Priority · Asked for · <consultant name> · URGENT (tags under the name)
options.does: Received = date and time the lead arrived (Toronto). Booking = Not Yet / Slot Held / Booked / Abandoned. 'Asked for' shows a request that is not a booking. URGENT = removal order, CBSA/IRCC letter, or urgent deadline.

options.label: Red banner '… — review urgently'
options.does: Lists the urgent points: 'Removal / enforcement order', 'CBSA / IRCC letter received', 'Urgent deadline'.

options.label: Red 'On the Not Wanted list' banner
options.does: Shown when the email or phone matches the Not Wanted list. A warning only. Named admins also see 'Remove from the list…'.

options.label: Quick actions → 'Open consultation view' (or 'Open retainer view')
options.does: Replaces the booking-invite card once the lead is Booked (or for a direct-retainer client). Opens the consultation record. Direct-retainer clients who never booked see 'Open retainer view'.

watch_out: 'Failed to load: Lead not found.' means the lead number is wrong or the lead was deleted.
steps.title: Open a lead's page and read the header
steps.summary: The lead page shows everything about one lead: header tags, warnings, editable details, the intake answers, the booking invite, outcome and remarks, and the Monday updates.
steps.where: Leads page → click a row → lead page (/admin/lead/<lead number>)

steps.access: All staff

options.label: (intake section cards)
options.does: Basic information, Family members, Current immigration status, Relationship with TDOT, Service required, service-specific answers and more. Staff-added and email leads show 'Intake archive unavailable — showing lead-board data only…'.

options.label: Attachments (OneDrive · Intake)
options.does: Names of letters the client uploaded on the form (enforcement, refusal and reference letters).

options.label: Lead status
options.does: Booking status · Booked slot · Booking invite (Sent · date / Not sent yet) · Booking reminders · Pre-consult (Submitted / Pending) · Outcome · Consultant · How they reached us · Original channel · Lead owner · Case type interest · Intake archive ('Submitted <date>' / 'None — came in by email' / 'None — added by staff' / 'Not found') · Consents · Email · Phone.

options.label: AI triage notes
options.does: Talking points, Priority reasons, Compliance flags — or 'No AI triage notes yet.'

watch_out: The AI is a second opinion only; Priority and Tier come from fixed rules.

'No inquiry text provided.' shows in 'Their inquiry' when the lead has no inquiry text (press Edit to add one). 'The intake archive is empty.' shows instead of the intake cards when the archive exists but holds nothing.
steps.setting_note: AI triage notes appear only when the AI service is set up for the app.
steps.title: Read the intake answers, Lead status and AI triage notes
steps.summary: The lead page shows the client's full intake form answers in sections, any letters they uploaded, a Lead status summary and the AI's second opinion.
steps.where: Lead page → intake section cards; 'Attachments (OneDrive · Intake)'; right column 'Lead status'; 'AI triage notes'

steps.access: All staff

options.label: Full name
options.does: Renames the lead row too.

options.label: Email
options.does: Can be emptied (then no invite or reminders can go out).

options.label: Phone
options.does: 7 to 15 digits.

options.label: How they reached us
options.does: Website / Phone / Email / WhatsApp / Instagram / Other.

options.label: Case type interest
options.does: '— not sure yet —' or a case type from the list.

options.label: Save details
options.does: Saves only what changed; 'No change.' if nothing did.

next: Update on the lead: 'Basic details changed by <name>: … (was …)'.
The unsigned consultation-agreement review copy is rebuilt with the new name and email.

Warnings you may see after saving: no email means no invite and no reminders; an email changed after an invite means you should send the invite again; an agreement already sent keeps the old details; the new email or phone is also on another lead or case; the person is on the Not Wanted list.
watch_out: When the lead already has a case, name, email and phone are greyed out: 'This lead has a case — change the name, email or phone on the case page…'
A direct-retainer client keeps the source 'Direct Retainer' (the source box is locked).

Refusals: 'Enter the client’s full name.' · 'That email doesn’t look right — fix it or leave it empty (the booking invite needs one).' · 'Enter a valid phone number (7 to 15 digits).' · 'Choose how they reached us from the list.' · '"<type>" is not a case type from the list.'
Reminders only go to an address an invite went to — after changing the email, send the invite again.
After 'Save details' the card shows 'Saved: name, email…' (the boxes that changed) or 'No change.'. The same words, with any warnings, are posted as a note on the lead.
steps.title: Correct a lead's name, email, phone, source or case type interest
steps.summary: The Basic details card lets you fix the lead's core details. Each change is recorded in an update with the old value.
steps.where: Lead page → card 'Basic details' → 'Save details'

steps.access: All staff

options.label: Edit
options.does: Opens a text box with the current text.

options.label: Save inquiry
options.does: Saves (up to 5000 characters) and posts 'Inquiry edited by <name>. It was: …'.

options.label: Cancel
options.does: Closes without saving.

next: An update is posted on the lead with the previous text.
watch_out: 'The inquiry is too long (max 5000 characters).'
steps.title: Edit the client's inquiry text
steps.summary: The 'Their inquiry' card shows what the client asked about; you can rewrite it. The old text is kept in an update.
steps.where: Lead page → card 'Their inquiry' → 'Edit' → 'Save inquiry' / 'Cancel'

steps.access: All staff

options.label: Address box
options.does: Street, city, province/state, postal code, country; up to 4 lines (5 to 500 characters).

options.label: Save address
options.does: Saves on the lead and posts 'Residential address added/corrected by …' with the old address.

next: The unsigned consultation-agreement review copy is rebuilt.

If a consultation package was waiting for the address, it is emailed now ('…the consultation package has been emailed to the client.'). Otherwise the message says why not: automatic sending is off, the consultation date has passed, it no longer applies, or it failed.
steps.client_sees: Only if a held package is released: the consultation package email.
watch_out: 'Enter the client’s full residential address (street, city, province/state, postal code, country).'
A retainer already sent and any signed copy keep the old address.

If a note says 'ℹ️ Consultation package not sent — it was waiting for the residential address, but …', the package was dropped, not sent. The note gives one of these reasons: the fee record no longer asks for it; an outcome was set; the client has a case, or a retainer is under way; it is a direct retainer client; the consultation is no longer booked with a time; the person is on the Not Wanted list; the booking or its video meeting could not be saved; or the video consultation has no join link. Follow the next step in the note (for example 'Save the fee record again so the meeting is made for this time, or put the right link in "Meeting Link" before "Review & send"'). Don't press 'Review & send' unless the meeting details are right.
steps.title: Add or correct the client's residential address
steps.summary: The address prints on the consultation agreement and the retainer. Saving it also releases a consultation package that was held because the address was blank.
steps.where: Lead page → card 'Residential address (prints on the consultation agreement and retainer)' → 'Save address'; or Consultation record → card 'Consultation' → 'Communications & agreement' → 'Client residential address (prints on the agreement and retainer)' → 'Save address'

steps.access: All staff

options.label: Lead owner (staff list, or '—')
options.does: '—' clears the owner.

options.label: Save owner
options.does: Saves and posts 'Lead owner set to X (was Y) by Z.'

next: The owner shows under Source on the Leads list and can be filtered there. The same owner can also be set in 'Attribution & follow-up' on the consultation record.
Under 'Save owner' you see 'Lead owner: <name>.', 'Lead owner cleared.' or 'No change.' (the same owner was already set).
watch_out: 'Choose an owner from the list.'
steps.title: Set or change the lead owner
steps.summary: The lead owner is the person who follows up on the lead; anyone can hand it on.
steps.where: Lead page → card 'Owner & where the client is' → 'Lead owner (follows up on this lead)' → 'Save owner'

steps.access: All staff
before: Set it BEFORE sending the booking invite — the invite email and the booking page quote the price.

options.label: Yes
options.does: Country = Canada; HST applies.

options.label: No + country
options.does: No HST on the consultation fee.

options.label: Save location
options.does: Saves and posts an update: where the client is, who set it, and the HST effect.

next: The saved message tells you what else to do. An amount already paid does not change (refund in Square). A payment page or invoice at the OLD price may still be open — cancel it in Square. If the invite already went out, use 'Send booking invite' to send it again with the new price.
steps.client_sees: The fee shown in the invite email and on the booking page (with or without HST).
watch_out: 'Answer "In Canada now?" first.' · 'Choose the country.'
Leads created from emails get an update reminding you to set 'In Canada now?' before inviting.
steps.title: Set where the client is now (decides HST on the consultation fee)
steps.summary: 'In Canada now?' decides whether 13% HST is added to the consultation fee. Clients outside Canada pay no HST. If it is never set, HST is charged.
steps.where: Lead page → card 'Owner & where the client is' → 'In Canada now? (sets the HST on the consultation fee)' Yes / No (+ country) → 'Save location'

steps.access: All staff
before: No case, no held time and no booked time on this lead (the button is hidden otherwise).

options.label: → Convert to direct retainer
options.does: Opens the Consultations page with the direct-retainer window filled in from this lead.

next: Continues in the retainer stage (direct retainer set-up).
watch_out: The app will not convert a lead that: is booked or holding a time; has been sent a retainer; has a retainer plan started (a fee, template or milestones entered); already has a case; or is retained. Creating the client opens their case at once.
steps.title: Convert a returning client's lead to a direct retainer
steps.summary: A returning or existing client who does not need a consultation can skip it. This reuses the same lead (no duplicate) and opens the direct-retainer window on the Consultations page, filled in.
steps.where: Lead page → card 'Booking invite email' → '→ Convert to direct retainer'

steps.access: All staff
before: Type your name in the 'Your name' box once (remembered in this browser and shared with the Updates box). The line above the buttons says 'Posting as <name>.' or 'Add your name below first.'

options.label: Notes sent to client
options.does: Consultation notes / summary emailed to the client.

options.label: Notes not sent
options.does: Decided not to send notes — say why in the details.

options.label: Retain — no fees quoted
options.does: Client wants to retain; fee not discussed yet.

options.label: Fees quoted
options.does: Fee discussed with the client.

options.label: Follow-up done
options.does: Follow-up call / email completed.

options.label: No answer / voicemail
options.does: Tried to reach the client, no answer.

options.label: Client to revert
options.does: Waiting on the client to come back to us.

options.label: Documents requested
options.does: Asked the client for documents / information.

options.label: Details (optional) — what was discussed, what happens next…
options.does: Free text up to 2000 characters. Type it BEFORE clicking a remark button to include it, or post it alone.

options.label: Your name
options.does: Required.

options.label: Post remark
options.does: Posts the details text on its own.

next: Update '📝 [Remark · <name>] <remark> — <details>' on the lead; the Leads list Current status shows it at once.
watch_out: 'Pick a remark or write one.' · 'Add your name so the team knows who did this.'
A remark does NOT set the Outcome and does NOT stop booking reminders — only an Outcome (or a booking or payment) does.
steps.title: Post a remark about what was done for a lead
steps.summary: One-click remark buttons (or your own text) post an update to the lead's Monday updates so the team sees what was done. The latest remark shows in the Leads list's Current status.
steps.where: Lead page → card 'Outcome & remarks' → 'Remarks — what was done for this lead'; or Consultation record → card 'Consultation' → 'Remarks — what was done for this lead'

steps.access: Named admins only: signed in with Monday AND on the admin list. With the team key alone the bin icon is hidden and the app refuses ("Sign in with Monday to delete records — the shared admin key doesn’t say who you are.").
before: You are sure the lead is junk or a duplicate.

options.label: Type DELETE to confirm
options.does: Turns on 'Delete permanently'.

options.label: Delete permanently
options.does: Deletes the lead row(s) and the OneDrive lead folder, and cancels any Square consultation appointment and any open Square consultation invoice.

options.label: Cancel
options.does: Closes without deleting.

options.label: Basic Information (section 1)

options.does: Required: Do you have a spouse or common-law partner? (if Yes: would they accompany you / be included?), How many dependent children do you have? (0–12; if more than 0: would the children accompany you — All / Some / None / Not sure).

options.label: Current Immigration Status (section 3)
options.does: Required: current status (Visitor, Student, Worker, Permanent Resident, Citizen, Maintained Status, Out of Status, Not in Canada, Other); expiry date for a temporary permit. Optional: recent extension / change of status.

options.label: Your Relationship With TDOT (section 4)
options.does: Required: New inquiry / Existing client with active application / Previous client with completed or inactive application.

options.label: Service Required (section 5)
options.does: Required: the service (Permanent Residence, Temporary Residence, After PR Services, Employer Services, Other Support), a short explanation, and 'What would you like to do?' (Book consultation / Start new application / Request quote / Existing file update).

options.label: A Few Service-Specific Questions (section 6)
options.does: Only for the chosen service (e.g. CRS score, ITA deadline). Optional; refusal review and 'other' allow a letter upload.

options.label: Urgency Screening (section 7)
options.does: Required: urgent deadline (with the date and reason if Yes); removal or enforcement order; a letter from CBSA, IRCC or the police (optional upload); restoration period (asked only when inside Canada); recent refusal (with what was refused and when, if Yes; optional upload).

options.label: How You Found Us & Consent (section 8)
options.does: Required: how they heard about TDOT (Existing client / Referral / Social media / Google / Website / Walk in / Event) and all four consent boxes.

options.label: Uploads

options.does: The client paid online, but the app could not put the consultation on the Square calendar. Add it to the consultant's Square calendar by hand, or the time looks free there.

next: Update '💳 Consultation fee recorded as paid — …' or '🆓 Consultation fee waived — …'.

The HST on top of the fee is fixed now from where the client is (none outside Canada); the consultation agreement then says the client 'has paid $X (incl. HST)', or 'nothing (the consultation fee was waived)'.
Lead Current status shows 'Fee recorded — no time booked yet' / 'Fee waived — no time booked yet' until a time is booked.
If recording with the booking is turned on, the window also asks for the booking and whether to email the package (next step). Otherwise it is a record only — no email and nothing automatic.
steps.client_sees: Nothing, unless you choose to email the package.
watch_out: Refused for a booking-link payment: '… there is nothing to record here. A refund is done in Square.'
'Enter the fee received, in dollars and cents.' · 'Enter the date received.' · 'Enter your name — it is recorded with the payment.'
If a booking-page payment link or Square invoice was made earlier, the reply tells you to cancel it in Square so the client is not charged twice.
If the client later also pays online, the app posts '🚨 Possible DOUBLE PAYMENT on the consultation' — refund one in Square.

On the lead page the button only shows before booking, with no case, not paid online and not holding a time online. After recording, the booking invite would ask the client to PAY again (the app warns you).
Type the fee before HST. Example: a client in Canada pays $226 for a $200 consultation, so you type 200 ($226 ÷ 1.13). A client outside Canada pays no HST, so type what they paid.

Hints under 'Fee received' while you type: 'This looks like the total WITH HST — enter the fee before HST (the agreement adds the HST).' (the amount equals a consultant's fee plus HST) or 'The booking fee for this consultation is $X.' (the amount differs from the fee on file). Nothing is blocked — check your figure.

The top of the window reads 'For <client> · consultation <date time>' — or '· not booked in the app (an online hold for <date time> expired)' when the time is only an expired online hold. Check the name before you record.
steps.title: Record a consultation fee paid by cash, e-transfer or invoice — or waived

Also from the lead page (before booking): card 'Booking invite email' → 'Record payment / Waived' (or 'Record payment / Waived (and book)' / 'Change payment record'), which opens the same window.

steps.access: All staff
before: The setting is on.
No outcome, no retainer, no case, not a direct-retainer client, and no package sent yet — otherwise the window explains why no package is sent.

options.label: Date / Time (Toronto time)
options.does: The consultation time; pre-filled only when the lead is already Booked with a future time.

options.label: Consultant
options.does: 'Choose…' or a consultant; a hint 'Suggested by the case type: <name>' may show.

options.label: Length
options.does: The lengths that consultant offers (e.g. '30 minutes').

options.label: How → Choose… / In person (at the office) / Video (Teams) / Phone call
options.does: Video makes a Teams meeting — 'A Teams meeting is created — the client and the consultant get its invite.'

options.label: Yes — email them now ('Yes — email them' for a waived fee)
options.does: Saves the booking and emails the package. The button becomes 'Record & email' ('Save & email' when changing a record).

options.label: No — don’t email them
options.does: No package. 'Why not?' is required for a paid fee (e.g. given in person, or the consultation already happened), optional for waived. With No, the date and time can be left empty.

next: The lead is set to Booked with the time, consultant, meeting type and length; Consultation Held = the date; 'Booked by' is filled if empty.
Video: a Teams meeting is made and its link saved; an earlier video meeting for another time is taken off the lead (you are told to delete it from the organiser's calendar).

No Square appointment is made for a booking entered by staff, and the app never adds one later. Add the time to the consultant's Square calendar yourself. Otherwise Square shows the time as free and someone could book over it.
Yes: the package is emailed at once. If there is no residential address, it is held instead and sent automatically when you save the address.
The 24-hour and 1-hour consultation reminders still go out for a future time; with No, the pre-consultation form reminder is not sent.
steps.client_sees: With Yes: 'Your TDOT Immigration consultation — details, form & agreement' (and a signing request when e-signing is on). With Video: a Teams calendar invite.
watch_out: 'Choose whether to email the consultation agreement and form to the client.'

'Say why the client is not being emailed the agreement and form.' — the example is in the box label 'Why not? (e.g. given to them in person, or the consultation already happened)'; for a waived fee the label reads 'Why not? (optional)' and no reason is needed.'
'That consultation time has already passed, so the package cannot be emailed for it. Choose “No”…'
Refused while the client is booking online (their time is held): 'The client is booking online right now (their time is held)…', or when the consultant already has an overlapping consultation.

'There is no email for this client, so the package cannot be emailed.' From this window, a person on the Not Wanted list is not emailed the package and gets no Teams invite — but the 24-hour and 1-hour consultation reminders still go out to them.
If the reply says the Teams link could not be saved, do NOT save again (it would make a second meeting) — paste the link into 'Meeting Link' in Monday.

If the window has no 'Consultation booking' section, look for a grey line in its place. 'The consultation package already went out…', 'An outcome is already set…', 'This client already has a case…', 'A retainer is already under way…' or 'A direct retainer client has no consultation…' say why no booking is asked. If there is neither a section nor such a line, booking from this window is switched off. The fee is still recorded, but you must enter the booking another way (the time on the lead in Monday) and send the package with 'Review & send'.

When you choose to email the package (or type a date or time with 'No'), the window checks every booking box before saving. You may see: 'Enter the consultation date.' · 'Enter the consultation time.' · 'Choose the consultant.' · 'Choose how the consultation happens: in person, video or phone.' · 'Choose the length.' The Date box does not accept a day before today.

If you see one of these three replies, NOTHING was saved — not even the fee. 'The consultation package is being sent right now — nothing was saved…' → wait a minute, reload, try again. 'Could not check the consultant’s other bookings in the app just now — nothing was saved…' → try again in a minute. 'Another client (lead N) is booked at … with no consultant set … Nothing was saved…' → set that lead's consultant in Monday, or choose another time.

'The booking you entered was NOT saved — …' means the fee was recorded but the booking was not. Reasons: the package already went out, booking from this window is switched off, or the client no longer has a consultation to book. Change the booking in Monday only if the time really moved. 'The consultation time entered has already passed, so the booking on the lead was left as it is.' means the same for a past time.

Video: '⚠ A calendar invite went to the client and <consultant>, but it has no Teams link … — the package was NOT emailed.' Ask whoever looks after the meeting organiser's calendar to delete that event (the reply gives its id) BEFORE you save again. Saving first sends the client and the consultant a second invite, and the first one has no join link. Or change How to in person or phone.

Video: '⚠ Booked, but the video meeting could not be created (…) — no invite went out and the package was NOT emailed.' Here it is safe to save the record again to retry, or choose in person or phone.

With 'Yes — email them now' and no residential address on the lead, the window says 'There is no residential address on this lead — the package waits until you add it on this page (the agreement prints it).' The fee is still recorded; the package goes out once you save the address.

With 'No — don’t email them' the window says 'Leave the date and time empty if the consultation has already happened. The booking reminders still go out for a time ahead.' — a future date and time typed here still triggers the meeting reminders.

With 'Yes — email them now' a green line previews what the agreement will say: 'The agreement will say the client has paid $X (incl. HST).' or 'The agreement will say the consultation fee was waived.' Check it before you press.

options.label: (Retain)

'This lead has no usable email or phone … not added to the list.'

Saving writes every box at once. A box left at '—' does NOT clear the value in Monday (the old value stays), even though the update shows '—' for it. If someone changed the Lead owner on the lead page since you opened this record, reload first, or you put the old owner back. The update reads 'Attribution saved — owner: …, booked by: …, payment reviewed by: …, follow-up: …'.
steps.title: Save the follow-up date and who owns the lead

steps.access: All staff
before: The consultation has happened and an outcome is set, a retainer is under way, or the client is a direct-retainer client.

options.does: Client may carry a 'direct' tag (or 'direct · <original channel>'). Consult fee 'n/a' for a direct client. Sent shows days waiting in brackets until signed. Stage: Paid / Signed / Sent / Fee set / Retain / New / —. Case: Open / Pending / —.

Hovering the grey 'direct' tag next to a client's name says 'Walk-in / referral — no consultation' or 'Converted from a <channel> lead — no consultation'.
steps.title: Work the Retainers & follow-ups list
steps.summary: Shows what the team does after a consultation (send the retainer, call back) plus direct-retainer clients. A consultation moves here once it has happened and an outcome is set (Retain, or a retainer under way, moves it at once; a consultation booked for a later day stays on the Consultations tab). It drops off once the client is retained (the case is then on the Cases page). A lead that never booked stays on the Leads page unless its Outcome is Retain or a retainer is under way.
steps.where: Consultations page → tab 'Retainers & follow-ups' → 'Show' buttons, filter bar and table

steps.title: Set up a walk-in or referral as a direct retainer client
steps.summary: For a client who goes straight to a retainer with no booking and no consultation. The popup creates the client with their case type and consultant, opens their case straight away, and then takes you to their Retainer plan.
steps.where: Consultations page (/admin/consultations) → Consultations tab → "＋ Direct retainer client" → popup "New direct retainer client" → "Create & open retainer"
steps.access: Staff signed in with the team key (the Consultations pages need it)
before: The client's full legal name, email, phone, residential address, case type (and sub-type when the case type has variants) and the consultant who is retaining them

options.label: Full legal name *
options.does: Required.

options.label: Email *
options.does: Required and must look like a real email — the retainer agreement is sent to it. When you leave the box the app checks for an existing client and the Not Wanted list.

options.label: Phone *
options.does: Required and must be a valid number. When you leave the box the app runs the same existing-client and Not Wanted check.

options.label: Residential address * (printed on the retainer agreement)
options.does: Required.

options.label: Case type *
options.does: Required; pick from the list. It sets the case number and the document checklist.

options.label: Case sub-type
options.does: Shows "— (can be set later)" until you pick a case type. After that it shows "Choose… (required)" when the case type has more than one checklist version, or "— (none for this case type)" when it has only one.

options.label: Consultant *
options.does: Required. The consultant signs the agreement and owns the case.

options.label: Referred by
options.does: Optional.

options.label: Notes (saved as an update on the client and their case in Monday)
options.does: Optional, up to 2,000 characters. Posted once on the client and on the case.

options.label: Cancel
options.does: Closes the popup (Esc or clicking outside also closes it). Nothing is saved.

options.label: Create & open retainer
options.does: Creates the client (or links the existing record you chose), opens their case, and opens the client's consultation page with the Retainer plan.

next: The client is created in the "Direct retainer clients" group of the Lead Board, with Source Channel "Direct Retainer" and Conversion Status "Qualified".
The case opens at once on the Cases board (stage Pre-Onboarding, Payment Status left empty) and gets its case number, OneDrive folder and portal link from the case type.
A note on the client says: "Direct retainer client created … Next: set the retainer fee + plan and click “Retain & send agreement”."

You may see a message first: "Linked to the existing lead — one record for this person, now set up as a direct retainer client." or "This client already exists as a direct retainer lead — opening it instead of creating a duplicate."
Then continue with the Retainer plan (set fee, save plan, Retain & send).
steps.client_sees: Nothing yet. The client hears from us when the retainer agreement is sent.
watch_out: Message "Name, email, phone, residential address, case type and consultant are required."
Message "This case type has checklist variants — choose the Case Sub Type."

The app also refuses: "A valid client email is required — the retainer agreement is sent to it.", "The client’s residential address is required — it is printed on the retainer agreement.", "A valid client phone number is required — it goes on the case record and is used to reach the client.", "Choose the consultant retaining this client — they sign the agreement and own the case.", "That sub-type does not belong to the chosen case type."
Pressing Create twice for the same person, email and case type does not make a duplicate — the app reuses the first record as long as no agreement has gone out.
If the message says tagging failed, the client was still created: follow the note on the client to set the case type and consultant by hand. Do not create them again.
If the case could not be opened, a note says it will be created automatically when the retainer is signed.
The popup is emptied every time it opens, so check you are typing for the right person.
If the popup says 'Could not load the case-type list — close and reopen to retry.', the Case type and Consultant lists stay empty: close the popup and open it again.

After 'Create & open retainer' the button reads 'Creating…' and is greyed. 'Creation failed — try again.' keeps the popup open with what you typed. 'This client may already exist — choose an option above.' means the app found a match only at that moment: the duplicate panel is shown for your choice.

The app's own checks can also show in the same red line: 'The client’s full legal name is required.', 'Choose a case type — it generates the case reference and the document checklist.', 'This case type has checklist variants — choose the Case Sub Type (it drives the document checklist).', 'This person is on the Not Wanted list — read the warning and tick the box if you mean to set them up anyway.'

steps.title: Answer the 'already exists' and Not Wanted warnings in the direct retainer popup

steps.access: Staff signed in with the team key
before: Email or phone typed in the popup

options.label: Link to existing lead — <name> — keeps ONE record for this person
options.does: Turns that existing lead into the direct retainer client instead of making a new one. Only offered for a lead with no case, no retainer sent, no booking, no retainer plan in progress and not Retained.

options.label: Create a new client anyway (I checked — this is a different person or a genuinely new matter)
options.does: Creates a new client record.

options.label: Open case: <case number> (link)
options.does: Shown for information. If it is the same matter, work in that case instead of creating a new client.

options.label: Client account: <name> / Existing lead: <name> — <reason>
options.does: Shown for information (for example "already has a case", "retainer already sent", "has a consultation booked — manage it from the Consultations page", "retainer plan in progress", "retained").

options.label: I have read the warning — set this person up as a direct retainer client anyway
options.does: Tick box shown when the person is on the Not Wanted list. You must tick it to continue; it is a warning only.

next: If you continue for someone on the Not Wanted list, a note is added to the client saying staff saw the warning and set them up anyway.
When you link an existing lead, a note says it was linked as a direct retainer client (and which channel it first came from).
steps.client_sees: Nothing. The Not Wanted warning is never shown to the client.
watch_out: Message "Possible existing records found — choose "link to existing" or "create new anyway" above."
Message "This person is on the Not Wanted list — tick the box above if you mean to set them up anyway."
Changing the email or phone clears the box and your choice — the check runs again.

The app refuses the link in five cases, and each message tells you where to go instead: "That lead already has an open case — open the case instead of creating a direct client." · "That lead has already been sent a retainer — open it from the Consultations page instead." · "That lead has a consultation booked or held — manage it from the Consultations page instead of converting it to a direct client." · "That lead already has a retainer plan in progress — open it from the Consultations page and continue there." · "The chosen lead does not match the name, email or phone you typed — re-check the duplicate panel and try again."
If the Not Wanted list cannot be read, a softer box says so — nothing is blocked.
In the red 'On the Not Wanted list' box, '· lead <number>' is a link: it opens, in a new tab, the earlier lead that put this person on the list, so you can read why.

steps.title: Start a direct retainer from an existing lead or a previous case
steps.summary: The same popup opens already filled in when you convert a lead from the Leads page, or start a new application from a client's previous case. Check everything before creating.
steps.where: Lead page → "→ Convert to direct retainer", or case page → "➕ New application" → Consultations page opens with the "New direct retainer client" popup filled in
steps.access: Staff signed in with the team key

options.label: Converting lead <number> (<name>) to a direct retainer client
options.does: Banner when you came from a lead: the existing lead is reused, no duplicate is made. Pick the case type and consultant, then create.

options.label: Carried from previous application <case number> — review everything before creating
options.does: Banner when you came from a case: name, email, phone, address and family are carried over. Immigration status and expiry are never carried. Any refusal on file or other open case is shown.

options.label: I confirmed the residential address is CURRENT with the client (it prints on the retainer agreement)
options.does: Tick box shown when an address was carried from a previous case. Required.

next: Carried family members land in the Retainer plan's family list — confirm the list there before sending.
The new case is a separate case; the old one is not changed.
watch_out: Message "Confirm the residential address is current with the client (checkbox above) — it prints on the retainer agreement."
If the address is more than a year old the banner says "over a year old" — ask the client.

If the email or phone also matches another lead or case, a note box says so. If you change the email or phone, the window forgets which lead you were converting, and the duplicate check shows that lead again for you to choose.
If the lead could not be loaded: "Could not load that lead — fill the fields manually (the duplicate check will still offer to link it)."

steps.title: Typing a Retainer Signed date on the Lead Board (and the hold rule)
steps.summary: Typing a date in the Lead Board's "Retainer Signed" column runs the same steps as a signature. If the lead's outcome is Follow-Up, Newsletter or Not Wanted, the date is kept but put on hold. No case opens and no payment request is sent until someone sets the outcome to Retain.
steps.where: Monday.com → Lead Board → the lead → "Retainer Signed" date column
steps.access: Anyone with Monday access to the Lead Board

options.label: Retainer Signed date (outcome Retain or blank)
options.does: Opens the case and emails the client the first-milestone e-Transfer request.

options.label: Retainer Signed date (outcome Follow-Up / Newsletter / Not Wanted)
options.does: Held. Note: "⚠ Retainer Signed (date) is recorded, but the outcome is “…” — no case was opened and no payment link was sent. If the client really signed, set the outcome to Retain: the case then opens with this signed date, and no new agreement is sent."

options.label: Outcome → Retain (on a held lead)
options.does: Opens the case with the held signed date. No new agreement is sent. Set Retain in the Lead Board's Outcome column in Monday — the app has no Retain outcome button, and 'Retain & send agreement' refuses a lead that already has a signed date.

options.label: (clearing the date)
options.does: Does nothing — the app ignores a cleared date.

next: Held leads wait; the payment request also waits until Retain opens the case.
steps.client_sees: The first-milestone e-Transfer request email, once the case opens.
watch_out: Prefer the app button "Mark retainer signed" on the client's consultation record. It refuses unless the outcome is Retain, and it will not run the steps again once the case is open.
Never clear a held date to 'fix' it — clearing it would let a later Retain email a second agreement. Set the outcome to Retain instead.
Not held: e-signatures through Documenso, direct retainer clients, leads that already have a case, Retained leads, and leads with a blank outcome.
If a note says "⚠ Handoff failed — no Client Master case was created", check the lead's email and name, then mark the retainer signed again, or create the case by hand.

steps.title: Open a client's Retainer plan
steps.summary: Everything about the retainer — fee, plan, agreement, signatures and milestone payments — is done in the "Retainer plan" card on the client's consultation page.
steps.where: Consultations page → "Consultations" or "Retainers & follow-ups" tab → click the client's row → client's consultation page → card "Retainer plan" (lower part of the page)
steps.access: Staff signed in with the team key (without it the page sends you back to the sign-in page)
before: The client has a lead record (website form, Add lead, email-to-lead, or the direct retainer popup)

options.label: Booked · Consult · Outcome · Retainer · Signed · Paid · Case (progress line at the top of the page)
options.does: Read-only. Retainer = agreement sent, Signed = Retainer Signed date, Paid = Retainer Paid date, Case = a case is linked.

options.label: Case status → Booking status · Consultation held · Outcome · Retainer fee · Retainer sent · Retainer signed · Retainer countersigned · Retainer paid · Case created
options.does: Read-only summary of where the client stands.

watch_out: The outcome buttons on this page do not include Retain. Retain is set only by "Retain & send agreement" in the Retainer plan card.

steps.title: Set the retainer fee
steps.summary: The professional fee (in Canadian dollars, before HST) that the agreement states. Nothing else in the plan can be previewed, saved or sent until it is set.
steps.where: Client's consultation page → "Retainer plan" → Fees → "Retainer fee" box ("Fee (CAD $)") → "Set fee"
steps.access: Staff signed in with the team key
before: The agreement has not been sent yet (otherwise press "✎ Amend" first)

options.label: Fee (CAD $)
options.does: Whole dollars, more than 0.

options.label: Set fee
options.does: Asks "Set the retainer fee to $X? If the retainer is already signed, this emails the payment link to the client." then saves the fee and posts a note "Retainer fee set to $X CAD." The button greys out until you change the amount.

next: Message: "Retainer fee set to $X. The retainer agreement (once Outcome is Retain) and the payment link (once signed) are emailed automatically."

The agreement is emailed automatically if three things are true: the outcome is already Retain, no agreement has gone out yet, and the retainer plan is complete. If the plan is not complete, the agreement waits and no note tells you. Use 'Retain & send agreement' to see what is missing.
If the retainer is already signed, the first-milestone e-Transfer request is emailed to the client automatically.
steps.client_sees: Possibly the retainer agreement or the first e-Transfer request (see above).
watch_out: Message "Enter a fee amount in CAD dollars first."
Refused once the agreement is sent: "The retainer agreement has already been sent, so the fee and milestones are locked. Use “Amend” if you genuinely need to change them."
"Fee must be a plain CAD dollar amount." / "Fee must be a positive amount in CAD dollars (max …)."
Changing the fee after an amend only records a note — the agreement is NOT sent again.

steps.title: Choose the agreement template, case type, sub-type, scope annex and fees
steps.summary: The plan decides which agreement is used and who signs it, which scope-of-services annex is attached, and the case type and sub-type the case and its checklist will get.
steps.where: Client's consultation page → "Retainer plan" → "Case & agreement" and "Fees" groups
steps.access: Staff signed in with the team key
before: Retainer fee set (until then Preview and Save are greyed out with the hint "Set the retainer fee first")

options.label: Signatory template → Principal Applicant only
options.does: The client alone signs (plus the RCIC).

options.label: Signatory template → PA + Inviter / Sponsor / Dependent
options.does: Shows the co-signer block; the second person signs at the same time as the client.

options.label: Signatory template → Employer / Legal Rep
options.does: Shows the "Employer / legal representative" block.

options.label: Case type ("— select case type —")
options.does: The confirmed case type from the approved list. It becomes the case's Primary Case Type and case number prefix. An old value outside the list shows as "(legacy — pick a canonical type to confirm)" and is not saved.

options.label: Sub-type ("Choose… (required for the checklist)" / "— (none for this case type) —")
options.does: Decides the document checklist and questionnaire. Required for case types with variants.

options.label: Scope annex ("— select scope annex —", Permanent / Temporary groups)
options.does: The scope-of-services annex attached to the agreement. A "Suggested:" line shows the app's pick with a "verify" or "high" tag.

options.label: Government fee (CAD)
options.does: Printed in the agreement.

options.label: Include RPRF
options.does: Tick to include the Right of Permanent Residence Fee.

options.label: Advertisement fee (CAD) (LMIA recruitment)
options.does: Only shown for LMIA case types, or when a value is already saved.

options.label: HST rate (%) (13% default)
options.does: Used for every milestone's HST and total.

options.label: Fees (auto-calculated)
options.does: Read-only line: professional fee, HST and total including HST ("(HST-exempt)" at 0%).

next: Nothing is sent and nothing is saved until you press "Save retainer plan".
watch_out: A yellow box "Before sending, please check:" lists what is missing, for example "Client residential address is blank — add it before generating.", "Client email is blank — the agreement cannot be emailed.", "No scope annex selected — choose one.", "The "pa-inviter" template needs: … — enter in the portal.", "No default government fee for this annex — enter it manually."
A sub-type that does not belong to the case type is refused: "… is not a known sub-type of … — pick one from the list."
Choose the sub-type here, before sending — a blank or wrong sub-type stops the document checklist when the case opens.

The case type and Sub Type are copied to the case only once, when the case is created. Changing them here later (✎ Amend + Save) changes the client record only. On an open case, change Primary Case Type / Case Sub Type on the Cases board, then set Re-seed Checklist to Run.

Changing the Case type empties the Sub Type, so pick it again. A stored sub-type that is not on the list shows '(legacy — pick from the list)' and is not saved. '(list unavailable — reload to edit)', '— could not load case types (reload to retry) —', 'Could not load retainer plan: …' or 'Timed out — please try again.' mean reload the page.
steps.setting_note: The agreement is built from this plan (TDOT's own templates, scope annex, milestone annex and co-signer) only when the new retainer templates are turned on. Otherwise a standard agreement stating the fee is sent.

steps.access: Staff signed in with the team key
before: Agreement not yet sent (or "✎ Amend" pressed)

options.does: The person's role. On a Super Visa, Spouse reads "Second parent (spouse of the applicant)" (or "Second grandparent …").

options.label: Full name / Date of birth / Current status / Residence country (columns; hints 'Full name (optional)', 'e.g. Visitor', 'e.g. Canada')
options.does: Optional; they pre-fill the member's questionnaire.

options.label: Accomp.
options.does: Ticked = this person gets a Family Members row, checklist and questionnaire section.
Removes the row.

options.does: Adds a new row (Spouse, ticked Accomp.).

options.label: Super Visa box "Super Visa — both parents applying?" → "Add the second parent" (both read "grandparent" on a grandparent Super Visa)

next: Saved with "Save retainer plan". The rows become Family Members on the case when the case number is given (or at signing for a direct retainer client).
watch_out: Once the client has signed and the case is open, changes here no longer reach the case — use "➕ Add family member" on the case page.
Super Visa: a "Parent" row has no documents — use the second-parent type. The box warns about two second parents, or a Parent and a second parent both ticked.
At "Retain & send" a Super Visa with only one parent asks: "This Super Visa lists ONE parent. Are both parents applying? …" — Cancel to fix the list, OK to send as it is.

Super Visa after signing: the box says 'The client has signed — this list was read when the case was set up, and changes here no longer reach the case.' Check the case page's Family card: the second parent must show as 'Second parent', not 'Parent'. If they show as Parent, ask an admin to change them. Do NOT add them again. If the client has signed but the case is not open yet, the list reaches the case when it opens. If the box says 'press ✎ Amend, fix the list and Save so the case gets it.', do that first.

The Super Visa box says exactly what is wrong: 'Two rows are marked “Second parent” and ticked “Accomp.” — a Super Visa has one second parent. Remove one.' · 'Both a “Second parent” and a “Parent” row are ticked “Accomp.” — if they are the same person, remove the “Parent” row…' · 'A family member is listed as “Parent” — a Super Visa has no documents for that type. Change that row’s Type to “Second parent”.' · 'Only one parent is listed. If both parents are applying, add the second parent (Type “Second parent”, ticked “Accomp.”).' · 'Second parent listed: <name>.' (On a grandparent Sub Type the word is 'grandparent'.)

steps.title: Enter the co-signer or employer details
steps.summary: For the PA + Inviter template the second signer's details are all required. For the Employer template the company and representative details are printed in the agreement.

steps.access: Staff signed in with the team key
before: Signatory template set to "PA + Inviter / Sponsor / Dependent" or "Employer / Legal Rep"

options.label: Email (required — receives the signing request)
options.does: Co-signer's email.

options.does: Co-signer's address.

steps.title: Set the milestone schedule
steps.summary: The fee is split into milestones. Each has an amount, HST and total, and the case stage at which it falls due. Milestone 1 is the non-refundable admin fee and is requested at signing.

steps.access: Staff signed in with the team key
before: Retainer fee set

options.label: Label
options.does: Milestone 1's label is locked ("Milestone 1 – Admin Fee (Non-Refundable)").

options.label: Amount (CAD)
options.does: Before HST. HST and Total fill in by themselves.

options.label: Trigger ("— when due —": Pre-Onboarding / Retainer Confirmed / Document Collection Started / Internal Review / Submission Preparation / Submission Ready / Application Submitted)
options.does: The case stage at which this milestone shows as Due.

options.label: Add milestone
options.does: Adds a row.

options.label: Split fee evenly
options.does: Divides the fee across the rows (any remainder on the last).
Removes a row (never the last one).

next: The heading shows "— milestones total $X / fee $Y ✓" or "(off by …)", and "· case is at <stage>" once a case exists.
steps.client_sees: The schedule is printed in the agreement as the milestone annex.
watch_out: Saving is refused unless: "At least one milestone is required.", "The first milestone must carry the administrative fee (non-refundable).", "Every milestone must have an amount greater than zero.", and the total matches the fee ("Milestones total $… but the professional fee is $….").
Always pick a Trigger. A later milestone left at '— when due —' never shows as due and never gets a 'Send e-transfer request' button. (Milestone 1 is the exception: it is requested at signing.)

Only milestone 1 is requested automatically (at signing). Later milestones are never emailed by the app and nothing reminds anyone. A milestone counts as due once the case reaches or passes its Trigger stage. Someone must check and send the request (see 'Check which milestones are due and request them').

Milestone 1 (the admin fee) can be re-amounted but never renamed or removed: its Label box is greyed and its last column reads 'locked' instead of ✕. The ✕ on other rows does nothing when only one row is left.

The heading shows a live sum: '— milestones total $X / fee $Y ✓' (green) or '(off by $Z)' (red) or '(set the fee first)', plus '· case is at <stage>' once a case exists — that stage decides which row shows 'Due'.

steps.title: Preview and save the retainer plan

steps.access: Staff signed in with the team key
before: Retainer fee set

options.label: Preview retainer agreement

options.label: Save retainer plan
options.does: Asks "Save this retainer plan (template, scope annex, fees, milestones)? This does not send anything to the client." then saves and posts a note "Retainer plan saved — template …, scope annex …, fee $…."

next: "Retain & send agreement" becomes clickable (it needs a saved plan).
watch_out: Any edit in the plan after saving greys out "Retain & send agreement" again until you save (hint "Save the retainer plan first").
Save is refused without a template and scope annex: "Choose a signatory template and a scope annex."

steps.title: Retain the client and send the retainer agreement
steps.summary: One click sets the outcome to Retain and emails the agreement for e-signature (or as a PDF link when e-signing is off or fails). The result shows straight away.
steps.where: Client's consultation page → "Retainer plan" action bar → "Retain & send agreement"
steps.access: Staff signed in with the team key
before: Fee set and plan saved
Client email and residential address on file
Sub Type chosen when the case type has variants
Agreement not already sent; client not already signed or Retained

next: Outcome becomes Retain; staff on the outcome notification list get an "Outcome: Retain" email.
The agreement goes to the client through Documenso (and to the co-signer at the same time); the "Retainer Sent" date is stamped.
The exact PDF sent is saved in the client's OneDrive folder (Retainer folder).
If Documenso fails or is off, the client gets an email with a PDF link instead and a note says so.
The fee and milestones lock (banner "🔒 The retainer agreement has been sent. The fee & milestones are locked.").
steps.client_sees: Documenso email "Your TDOT Immigration retainer agreement — please sign" (or, without e-signing, "Your TDOT Immigration retainer agreement" with "View & download your retainer (PDF)").
watch_out: Result messages: "✓ Retainer agreement emailed to the client." / "Not sent — the retainer plan isn’t complete: … Fix these, save, and click again." / "Not sent — no client email on file. Add the client’s email, then click again." / "Not sent — set the retainer fee first." / "Not sent — … Fix them in the retainer panel, save, and click again — the agreement goes to both signers at once." (co-signer) / "Not sent — generation/email failed (…). It will retry; check the note on the lead."

Refused: "The retainer agreement has already been sent to this client."; "This client has already been retained (signed) — a new retainer agreement should not be sent. Use “Amend” to record a change instead."; "Set the retainer fee before sending the agreement."; ""<case type>" needs a Sub-type before sending — pick one in the retainer plan (it selects the document checklist)."
A walk-in who already paid milestone 1 can still be sent the agreement — payment alone does not lock it.
Greyed-out button hints: "Set the retainer fee first", "Save the retainer plan first", "Agreement already sent", "Client already retained — no new agreement needed".
The outcome is set to Retain even when the reply says 'Not sent' — fix what it names, save the plan, and press the button again.
'Outcome set to Retain — the agreement will be emailed shortly.' means it is on its way. Don't press again.
steps.setting_note: Sent for e-signature only when e-signing (Documenso) is turned on. The plan's template, co-signer and saved OneDrive copy apply only when the new retainer templates are turned on. The staff outcome email goes only to people on the notification list.

steps.title: Amend a plan after the agreement was sent
steps.summary: Unlocks the fee and milestones for a deliberate, recorded change. It does NOT send the agreement again.
steps.where: Client's consultation page → "Retainer plan" → lock banner → "✎ Amend"
steps.access: Staff signed in with the team key
before: Agreement sent, or client signed / Retained (the lock banner is showing)

options.label: ✎ Amend
options.does: Asks "The retainer agreement has already been emailed to the client. Amending the fee or milestones will NOT re-send it, and the client may hold an agreement stating the original terms — a staff note will record the change. Continue?" The plan becomes editable; banner "✎ Amending a sent agreement."

next: Saving posts "⚠ Retainer plan AMENDED after the agreement was sent …" (or "⚠ Retainer fee AMENDED after the agreement was sent …") and shows "Retainer plan amended — a staff note was recorded."
To send the new terms to a client who has not signed yet, use "🔄 Void & re-issue".
watch_out: Banner after signing: "🔒 This client has already been retained. The fee & milestones are locked — no new agreement will be sent." A signed agreement cannot be re-issued.

steps.title: Void an unsigned agreement and send a fresh one
steps.summary: The fix for a wrong signer email, a renegotiated fee or any change after sending: the old signing links stop working and a new agreement goes out with the current plan.
steps.where: Client's consultation page → "Retainer plan" → lock banner → "🔄 Void & re-issue" (shown only while sent and not signed)
steps.access: Staff signed in with the team key
before: Agreement sent but not signed
Outcome is Retain
Changes saved first (✎ Amend → edit → Save retainer plan)

next: The old Documenso request is cancelled (and any pending RCIC countersign request).
Note "🔄 Retainer agreement re-issued — the old envelope was voided and a fresh agreement emailed."
Message "✓ Old agreement voided — fresh agreement emailed with the current details."
steps.client_sees: A new signing email; the old one stops working.
watch_out: Refused if the client already signed: "The client has already signed — a signed agreement cannot be voided from here. Record changes with “Amend”."
Refused if the outcome is not Retain (nothing is voided) — the message tells you to set Retain on the Lead Board first.
If Documenso could not cancel the old links, the message says to tell the signers to use the NEW email only.
Partial results: "Old agreement voided, but the new one is HELD — …" or "…was NOT sent — no client email on file." — fix it, then press "Retain & send agreement".
"A re-issue is already running for this client — give it a moment, then refresh."
A signer who completes an OLD (voided) request is not recorded — a note warns about it.
steps.setting_note: Old signing links can only be cancelled when e-signing (Documenso) is turned on.

steps.title: Mark the retainer signed by hand

steps.access: Staff signed in with the team key
before: Outcome is Retain

If a note says "⚠ Handoff failed", check the client's email and name, then press it again.
'The retainer was already marked signed on <date> and the case is open — no change.' means it was already done. Nothing was sent again.

before: Client has signed
E-signing turned on

options.label: Countersigned
options.does: Greyed out — done.

next: When the RCIC signs: the countersign date is recorded, the fully signed PDF is saved to OneDrive, the client is emailed it, and a note goes on the lead.
If payment is already recorded, the case starts onboarding at that moment.
steps.client_sees: Email "Your fully signed TDOT Immigration retainer agreement" with the PDF attached.
watch_out: "The client has not signed the retainer agreement yet — the consultant signs after the client."
"E-signing (Documenso) is not enabled."

If a note says "⚠️ Countersign request WAS emailed to the consultant, but could not be recorded on this lead", do NOT press "Sign retainer as consultant" — it would send a second request. Sign from the email already received.
If a payment was flagged as wrong, the RCIC is asked not to countersign until an admin has checked it.

'Sign retainer as consultant' and 'View signed retainer' also appear after 'Mark retainer signed' (paper or emailed PDF). A paper signature needs no countersign in the app. If you press it anyway, it needs the client-signed PDF in the client's OneDrive or in Documenso. Without it you get 'The client-signed retainer PDF could not be retrieved (OneDrive + Documenso) — cannot start the countersign.' Another refusal: 'No consultant email on record — cannot issue the countersign envelope.'

If the new tab opens the Documenso documents page instead of the signing page, the request went to the consultant's email ('Countersign envelope issued — the signing link has been emailed to the consultant (Documenso).'). Sign from that email; don't press again.

The confirm box reads 'Add the consultant (RCIC) signature to the retainer now? The client has already signed. Your signature completes the agreement, and the fully signed copy is emailed to the client automatically.' Once signed, the greyed button's tooltip reads 'Retainer already countersigned by the consultant'.
steps.setting_note: Only when e-signing (Documenso) is turned on.

Staff on the signature notification list get "✍️ Retainer signed — <client> (<case type>)".
The consultant is emailed the countersign request automatically.
The client is emailed the first-milestone e-Transfer request (when a fee and milestones are set).

A co-signer with a missing or invalid email holds the send — nothing goes out until it is fixed.
After a re-issue, the old signing links stop working for both signers.
steps.setting_note: E-signing only when Documenso is turned on; a co-signer only when the new retainer templates are turned on; the staff alert goes only to people on the notification list.

steps.access: The client
before: Retainer signed and fee/milestones set (milestone 1 is requested automatically; later ones when staff send the request)

steps.access: Consultation page: staff with the team key. Case page: staff who can open the case (assigned staff when visibility is assigned-only) and admins.
before: The milestone shows Pending and Due (the case has reached its trigger stage) — or it is milestone 1 and the retainer is signed
A milestone schedule exists (otherwise the case page says "No milestone schedule yet — build the retainer plan on the consultation page first.")

options.label: Send e-transfer request (consultation page) / Send e-Transfer request (case page)
options.does: Asks "Email the e-transfer payment request for this milestone to the client now?" (case page: "Email the client an e-Transfer request for this milestone?"), then emails the client and marks the row Requested with a reference code; note "📧 E-transfer request sent".

options.label: Send e-transfer details / Send e-Transfer details
options.does: Only on old rows from the Square days: sends proper e-Transfer details.

next: Message "E-transfer request for <milestone> emailed to the client (ref <reference>)."
The row shows Requested with the reference.

The button is not shown for milestone 1 once the retainer is recorded paid.

Case page refuses when two client records share the case: "This case is linked to N client records, so it isn’t safe to record payments from here. Open the client from Consultations and record it on their own record."

"Enter your name — it is recorded with the payment."

'Already recorded as paid (<date>) — nothing changed.' means it was recorded before. Add the documents they need by hand; otherwise their documents are never asked for. '…built for another Case Type — see the note on the case (do not add the member again)' means read the note; the member IS added.

(the Add button stays off until it ends). 'Failed: … — reload the page and check the Family list before adding again.' means the request itself failed.
