next: Nothing is changed by opening the page or switching tabs.
watch_out: "Stage unavailable — reload" / "Payment unavailable — reload" means the app could not read the case from Monday just now. Reload; do not act on the page until it shows real values.
"Please sign in. Sign in with Monday or enter the admin key on the sign-in page." means your sign-in has expired.
"You are not assigned to this case, so you cannot view it. Ask an owner or the assigned case manager for access." means you are not named on the case.
"Case data is temporarily unavailable. Please reload in a moment." means Monday could not be read; reload.
The "Does not apply" document buttons only appear when you signed in with Monday (the shared admin key does not say who you are).

"Deadline" is the Hard Deadline. The app works it out every night from the Stage Start Date and the case type's SLA settings, for cases at Document Collection Started, Internal Review, Submission Preparation or Stuck. It is an internal target, not the client's own permit or IRCC deadline.

'Case not found: <case number>' means the number is wrong; 'Failed to load case: …' means the page could not load (reload). While the case cannot be read (Stage / Payment show 'unavailable — reload') the '📁 Case folder…' button is hidden.
steps.setting_note: Who can open which case depends on a setting: either all staff see every case, or staff see only cases they are assigned to.
steps.title: Open a case page and move between its tabs
steps.summary: Every open case has one staff page that shows the client, stage, payment, readiness, family, documents, questionnaire, payments, meeting, timeline and Monday updates in one place. Opening it changes nothing.
steps.where: 🗂️ Cases (/admin/dashboard) → click the case row → case page (/admin/case/<case number>). Also from the "Open case" links on Leads and Consultations, and from a case number on the Needs attention list.
steps.access: All signed-in staff (admin key or Monday sign-in). If the app is set to show staff only their assigned cases, you can open only cases where you are named in one of the people columns (Stage Owner, Ops Supervisor, Case Support Officer, Case Manager, Submission Team, Retained by, Override Approved By). Admins always see every case.

options.label: 🏠 Client portal
options.does: Opens the client's portal in staff view (shown only when the portal link is on the case). From there you can resend the portal email.

options.label: 📁 OneDrive
options.does: Opens the case's OneDrive folder (shown only when the folder link is on the case).

options.label: 📁 Case folder…
options.does: Shown instead of "📁 OneDrive" when no folder is linked. Checks OneDrive first and creates the folder only if the case truly has none (see "Create or link a missing case folder").

options.label: ✉ Email client
options.does: Opens your own email program addressed to the client. The app sends nothing.

options.label: ➕ New application
options.does: Opens the Consultations page with the new-client form filled in from this case, for you to check. The current case is not changed.

steps.title: Use the buttons at the top of the case page
steps.summary: Quick buttons to open the client's portal or OneDrive folder, write to the client, or start a new application for the same client.
steps.where: Case page → top right, next to the client's name
steps.access: Anyone who can open the case.

options.label: 📝 Questionnaire readiness
options.does: The % from the client's saved answers (all members together). Under it: "N of M member section(s) submitted". Green at 80% or more, amber at 50% or more, red below.

options.label: 📂 Document readiness
options.does: Shows how much the client has UPLOADED (Documents Uploaded %), not how much staff have reviewed. Under it: "X of Y document(s) in", then "· N not applicable", "· N optional not sent" and "· N reviewed" when they apply.

options.label: 👪 Family on this case
options.does: The Family Members board rows for the case (name, role, notes). "No family members recorded on the board." when there are none. The add-a-member box sits here.

options.label: 🧾 Questionnaire members
options.does: Each questionnaire section with its status: Submitted, In progress or Not started. "Primary applicant only." when there is one section.

options.label: 📑 Documents → Missing · Received · Reviewed · Rework · N/A · Total
options.does: Counts of the checklist by status, then each document by category with a coloured dot, the person and the status. "No checklist rows seeded yet." before the checklist exists.

watch_out: The documents meter here shows how much the client has uploaded. The automatic move to Internal Review uses a different number: Documents Readiness %, the share of documents that staff have marked Reviewed. A case with everything uploaded does not move on until staff mark the documents Reviewed.
steps.title: Read how far the client is (Overview tab)
steps.summary: Two meters show the questionnaire % and the documents %, with a count of documents by status, the family on the case and each questionnaire section.
steps.where: Case page → Overview tab → "📝 Questionnaire readiness", "📂 Document readiness", "👪 Family on this case", "🧾 Questionnaire members", "📑 Documents"
steps.access: Anyone who can open the case.

before: The case has a document checklist. Otherwise the page says "No documents found — Case reference <case number> has no document checklist items on the Execution Board yet." Build the checklist first (Re-seed Checklist).

options.label: Total · Received · Reviewed · Rework · Pending (· +N optional) · N/A
options.does: Counts by status at the top.

options.label: All
options.does: Filter: shows every document.

options.label: Received
options.does: Filter: only documents waiting for your review.

options.label: Reviewed
options.does: Filter: only accepted documents.

options.label: Rework
options.does: Filter: only documents sent back to the client.

options.label: Missing
options.does: Filter: only documents not uploaded yet.

options.label: N/A
options.does: Filter: only documents marked Not Applicable.

options.label: 📁 Open in OneDrive
options.does: Opens that document's category folder in OneDrive. Greyed out ("No OneDrive folder linked yet") when the case has no folder.

options.label: 📎 <file name> · <date> (latest upload), then '<n> earlier ▸' to open the older copies
options.does: Every copy the client uploaded for that document, newest first, each with its own link; shows "sent as <original name>" when the file was renamed.

options.label: 💬 <who wrote it> · <when>, then the reply text
options.does: Replies the client typed under a review note.

options.label: 💡 <the instruction text the client was given>
options.does: What the client was asked to provide — use it as the yardstick when you check the upload.

options.label: Optional
options.does: Tag on optional documents: they count toward the % only once uploaded.

watch_out: The top bar shows "Reviewing as <your name>" — check it is you.
If a yellow banner says the OneDrive folder links could not be loaded, review still works; reload to get the "Open in OneDrive" buttons back.

When the client uploaded again after a rework, the note reads "📝 Review note on file (row is Received — see the upload trail below):". The old note is kept on purpose so you can check the new copy against it.
Every document needs its own click — there is no "mark all reviewed".

If a bar says '⚠️ Could not load replies.' (or another reason) with a 'Retry' button, the client replies and the list of uploaded copies did not load; the review buttons still work, but the rows show no file links until Retry succeeds.

'Last upload: <date>' under a document is the date of the client's latest copy. 'Could not verify your access to this case — please try again shortly.' or 'Error loading review page' means a short outage, not a refusal — open the page again in a minute.
steps.title: Open the full document review page
steps.summary: A page with every document of the case, grouped by family member and category, showing every copy the client uploaded, their replies, and the review buttons.
steps.where: Case page → Documents tab → "Full review page (uploads & replies) →" (or "📎 Files" on a document to jump to it) → Document Review page (/d/<case number>/review). Also the "Open document review" link in Monday rework notes.
steps.access: Staff signed in with Monday (the admin key alone does not open it). Admins see every case; others see every case unless the app is set to assigned cases only.

before: Open the file first: "📎 Files" on the case page opens the review page at that document with every uploaded copy.
Case page: the button shows only on Received documents. Review page: the button works on Received, Under Review and Rework Required documents (greyed out on Reviewed, Missing and Not Applicable).

options.label: 📎 Files
options.does: Case page: opens the review page at this document, with every copy the client uploaded (newest first).

options.label: ✓ Mark reviewed
options.does: Case page: asks "Mark this document as reviewed?", then sets the status to Reviewed and shows "✓ Marked reviewed."

options.label: ✓ Mark Reviewed
options.does: Review page: no confirm box; sets the status to Reviewed and shows "✓ Marked as Reviewed". "↺ Undo" becomes available.

next: Monday sets Review Completed Date to today and Review Required to No on the document.
The case's document numbers (including Documents Readiness %) are recalculated straight away; this can move the case to Internal Review by itself.
steps.client_sees: In the portal the document shows "✓ Reviewed" and its upload button disappears. No email is sent.
watch_out: There is no Undo on the case page — use "↺ Undo" on the review page.
A Not Applicable document refuses: "This document is marked Not Applicable — press "Applies again" first, then reload the page."
"Not sent — an earlier change to this document is still being processed…" means wait a few minutes and reload before trying again.

Setting Document Status to 'Reviewed' by hand in Monday has the same effect as this button: Review Completed Date is today, Review Required is No, and the readiness numbers are recounted (which can move the case to Internal Review). Setting 'Received' by hand also alerts the team.
'That document is not on this case.' means the row belongs to another case (a stale page): nothing changed — reload the page.

On the case page a row shows only the buttons that fit its status: '✓ Mark reviewed' only on Received; '⟲ Request rework' on Received or Reviewed (a Reviewed document can still be sent back); '⊘ Does not apply' only on Missing or Received; '↩ Applies again' only on Not Applicable. Under the row, 'Rework note: …' or 'Not applicable: <reason> — <name>' shows the note or reason and who set it.
steps.title: Accept a document (mark it Reviewed)
steps.summary: After you open and check a file the client uploaded, mark it Reviewed. Only Reviewed documents count toward the automatic move to Internal Review.
steps.where: Case page → Documents tab → "📂 Document review" → the document → "✓ Mark reviewed"; or Document Review page (/d/<case number>/review) → the document → "✓ Mark Reviewed"
steps.access: Case page: anyone who can open the case. Review page: staff signed in with Monday who can see the case.

before: The document has an upload. Case page: shown on Received and Reviewed documents. Review page: works on Received, Reviewed and Under Review (greyed out on Rework Required, Missing and Not Applicable).

options.label: ⟲ Request rework
options.does: Case page: asks "What needs fixing on "<document>"? The client sees this note." → sets Rework Required with your note in Review Notes; shows "✓ Rework requested — the client will see your note."

options.label: Note box ("Explain to the client what needs to be corrected. This text will be sent to them by email and shown in their upload form.")
options.does: Review page: your note to the client. Required.

options.label: Send Rework Request
options.does: Review page: sets Rework Required with your note; shows "✓ Rework requested — client will be notified by email".

options.label: Cancel
options.does: Review page: closes the box without sending (not possible while it is sending).

next: Rework Count on the document goes up by 1 and its Escalation column reads "Triggered by Rework".
The case gets Escalation Required = Yes with the reason "Document rework required — <document> (<case number>)"; Monday notifies the Ops Supervisor.
Monday notification "Document flagged for rework: "<document>" (Case: <case number>)" to the Case Manager and Ops Supervisor.
Notes "🔄 Rework Requested by Staff" on the document and "🔄 Document Flagged for Client Rework" on the case.
The client email goes about 2 minutes after the LAST rework on the case — all reworks in that window go out in one email.
steps.client_sees: Email "Action Required: N item(s) need(s) your attention — Case <case number>" listing each document with your note and an "Upload Documents →" button. In the portal the document shows "Needs a new copy" with an "Upload new copy" button.
watch_out: Your note is sent to the client word for word — write it for the client.
A note is required: "A note is required for rework." (case page) / "Notes are required for rework requests." (review page).

If the page says "A rework request for this document may still go through — reload the page after HH:MM to check before sending again.", do NOT send again before reloading — a second send means a second email.
"Please wait — the previous rework request is still being sent." means wait.
"Your sign-in has expired — nothing was sent. Copy your note, then reload the page to sign in again."
Undo within the 2 minutes does NOT stop the email. The queued note is dropped only if the document is marked Not Applicable before the email goes.
Nothing in document review sets the case's Escalation Required back to No — someone has to clear it in Monday when the rework is resolved.

Setting Document Status to 'Rework Required' by hand on the Monday Document Checklist board does the same as this button: rework count, escalation, alerts, and the client email two minutes later. The email uses whatever is in Review Notes at that moment, so it can be blank or an OLD note. Type the Review Note first, or use this button (it makes you write a note).
steps.title: Send a document back to the client (request rework)
steps.summary: When an upload is wrong or incomplete, send it back with a note. The client is emailed and can upload a new copy.
steps.where: Case page → Documents tab → the document → "⟲ Request rework"; or Document Review page (/d/<case number>/review) → the document → "⟲ Request Rework" → box "Request Rework" → "Send Rework Request"
steps.access: Case page: anyone who can open the case. Review page: staff signed in with Monday who can see the case.

before: The document is Reviewed or Rework Required (greyed out otherwise).

options.label: ↺ Undo
options.does: No confirm box; status goes back to Received; shows "↺ Reopened — back to pending review".

next: The case's document numbers are recalculated. The Rework Count and the case escalation from an earlier rework are NOT reversed.
steps.client_sees: No email from the Undo itself — but a rework email already waiting (sent less than about 2 minutes ago) still goes out.
watch_out: You must Undo before you can mark a Reviewed or Rework Required document as Not Applicable.
steps.title: Undo a review decision (fix a mis-click)
steps.summary: Puts a Reviewed or Rework Required document back to Received without emailing the client.
steps.where: Document Review page (/d/<case number>/review) → the document → "↺ Undo" (not on the case page)
steps.access: Staff signed in with Monday who can see the case.

before: The document is Missing or Received (for "does not apply").

options.label: ⊘ Does not apply
options.does: Case page: asks "Why does "<document>" not apply to this client? (e.g. "client is single"). Only for a document that does not exist for the client — a file received by email is uploaded instead." → status Not Applicable with your reason, name and time; shows "⊘ Marked not applicable."

options.label: ⊘ Doesn't apply
options.does: Review page: opens the "Mark as Not Applicable" box.

options.label: Reason box ("Reason (required, shown to staff on the row)")
options.does: Review page: required, up to 300 characters.

options.label: ⊘ Mark Not Applicable
options.does: Review page: saves and reloads the page.

options.label: Cancel
options.does: Review page: closes the box without saving.

options.label: ↩ Applies again
options.does: Asks "Put this document back on the checklist? The client will see it as needed again (no email is sent)." → back to Received (if a file was ever uploaded) or Missing; shows "↩ Back on the checklist…".

next: Review Required is set to No; a note "⛔ Document marked Not Applicable — <document> — by <name>…" is posted on the document and on the case.
The document leaves every count (%, missing, blocking).

"Applies again" shows "↩ Back on the checklist." on the case page, or "↩ Back on the checklist as Received" / "↩ Back on the checklist as Missing" on the review page, and posts "↩️ Document applies again…" on the document and the case.
steps.client_sees: The portal shows "Not needed for your application — confirmed by your case officer" and the client cannot upload to it ("Your case officer confirmed this document is not needed for your application. If you believe it applies, please contact them."). "Applies again" sends no email.
watch_out: Only for a document that does not exist for this client. A file received by email is uploaded into the document instead.
A reason is required ("A reason is required." / "A reason is required to mark a document not applicable.").
"Sign in with Monday to mark a document not applicable — the shared admin key does not say who you are."

Refused on a Rework Required document: "Press Undo first — this document has an open rework request." Refused on a Reviewed document: "This document is already reviewed. Press Undo first if it really does not apply." Undo is only on the review page.

If someone sets Not Applicable by hand in Monday without a reason, the app writes "(set directly in Monday — no reason recorded)" and posts a note asking staff to fill the "Not Applicable Reason" column. Prefer the app buttons — they record the reason and your name.
""Not applicable" is switched off." means this option is turned off.
A file the client emailed you: see 'Upload a file the client sent by email' for how to put it into the document yourself.
steps.setting_note: Only when "Not applicable" is turned on.
steps.title: Mark a document "does not apply" (or put it back)
steps.summary: For a document that does not exist for this client (for example the client is single), take it off the checklist with a reason. It then stops counting everywhere.
steps.where: Case page → Documents tab → the document → "⊘ Does not apply" / "↩ Applies again"; or Document Review page (/d/<case number>/review) → the document → "⊘ Doesn't apply" → box "Mark as Not Applicable" → "⊘ Mark Not Applicable", or "↩ Applies again"
steps.access: Staff signed in with Monday only (your name is recorded). The buttons are not shown with the shared admin key alone.

options.label: Review Notes (when reopening is turned on)
options.does: On a Reviewed, Received or Under Review document the app changes the status to Rework Required and runs the full rework chain (count, escalation, one client email).

options.label: Review Notes (when reopening is turned off)
options.does: The client is emailed the note and the case is escalated, but the status stays as it is — on a Reviewed document the client then has no upload button.

next: The client email goes in the next 2-minute batch, together with any other reworks on the case.
steps.client_sees: Email "Action Required: N item(s) need(s) your attention — Case <case number>" with the note.
watch_out: Prefer "⟲ Request Rework" in the app: it always sets the document to Rework Required so the client can upload a new copy, whatever the setting.
A note on a Not Applicable document never emails the client.
If the status could not be changed, the app posts "⚠️ Could not reopen this document for a new copy" — then press Request Rework on the review page.
Saving the same note again on a document already in Rework Required does not email again (when reopening is turned on).
steps.setting_note: What happens depends on whether "a Review Note reopens the document" is turned on.
steps.title: Type a Review Note on a document directly in Monday
steps.summary: Writing in the Review Notes column of a document on the Document Checklist Execution board also emails the client.
steps.where: Monday → Document Checklist Execution board → the document → Review Notes column
steps.access: Anyone with Monday access to the board.

before: The case has a Case Reference and the correct Case Sub Type.
The case type has an automatic checklist (older template-built case types are not supported).

options.label: Run
options.does: Starts the re-seed. The column then reads "Done ✓" or "Failed ⚠".

next: A note "✅ Checklist re-seed complete" on the case (members found, new rows added, rows left untouched, rows that failed; rows moved over from an old Sub Type keep their uploads; empty rows of another Sub Type are removed), or "⚠ Re-seed failed: …".
Documents from an old Sub Type that need a check are listed in a separate "Checklist moved" note.
No email and no stage change.
steps.client_sees: New documents appear in the client's upload list.
watch_out: "No code schema registered…" means the Sub Type is blank or wrong, or the case type uses the old template checklist that re-seed cannot handle.
"this case has no Case Reference Number yet" means set the Primary Case Type first.
The app has no button for this on the case page; adding a family member from the case page already adds their documents.
steps.title: Add missing document rows (Re-seed Checklist in Monday)
steps.summary: Adds any document rows the case is missing — for example after a family member was added on the Family Members board, or after the Case Sub Type was set or changed. It keeps rows of the current Sub Type as they are. After a Sub Type change it moves the old Sub Type's rows over (uploads kept), and deletes old-Sub Type rows that are still empty.
steps.where: Monday → Cases board (called 'Client Master' in Monday) → the case → "Re-seed Checklist" column → set to Run
steps.access: Anyone with Monday access to the Cases board.

options.label: Show questionnaire ▾ / Hide questionnaire ▴
options.does: Shows or hides the questionnaire review page inside the case page. It is the same page as "Open full page →", with the 🚩 Flag buttons and "Send Correction Request" — it is not read-only.

options.label: Open full page →
options.does: Opens the questionnaire review page in a new tab — the page where you can mark answers for correction.

options.label: Export PDF
options.does: Downloads one PDF of every saved form of the case, with staff notes printed beside the answers.

options.label: Copy client link
options.does: Copies the client's own questionnaire link; shows "✓ Copied".

options.label: Member list
options.does: Each section with "submitted <date>" and Submitted / In progress / Not started. "No questionnaire members yet — they appear once the case checklist is provisioned." before then.

watch_out: The copied link lets anyone who has it open and change the client's answers — send it only to the client.

If the client has typed nothing yet, the view shows a calm notice headed "Nothing to review yet": "No answers have been saved for this questionnaire yet, so there is nothing to review." It then points you to "🏠 Client portal" at the top of the case page → "Resend portal access email" in the Client access box (needs a Monday sign-in) if the client says they never got their link. This is not an access problem.

PNP cases (AAIP, OINP, NSNP, BCPNP, RCIP, Manitoba PNP, RNIP, SNIP), Federal PR, and Canadian Experience Class cases with profile + ITA + submission have TWO questionnaire forms. 'Open full page →' and 'Show questionnaire' show only the FIRST. See 'Review the second questionnaire form'.

'No answers yet' / 'The client has opened the questionnaire, but no answers have been saved yet. Please ask them to complete and submit it before reviewing.' means the client has not started; it is not a fault. Export PDF: 'Nothing to export yet' / 'No saved answers were found for this form, so there is nothing to export.' (nothing saved yet) or 'Our document system is temporarily unavailable — please try again in a few minutes.' (a short outage; try later).

Other pages you may see: 'Case not found.' (wrong case number), 'Form file not found for this case type.' (the case type has no questionnaire form set up — tell an admin), 'An error occurred loading the review page.' (try again).
steps.title: Look at the client's questionnaire from the case page
steps.summary: See each member's section status, read the answers, download a PDF, or copy the client's questionnaire link.
steps.where: Case page → Questionnaire tab → "📝 Questionnaire"
steps.access: Anyone who can open the case.

before: The client has saved some answers.

You are signed in with Monday ('Sign in with Monday'), then reloaded the review page. With the team key alone the flag is NOT saved, even though the button turns to 'Flagged' (an error line and pop-up say so).

options.label: 🚩 Flag
options.does: Opens a note box: "Write a note for the client about this field...".

options.label: Save Flag
options.does: Saves the note; the button turns "🚩 Flagged" and the count in the top bar goes up.

options.label: Remove Flag
options.does: Asks "Remove this flag?", then deletes it.

options.label: Cancel
options.does: Closes the note box.

next: Notes are saved in the case's OneDrive Questionnaire folder. Nothing is emailed until "Send Correction Request".
steps.client_sees: When the client opens the form, the marked answers show "💬 Consultant note:" with a "↩️ Reply to consultant" button.
watch_out: Answers shown as "Not recorded — ask the client to re-confirm" are Yes/No questions the old form never saved (forms before 2026-09-09). Ask the client to answer them again.
The client can see a saved note the next time they open their questionnaire, even before you press "Send Correction Request". Write every note as if the client will read it.

If the bar shows '⚠ Flag save failed — please re-login and try again' or a pop-up says 'Could not save flag to server: …', the flag was NOT saved, even though the button reads 'Flagged'. 'Send Correction Request' then fails with 'Failed to send: …'. Sign in with Monday, reload, and flag again.

The answer boxes are read-only: staff cannot type a correction, only flag it for the client. A section with nothing filled in shows '(no data submitted)'. Saving an empty note is refused: 'Please write a note before saving.'

Some case types have a questionnaire with no separate family sections (for example Inland / Outland Spousal Sponsorship, Refugee WP, TRV, USA Visa, OCI / Passport Surrender, Visitor Visa 'Change of Status', and the OINP Workforce Priority Stream sub types). On those, when the Family list has at most one person, a different review page opens, headed '📋 Questionnaire Review — <client name>'. There a saved note shows '✏️ Edit' and '✕ Remove' under the answer, the note box is headed '🚩 Flag for Correction' ('Write a note for the client explaining what needs to be corrected…'), the send button reads '📧 Send Correction Request (N)', and there is no '⬇ Export PDF' button (use 'Export PDF' on the case page). The same page opens when you open one family member's form on its own. (Spousal Sponsorship always opens this page: both spouses share one form.)
Every section is folded up except the first. Click a section heading (small ▶ arrow) to open it, and again to close it. Flags inside a closed section are not visible until you open it.

The dark top bar shows 'N flags' and 'Reviewing as <name>'. Check the name before flagging — with the shared team key alone it reads 'Reviewing as TDOT Staff' and the flags are not saved (the page asks for the Monday sign-in).
steps.title: Mark a questionnaire answer for correction (🚩 Flag)
steps.summary: On the questionnaire review page, put a note on any answer the client must fix. Nothing is emailed until you send the correction request.
steps.where: Case page → Questionnaire tab → "Open full page →" → questionnaire review page (/q/<case number>/review) → the answer → "🚩 Flag" → note → "Save Flag"
steps.access: Viewing: Monday sign-in or the admin key. Saving: Monday sign-in.

before: At least one answer is marked ("Flag at least one field before sending." otherwise).

options.label: Send Correction Request (N)
options.does: Asks "Send a correction request email to the client? N flags will be included." → sends one email. Family cases: ONE email with a section per member. Shows "✓ Email sent".

options.label: ⬇ Export PDF
options.does: A PDF of this form (or of the whole case on a family review).

next: A note "📋 Correction Request Sent" listing every marked answer is posted on the case in Monday.
steps.client_sees: Email "Action Required — Please Update Your Questionnaire (<case number>)" with every marked answer, your notes and a link back to the form. Family cases always get this one email, with a section for each member. The member's name is added before the case number only when one other member's form is reviewed on its own.
watch_out: Every send includes ALL notes still saved, including old ones — remove the notes that are fixed before sending again.
Client replies are saved on the note and shown as "✉️ Client reply:" on the review page. The app does not notify staff when a client replies — check the page.
Sending does not change Q Completion Status or the stage.

On the single-applicant review page (case types without family sections) the top bar reads '📋 Questionnaire Review — <client name>' and the button '📧 Send Correction Request (N)'; that page has no '⬇ Export PDF' button. If the app answers 'No flags to send — flag at least one field first.', a flag that looked saved was not — flag again.
steps.title: Email the client a questionnaire correction request
steps.summary: Sends the client every marked answer with your notes and a link back to their form.
steps.where: Questionnaire review page (/q/<case number>/review) → top bar "🔍 Questionnaire Review — <case number>" → "Send Correction Request (N)"
steps.access: Staff signed in with Monday.

options.label: 🎥 Join meeting · 📄 Pre-consult dossier · 📼 Recording · 📝 Transcript
options.does: Links, shown when they were captured.

options.label: Open consultation view →
options.does: Opens the client's consultation record.

options.label: Timeline
options.does: Inquiry received, booking invite sent, consultation scheduled and held, agreements sent and signed, retainer sent and signed, payments, questionnaire submitted per member, and each document received. Times are Toronto time.

watch_out: Cases with no linked lead show "No linked lead record…" on Meetings and Payments.

Meetings shows 'Consultation slot <date> · <in person/virtual>', 'Consultation held <date>' or 'Not yet', 'Consultant <name>', and 'None captured yet — the recording and transcript appear after the meeting.' until a recording exists. Timeline shows 'No recorded events yet.' when nothing is dated.
steps.title: See the consultation meeting and the case timeline
steps.summary: Two read-only tabs: the consultation's links and recordings, and a dated list of everything recorded on the case.
steps.where: Case page → Meetings tab ("🎥 Consultation meeting") and Timeline tab ("🕓 Case timeline")
steps.access: Anyone who can open the case.

options.label: Write an update… (posts to this item's Monday thread)
options.does: The text of your update (up to 4,000 characters).

options.label: Your name
options.does: Shown as [Your name] on the update — the update itself is posted by the app's Monday account.

options.label: Post update
options.does: Posts it to the case's Monday thread.

watch_out: Staff signed in only with Monday see "Updates need the admin key (enter it on the sign-in page)." and "Posting needs the admin key (enter it on the sign-in page)."

When the thread mixes notes from the lead and from the case, each entry is tagged 'Lead' or 'Case' (where it was posted). Messages: 'No updates yet — the thread starts with the first note.', 'Write something first.', 'Posted.', 'Could not load updates — refresh to retry.', 'Network error — not posted.', 'No Monday item to post to.'
steps.title: Read or post Monday updates on the case
steps.summary: The same Updates thread Monday shows (the case plus its earlier lead entries), newest first, with a box to post a new update.
steps.where: Case page → Updates tab → "💬 Updates" → "Write an update…" + "Your name" → "Post update"
steps.access: Needs the admin key entered in this browser.

before: The portal email (or a re-sent one).

options.label: Case opened · Your questionnaire & documents · We prepare your application · Application submitted · Decision
options.does: The five-step progress bar. The current step follows the Case Stage (for example Document Collection Started = step 2; Internal Review, Submission Preparation, Submission Ready and Stuck = step 3; Submitted / Application Submitted = step 4; Approved, Refused, Closed, Withdrawn, Cancelled, Archived = Decision).

options.label: 📌 What's pending
options.does: For example "📂 N document(s) need(s) re-upload (rework requested)", "📝 Questionnaire is N% complete — please finish remaining fields", "📝 Your questionnaire is filled in — please open it and click Submit", "👥 N family member(s) still need(s) their questionnaire submitted", or "✅ Nothing pending right now — your case officer will be in touch."

options.label: Start Questionnaire → / Continue Filling → / Review Your Answers →
options.does: Opens the questionnaire. The badge shows Not Started / In Progress / Submitted and the % complete.

options.label: 📂 Documents
options.does: The checklist by category, with a person tag (for example Principal Applicant, Spouse, Sponsor) when more than one person is involved, and the % uploaded.

options.label: Upload / Add more files / Upload new copy
options.does: Uploads one or more files to that document. The button reads "Upload" when the document is missing, "Add more files" when it was already received, and "Upload new copy" when a new copy was asked for.

options.label: Open it here
options.does: Opens the full documents page with detailed instructions.

options.label: 💳 Payments
options.does: Only when a payment schedule exists: each milestone with "✓ Paid", "Part-paid", "Due now" or "Not due yet", amounts with HST, and how to pay by e-Transfer with the reference.

options.label: 🕓 Your case journey
options.does: The case history in plain words, for example "We received your inquiry", "Retainer signed — your case opened", "We received your document: <name>".

next: Opening the page changes nothing.
steps.client_sees: The portal page.
watch_out: A wrong or missing access code shows "🔒 Access denied" and asks the client to use the most recent link from their case officer. A system problem shows "⚠️ Could not load this case".
The access code never changes — every earlier portal email keeps working.
Before the checklist is built the Documents card says "No documents have been requested yet — your checklist appears here as soon as your case officer prepares it."
Not Applicable documents read "Not needed for your application — confirmed by your case officer" and are not counted; optional documents count only once uploaded.
A Reviewed document can no longer be uploaded to.
steps.title: Client opens the Client Portal
steps.summary: One page that shows where the case is, what is pending, the questionnaire, the document checklist with upload buttons, payments and the case history.
steps.where: Client Portal (/client/<case number>?t=<access code>) — the link in the "case is ready" email or a re-sent portal email
steps.access: The client, through the link with its access code. Staff who open the same page while signed in see a staff version.

before: The checklist has been built for the case.
The document is not Reviewed and not Not Applicable (those have no upload button).

options.label: (file types)
options.does: PDF, DOC, DOCX, JPG, JPEG, PNG, HEIC, WEBP, XLSX, XLS, CSV, ZIP. Others are refused: "File type ".xyz" is not allowed."

options.label: Size
options.does: Up to 50 MB per file. Bigger files are refused with: "That file is over 50 MB. Please split it into smaller files, or scan it at a lower quality, and try again."

options.label: (several files)
options.does: Allowed; sent one at a time; the message names any file that failed ("All N files uploaded ✓" when all worked).

options.label: ↩️ Reply to case officer
options.does: On the full documents page, under a review note: the client types a reply; it is posted as "✉️ Client Reply" on that document in Monday and shown to staff on the review page.

options.label: I have read and understood the above disclaimer → I Understand
options.does: Full documents page: must be ticked to close the "Document Submission Guidelines" box before uploading.

options.label: ✅ Done
options.does: Full documents page, last step: shows "Documents Submitted!". It does not change anything in the system.

next: The document becomes Received, Last Upload Date = today, Review Required = Yes; a "📄 Document Uploaded by Client" note on the document (and the case) names the stored file.

Monday notification "📄 Document received: "<document>" | Client: … | Category: … | Folder: …" to the document's assigned reviewer and the case's Case Manager, Ops Supervisor, Case Support Officer, Stage Owner and Submission Team.
The case's Last Activity Date and document % are updated.
With unique file names turned on, every copy is kept as a new file ("<Document> – <Member> – <date time> – <client file name>"). With it turned off, a same-name upload replaces the earlier file.
steps.client_sees: "Uploaded ✓" / "✓ Received" and the page refreshes. If the file saved but the checklist could not be updated: "Your file was saved… Please do not upload it again." (the app retries marking it after 1, 5 and 15 minutes).
watch_out: An upload after a rework changes Rework Required back to Received. The old review note stays on the document as the yardstick for the new copy.

When the app is busy with many uploads at once, the client sees "Several uploads are in progress right now. Please try again in a minute."; the portal retries by itself every 15 seconds (up to 8 times).
The portal allows 60 uploads per connection per 15 minutes ("Too many uploads from this connection — please wait a few minutes and try again.").
Uploads to a Not Applicable document are refused: "Your case officer confirmed this document is not needed for your application. If you believe it applies, please contact them."
The full documents page does not check an access code — anyone with the case number can open it.

The page is split into steps (one per family member, or one per document category) with '← Back' / 'Next →' at the bottom and '✅ Done' on the last step. A yellow banner 'N document(s) require(s) re-upload.' has a 'Review Now →' button that jumps to the first document sent back. On two-stage case types the documents sit under a phase heading ('📋 Profile Creation' / '📁 <phase>').
steps.setting_note: Whether every upload is kept as its own file depends on the "unique file names" setting.
steps.title: Client uploads documents (or a new copy)
steps.summary: Each file goes into the client's OneDrive case folder and the document is marked Received for staff to review.
steps.where: Client Portal → "📂 Documents" → "Upload" / "Add more files" / "Upload new copy"; or the full documents page (/documents/<case number>) → "⬆ Upload" / "🔄 Re-upload"
steps.access: The client. The portal needs the access code; the full documents page only needs the case number.

before: The portal email. The case type has a questionnaire (otherwise the page says "Your Questionnaire Is Being Prepared").

options.label: 💾 Save Progress
options.does: Saves now ("✓ Saved at <time>"). If fields are still empty, the client may get the "Information Still Needed" email (at most once per 24 hours).

options.label: Autosave
options.does: Every 60 seconds, only when something changed. A copy is also kept in the browser.

options.label: ✅ Submit Questionnaire
options.does: Locked with "🔒 Submit unlocks at 80% (currently N%)" until 80%. Then asks to confirm and shows "Questionnaire Submitted".

options.label: + Add Family Member
options.does: Adds a member the case type allows (for example Spouse, Dependent Child, Parent, Sibling, Sponsor). This also adds their row on the Family Members board and their documents.

options.label: ✕ (remove member)
options.does: Asks "Remove <name>? Any unsaved answers will be lost." Not possible for the Primary Applicant or a member who already submitted.

options.label: (form tabs) / ← All Forms
options.does: Cases with more than one form show each as a tab.

options.label: 💬 Consultant note / ↩️ Reply to consultant → Send Reply
options.does: Answers marked by staff show the note; the client can reply.

next: Each save updates the case in Monday: Q Readiness % (how complete the questionnaire is) and Q Completion Status "Working on it". A save the client presses shows within a couple of seconds; automatic saves are sent at most once every 5 minutes. The app also keeps one up-to-date draft PDF of each form in OneDrive.

Submit: Q Completion Status becomes "Done" once every member has submitted (until then it stays "Working on it"). A note "📋 Questionnaire Submitted" with a staff review link is posted on the case, and a submission PDF is saved. Then the app checks whether the case can move to Internal Review.
steps.client_sees: Progress in the toolbar and save / submit messages; a blue banner "Some answers were pre-filled from your earlier forms." when answers were pre-filled; email "Information Still Needed for Your Case — <case number>" when fields are still empty (on Submit always, on a manual save at most once per 24 hours).
watch_out: Below 80% the app refuses: "Submission requires at least 80% completion…".
Family cases: the 80% is the average over all members, weighted by number of fields.
A higher Q Readiness % alone never moves the stage — the questionnaire must also be submitted (Q Completion Status = Done).
If saved answers could not be loaded, saving and submitting pause with a message; the work stays in the browser — refresh in a few minutes.
A wrong code shows "Access Denied"; a storage outage shows "Our document system is temporarily unavailable. Nothing is wrong with your link…".
On a Super Visa the second member is shown as "Second parent".
Removing a member with ✕ only takes away their questionnaire section. Their Family Members row and their documents stay on the case — staff must tidy those up.
steps.title: Client fills in, saves and submits the questionnaire
steps.summary: The questionnaire for the case type, with a section for each family member where the case allows. Work is saved automatically; Submit unlocks at 80% complete (across all members).
steps.where: Questionnaire (/q/<case number>?t=<access code>, from the portal) → toolbar "💾 Save Progress" and "✅ Submit Questionnaire"
steps.access: The client, through the link with its access code.

before: Case Stage is exactly "Document Collection Started" and Automation Lock is not Yes.
Q Completion Status = Done (every member submitted).
Q Readiness and Documents Readiness % (the share marked Reviewed) are both at or above the case type's minimum on the SLA Config board (80% when none is set).
No blocking documents left.

options.label: Case Stage → Internal Review (by hand in Monday)
options.does: Allowed. Stage Start Date resets to today, Chasing Stage = Resolved, Reminder Count = 0.

next: Automatic move writes Case Stage = Internal Review, Stage Start Date = today, Ready for Review = Done, Doc Threshold Met = Yes, Chasing Stage = Resolved.
Note "📋 Case Ready for Internal Review" asking the Ops Supervisor to assign the Case Manager / reviewer.
Email "Internal Review — Please Assign Reviewer — <case number>" to the Ops Supervisor and Case Manager.
The check runs when the client submits the questionnaire, whenever a document's status changes or a file is uploaded, and in the overnight run.
watch_out: Uploaded is not enough — documents must be marked Reviewed for Documents Readiness % to rise.

Sometimes everything is done (questionnaire submitted at 100%, every document reviewed) but the last thing that happened was a document review, not the questionnaire submit. In that case the app does not move the case. Move it by hand.
The email goes only to the people already in Ops Supervisor and Case Manager. If both are empty, nobody is emailed — there is only the note on the case.
steps.title: Get a case to Internal Review
steps.summary: The app moves a case from Document Collection Started to Internal Review by itself once the questionnaire is submitted and enough documents are marked Reviewed. You can also move it by hand in Monday.
steps.where: Automatic; or Monday → Client Master board → the case → Case Stage = Internal Review
steps.access: Automatic, or anyone with Monday access.

before: The case is at Internal Review.

options.label: Case Manager · Case Support Officer · Ops Supervisor · Stage Owner · Submission Team
options.does: Any change to one of these columns sends every person then in it (people, not teams) a Monday notification "You have been assigned as <role> for case: …" — people already there are notified again.

watch_out: If the app is set to show staff only their assigned cases, these people columns also decide who can open the case pages.
steps.title: Assign the reviewer for Internal Review
steps.summary: When a case reaches Internal Review, the Ops Supervisor assigns the Case Manager / reviewer in Monday.
steps.where: Monday → Client Master board → the case → Case Manager (and the other people columns)
steps.access: Anyone with Monday access.

before: Case Stage is Internal Review; Q Completion Status = Done; Q Readiness 100%; Documents Readiness % 100%; no blocking documents.

options.label: Case Stage → Submission Preparation (by hand in Monday)
options.does: Stage Start Date resets to today, Chasing Stage = Resolved, Reminder Count = 0.

next: Automatic move writes Case Stage = Submission Preparation, Stage Start Date = today, Ready for Sub Prep = Done.
Note "✅ Case Ready for Submission Preparation" asking the Ops Supervisor to assign the Submission Team.
Email "Submission Prep — Please Assign Submission Team — <case number>" to the Ops Supervisor and Case Manager.
watch_out: A questionnaire submitted below 100% moves on by itself once the client fills the rest (checked after reviews and overnight). While it stays below 100%, set the stage by hand.
The move does not wait for the internal reviewer: at 100% the case moves to Submission Preparation even if the review is still going on.
steps.title: Move a case to Submission Preparation
steps.summary: The app moves Internal Review to Submission Preparation only at 100% (questionnaire and reviewed documents) with nothing blocking. Otherwise you move it by hand in Monday.
steps.where: Automatic; or Monday → Client Master board → the case → Case Stage = Submission Preparation
steps.access: Automatic, or anyone with Monday access.

before: The Submission Team (or Case Manager) is assigned — otherwise nobody is emailed.

options.label: Submission Ready
options.does: Sets Automation Lock = Yes.

next: Note "🔒 Case Locked — Submission Ready" on the case.
Email "Submission Ready — Filing Can Begin — <case number>" to the Submission Team and Case Manager, asking them to file with IRCC and then set Case Stage to Submitted.
watch_out: Once Automation Lock is Yes, the app's daily checks skip the case and its readiness numbers stop updating.
steps.title: Mark the case Submission Ready (locks the case)
steps.summary: When the file is ready to be filed, the supervisor sets Submission Ready by hand. The app locks the case and tells the Submission Team.
steps.where: Monday → Cases board (called 'Client Master' in Monday) → the case → Case Stage = Submission Ready
steps.access: Anyone with Monday access (the app's email calls this the case supervisor's step).

options.label: Submitted · Approved · Refused · Closed · Withdrawn · Cancelled · Archived
options.does: End stages: Automation Lock = Yes, Chasing Stage = Resolved, Escalation Required = No and its reason cleared; note "🔒 Case <stage>" on the case.

options.label: Application Submitted (also LMIA Submitted, ADR, Reconsideration)
options.does: Labels on the board that are NOT end stages for the app — setting them does not lock the case. (A case that went through Submission Ready is already locked and stays locked.) On an unlocked case the document numbers keep being recounted; reminders, health and escalation checks skip it.

steps.client_sees: The portal progress bar moves: Submitted / Application Submitted = "Application submitted"; Approved shows "Approved 🎉"; Refused shows "Decision received"; Closed, Withdrawn, Cancelled, Archived show "Case closed" / "Case withdrawn" / "Case cancelled" / "Case archived". LMIA Submitted, ADR and Reconsideration are not known to the portal: the client sees "We prepare your application".
watch_out: The Submission Ready email tells the team to set "Submitted". Many board rows use "Application Submitted", which does not lock the case — only "Submitted" does.
steps.title: Record filing, the decision, or closing the case
steps.summary: After filing, and again when the decision comes, set the Case Stage by hand in Monday. The end stages lock the case.
steps.where: Monday → Client Master board → the case → Case Stage
steps.access: Anyone with Monday access.

options.label: 1-Coordinator-Working
options.does: Staff working space; the client never sees it.

options.label: 2-Case-Manager-Draft
options.does: Staff working space; the client never sees it.

options.label: 3-AW-Analyst-Final-RCIC
options.does: Staff working space; the client never sees it.

options.label: 4-Submitted-IRCC
options.does: Staff working space; the client never sees it.

watch_out: Leave client uploads in their category folders: the review page's "Open in OneDrive", the upload notes and the re-filing tools all point at those files.
Cases whose folder was made before 30 September 2026 only have these folders if they were added later.
steps.title: Use the four staff working folders in OneDrive
steps.summary: Every new case folder has four staff-only folders, numbered in the order of the submission work. The app never puts client uploads or its own files there.
steps.where: Case page → "📁 OneDrive" → case folder → 1-Coordinator-Working · 2-Case-Manager-Draft · 3-AW-Analyst-Final-RCIC · 4-Submitted-IRCC
steps.access: Staff with OneDrive access.

options.label: Case Stage → Document Collection Started / Internal Review / … (set back by hand in Monday)
options.does: The automatic moves only start from Document Collection Started or Internal Review.

watch_out: A locked case in Stuck is still handled by escalation routing.

Setting the stage back to Document Collection Started on a paid case emails the client the "Action Required — Your case is ready" email again, every time. Only set it back to Document Collection Started when the client should get that email again.

Moving a case back to an earlier stage does not unlock it. If Automation Lock is Yes (set at Submission Ready, at an end stage, or by an escalation rule), the readiness numbers and automatic stage moves stay switched off. They come back only when someone sets Automation Lock to No in Monday.
steps.title: Deal with a case in "Stuck"
steps.summary: Stuck still counts as an active stage: the app keeps updating its readiness numbers, deadlines, health and escalations. But the readiness checks never move a case out of Stuck by themselves. The only automatic way out is an escalation rule (on the Escalation Routing Matrix board) written for Stuck cases that sets a new case status.
steps.where: Monday → Client Master board → the case → Case Stage (set to Stuck by hand, or by an Escalation Routing Matrix rule that changes the case status)
steps.access: Anyone with Monday access; or the app's daily escalation check.

Anyone who has the shared team key. The key opens every staff page and shows every case. It does not count as an admin for deleting, undoing payments or the Engine Controls run buttons — those need a named admin signed in with Monday. The document review page and the client documents page always need the Monday sign-in too.
before: You have the shared team key from management.

options.label: Admin API Key
options.does: Type the shared team key here (it is hidden as you type).

options.label: Sign In →
options.does: Checks the key and the Monday connection. On success it shows "✓ Success! Redirecting…" and opens the Consultations page. Pressing Enter does the same.

next: The key is kept in this browser tab only. A new tab or window, or closing the browser, asks for it again.
If you are already signed in, opening /admin takes you straight to the Consultations page.
watch_out: Empty box: "Please enter your admin API key."
Wrong key: "Invalid API key. Please check and try again." (or "Invalid or missing API key").
Monday not reachable: "Monday.com API is not reachable. Try again shortly."
The team key does not say who you are. Actions that record a name (for example Mark paid, Not applicable, undoing a payment) also need "Sign in with Monday", or ask you to type your name.
steps.setting_note: If the server has no team key set up, sign-in is refused with "API key not configured on server".
steps.title: Sign in to the staff pages with the team key
steps.summary: Every staff page opens with the shared team key. Type it once on the sign-in page; this browser tab then remembers it until the tab is closed.
steps.where: Sign-in page (/admin) → box "Admin API Key" → "Sign In →"

steps.access: Staff whose Monday email is on an allowed company domain (tdotimm.com unless set otherwise).
before: You have a Monday.com account with your company email address.

options.label: Sign in with Monday
options.does: Sends you to Monday.com to approve, then back to the page you came from (the Cases page if there was none).

next: The app remembers your Monday sign-in for 8 hours, then asks again.
Your Monday account and teams decide which cases you can open when the firm limits staff to their assigned cases.
watch_out: Email on another domain: "Access is restricted to: tdotimm.com accounts." (or the domains set up).
Cancelled on Monday: "Monday login was cancelled or denied. Please try again."
If you see "Invalid login state — please try again.", start the sign-in again from the app.
"Sign Out" in the top bar does NOT end your Monday sign-in; there is no Monday sign-out button.

The Cases and Summary pages still need the team key in this browser tab: without it they send you to the sign-in page, even if you signed in with Monday. The case page works with a Monday sign-in alone.

'Login failed — could not exchange code for token. Please try again.', 'Login failed — could not verify your Monday identity.' or 'Could not retrieve your Monday account details.': start the sign-in again. If it keeps failing, tell an admin.
steps.setting_note: Which email domains may use this sign-in is a setting (default tdotimm.com). If Monday sign-in is not set up in the app's settings you see a "Monday OAuth Not Configured" page.
steps.title: Sign in with Monday (so the app knows your name)
steps.summary: A second sign-in, with your own Monday.com account. Needed for actions that must carry your name, and the only way to be recognised as a named admin.
steps.where: Any "Sign in with Monday" link (case page, payment dialogs, the Cases/Summary sign-in box) → Monday.com → back to the page you were on. Direct address: /q/auth/monday

steps.access: All signed-in staff
before: Signed in.

options.label: 📥 Leads
options.does: Opens the Leads page (/admin/leads).

options.label: 🗓️ Consultations
options.does: Opens the Consultations page (/admin/consultations): consultations, retainers & follow-ups, reporting.

options.label: 🗂️ Cases
options.does: Opens the Cases page (/admin/dashboard). Stays highlighted while you are on a single case page.

options.label: 📊 Summary
options.does: Opens the Summary page (/admin/dashboard/summary): the Needs attention list, figures and charts.

options.label: (status light: Checking… / Online / Monday API Offline)
options.does: Shows "Checking…", then "Online" when Monday answers, or "Monday API Offline".

options.label: Sign Out
options.does: Removes the team key from this tab and goes back to the sign-in page.

options.label: 📘 Guide
options.does: Opens the staff guide page 'How TDOT works' (this guide). Its tooltip reads 'Staff guide: how TDOT works'. It only shows the guide once you are signed in.

watch_out: If the light says "Monday API Offline", pages may not load or may be out of date — wait and refresh.
On a phone the page names are hidden (icons only).
The Engine Controls page is not in this bar; it is opened only by typing its address (/admin/engines).
steps.title: Move between the main staff pages
steps.summary: Every staff page has the same dark top bar: five page buttons, a Monday connection light, a clock and Sign Out.
steps.where: Top bar on every staff page

steps.access: Team key holders and Monday users on the admin list always see everything.

options.label: (normal setting: every signed-in staff member sees all cases)
options.does: Any signed-in staff member can open any case (team decision 2026-09-04).

options.label: (if switched on: assigned cases only)
options.does: You see a case only when you or your team are in Stage Owner, Ops Supervisor, Case Support Officer, Case Manager, Submission Team, Retained by, or Override Approved By.

next: When limited, the Cases page header reads "👤 Your assigned cases (N) — <your name>"; otherwise "🗂️ All cases".
A case you may not open shows: "You are not assigned to this case, so you cannot view it. Ask an owner or the assigned case manager for access."
watch_out: Seeing a case lets you read it. Deleting a case, repairing or restoring a client's saved answers, the payment status check and the OneDrive tools always need an admin.
The shared team key sees every case, but it cannot delete records or run the overnight checks by hand — those need a named admin.

Undoing a payment and "Correct amount" need a NAMED admin: signed in with Monday AND on the admin list. With the team key alone you get "Sign in with Monday to change a payment record — the shared admin key doesn't say who you are." Others get "Only admins can change a payment record. Use “Flag as wrong” to alert them."
If Monday cannot be read, a non-admin sees "Case data is temporarily unavailable. Please reload in a moment." instead of a refusal.
steps.setting_note: Whether staff see all cases or only their assigned cases is a setting; it is "all cases" unless changed. Who counts as a named admin is set by a list of admin emails.
steps.title: Know who can see which cases
steps.summary: Normally every signed-in staff member can open every case. The firm can switch this to "assigned only". Then, when you sign in with Monday, you see only the cases where you (or a team you belong to) are named in one of the seven people columns on the Cases board: Stage Owner, Ops Supervisor, Case Support Officer, Case Manager, Submission Team, Retained by, Override Approved By.
steps.where: Applies to the Cases page, Summary page, Needs attention list, case page (/admin/case/<case number>), the document and questionnaire review pages, the staff view of the client portal and the client documents page (/documents/<case number>?staff=1)

steps.access: Anyone signed in with the team key. Everyone sees the same list (no per-person filter on this page).
before: Signed in with the team key.

options.label: Leads

options.label: Consultations

next: The tab you chose is remembered in this browser and kept in the page address, so a shared link opens the same tab.

If the header says "Monday could not be read — showing the last copy", the list is out of date; do not act on it as current.
A lead shows on exactly one of Leads / Consultations / Retainers & follow-ups, or on none once it is Retained (the case is then on the Cases page).
If the lists cannot be read the page shows a red 'Failed to load: <reason>' box. If the team key is missing or wrong, the page sends you to the sign-in page (/admin).

before: Fill in "Your name" — it is shown as [Name] on the update.

options.label: Your name
options.does: Shown as [Name] at the start of the update.

It does not check that the case is paid. It posts the note 'Intake email sent ("Your case is ready") from the admin tools to <hidden email>'. It is refused with 'This case has no client email on the Client Master row.', 'This case has no case reference yet.' or 'No access token could be created for this case.' (the last one means the app could not make the client's secure portal link — tell an admin). To just resend the link, use 'Resend portal access email →' on the client portal page instead.
