options.does: Shows only these leads. They have no Tier and no AI triage notes.

options.label: Existing file update (amber tag next to the name in the Lead column)
options.does: Shown when the person chose 'Existing file update' as what they want to do: another sign they want news about their file, not a consultation.

options.label: 🗂️ Cases → search by the client's name
options.does: Find their open case and who manages it. If the page says 'Your assigned cases' you only see your own cases: if theirs is not listed, ask an admin or the case manager.

options.label: Case page → Updates tab → Post update
options.does: Post the client's request on their case so the case team sees it.

next: Nothing happens by itself: no note goes on the case and nobody on the case team is alerted.
steps.client_sees: The website thank-you page tells them their request is 'being routed directly to your case team — they'll be in touch shortly'.
watch_out: Do not send a booking invite. It asks the client to pay for a consultation.
The client was promised a reply from their case team. Pass it on the same day and tell the case manager.
Post a remark on the lead saying who you passed it to, so the rest of the team knows it is handled.
If they reported a removal order or an enforcement letter, the app also posts an urgent '🚨 CRITICAL LEAD' note on the lead. Pass it on at once.

steps.title: The client did not get the booking invite
steps.summary: Work through these checks in order before you send anything again.
steps.where: Leads page → columns 'Invite' and 'Current status'; lead page → cards 'Basic details' and 'Booking invite email'
steps.access: All staff

options.label: 1. Invite column / Current status
options.does: '—' or 'Invite failed' means it did not go out: fix the cause and send it. 'Sent <date>' means the app sent it that day. It does not prove it reached the inbox.

options.label: 2. Email (card 'Basic details')
options.does: Check the spelling. If you correct it, press 'Save details' and send the invite again. Reminders only go to the address the invite went to.

options.label: 3. Ask the client to look in junk / spam
options.does: The subject is 'Book your consultation with TDOT Immigration'.

options.label: 4. Send booking invite (again)
options.does: Emails the same personal link again. The card shows when it was last sent.

options.label: 5. Already booked?
options.does: No invite is needed. Use 'Resend links' on the consultation record (or 'Resend meeting + pre-consult links' on the lead page) to resend the meeting and pre-consultation links.

next: Each send posts '📧 Booking invite emailed to <email> on <date>.' on the lead.
watch_out: If you see 'Booking invite email WAS DELIVERED … Do NOT resend.', don't send again. Set Booking Invite to 'Sent' in Monday instead.
If the client's fee is already recorded, don't send the invite: the link asks them to pay again.

steps.title: When a client did not finish booking online
steps.summary: If the client picked a time but did not pay before the hold ended, Booking Status becomes 'Abandoned' and Current status reads 'Booking not finished'. The old time stays on the lead, and that blocks some buttons.
steps.where: Leads page → Current status 'Booking not finished' → lead page → card 'Booking invite email'
steps.access: All staff

options.label: (the client's booking link)
options.does: The client can open the same link, pick a time again and pay. The consultant stays the same.

options.label: Consultation with (dropdown)
options.does: Refuses with 'Already booked — the consultation is on the assigned consultant's calendar. Cancel/rebook to change it.' This is misleading: nothing is booked. The old held time is still in Booked Slot.

options.label: → Convert to direct retainer
options.does: Hidden for this lead. The app would refuse: 'That lead has a consultation booked or held…'.

next: If the client pays an old payment link after the hold ran out, the app still books them and posts '💳 Paid after the slot hold had expired'. Confirm the time with them.
watch_out: To move the client to the other consultant, or to make them a direct retainer client, Booked Slot on the Lead Board in Monday must be empty first. Ask an admin if you are not sure.

steps.title: Handle a double consultation payment
steps.summary: The note '🚨 Possible DOUBLE PAYMENT on the consultation' means the client paid twice, or paid online after staff recorded the fee. The app never refunds anything, so a person must check and refund.
steps.where: Lead page or Consultation record → '💬 Updates' → the 🚨 note; then Square; then a remark on the lead
steps.access: All staff can read the note. Refunds are done in Square by someone who has refund access there.

options.label: 1. Check Square
options.does: See whether both payments really went through. If only one did, nothing needs refunding.

options.label: 2. Refund one payment in Square
options.does: Done by whoever has refund access in Square. The app does not refund.

options.label: 3. Consultation fee card (Consultation record)
options.does: Read only once the client has paid online: it shows 'Paid through the booking link', plus 'Also recorded by staff' when staff had recorded the fee too. There is no Remove record button, and the card does not change after a refund, so write the refund in the remark (next step).

options.label: 4. Post a remark on the lead
options.does: Say what was refunded, how and by whom, and tell the client.

watch_out: The app will not let you remove or change the staff record after an online payment ('Nothing to record here. A refund is done in Square.').
Who decides which payment to give back is a team decision; ask your manager if it is not clear.

steps.title: Change an outcome later
steps.summary: An outcome can be changed at any time, and the last click wins. Two cases need care: a client with another outcome who now wants to sign, and Not Wanted chosen by mistake.
steps.where: Consultation record → 'Record outcome' buttons (or Lead page → 'Outcome' buttons); Retainer plan → 'Retain & send agreement'; red 'On the Not Wanted list' banner → 'Remove from the list…'
steps.access: All staff for the outcome buttons. Only named admins (signed in with Monday and on the admin list) can use 'Remove from the list…'.

options.label: Follow-Up / Newsletter / Not Wanted (click a different one)
options.does: Replaces the outcome and posts 'Outcome set to “<outcome>” by <name>.'

options.label: Retain & send agreement (Retainer plan)
options.does: For a client who now wants to sign: replaces any earlier outcome with Retain and emails the agreement. There is no Retain button.

options.label: Remove from the list… (red Not Wanted banner)
options.does: The only way to take someone off the Not Wanted list. A named admin types the reason.

next: The team outcome email goes out on a real change (when it is set up).
watch_out: Not Wanted by mistake: change the outcome AND ask a named admin to remove the person from the list. A new outcome alone leaves the red warning, and booking reminders stay stopped.

If a Retainer Signed date was typed while the outcome was not Retain, 'Retain & send' refuses. Set the Outcome column to Retain on the Lead Board in Monday instead (see 'Typing a Retainer Signed date on the Lead Board').

steps.title: Check which milestones are due and request them
steps.summary: Only milestone 1 is requested automatically, at signing. Later milestones are never emailed by the app and nothing reminds anyone, so check open cases regularly and send each request when it falls due.
steps.where: Case page → Payments tab → '💳 Retainer & milestone payments'; or the client's consultation page → 'Milestone payments (e-Transfer)'
steps.access: All staff who can open the case

options.label: DUE (amber label on a row)
options.does: The case has reached or passed that milestone's Trigger stage and it is not paid. Send the request.

options.label: PENDING / REQUESTED / PART-PAID / PAID
options.does: Not requested yet / request emailed (with its reference) / some money in, balance shown / fully paid.

options.label: trigger: <stage>
options.does: Shown on each row of the case page: the case stage at which the milestone falls due.

options.label: Send e-Transfer request (case page) / Send e-transfer request (consultation page)
options.does: Emails the client the amount including HST, the e-Transfer address and the reference code. Shown on a due row that is not yet requested, and on milestone 1 as soon as the retainer is signed (even before the case starts). Never shown once the retainer is recorded as paid. An older row that never had e-Transfer details shows 'Send e-Transfer details' instead.

next: The row shows REQUESTED with the reference. Record the money with 'Record payment' when it arrives.
watch_out: A milestone saved with no Trigger ('— when due —') never shows DUE and never gets a request button. Ask the consultant to amend the plan and pick a Trigger.

Needs attention only lists part-paid milestones once the case is at Submission Preparation ('Balance owed before submission'). A due milestone that was never requested is not on any list: only the client's own pages show it (the DUE label on the Payments tab).

Before a retainer plan is saved the box reads 'Payment status appears here once the retainer plan is set…' (consultation record) or 'No milestones set yet.' / 'No milestone schedule yet — build the retainer plan on the consultation page first.' (case page).

The case page's Payments tab also shows a strip: 'Retainer $<fee>' or 'Retainer fee not set', 'Sent <date>', 'Signed <date>', 'Consult fee paid · Square'; the line 'Clients pay by Interac e-Transfer to <address> — the reference code ties each transfer to its milestone.'; and, in an outage, 'Payment details unavailable right now — reload to retry.'

steps.title: First checks on a new case
steps.summary: When a case starts (paid and at Document Collection Started), go through these checks once so nothing blocks the client.
steps.where: Case page (/admin/case/<case number>) → Overview, Documents and Payments tabs and the top buttons; Monday → Cases board for the Sub Type
steps.access: All staff who can open the case
before: The case is Paid and at Document Collection Started.

options.label: 1. Case Sub Type (Cases board in Monday)
options.does: Must be set from the list and match the client. OK when the Overview tab's '📑 Documents' list shows rows, not 'No checklist rows seeded yet.'

options.label: 2. 👪 Family on this case (Overview tab)
options.does: Everyone on the application is listed. If someone is missing, use '➕ Add family member' once.

options.label: 3. 🤝 Sponsor / inviter (Overview tab)
options.does: Where the case type has a sponsor. A grey 'Not emailed yet' label means the sponsor has not had their email: press 'Send sponsor link' yourself.

options.label: 4. 📁 OneDrive (top buttons)
options.does: OK when you see '📁 OneDrive'. If you see '📁 Case folder…' instead, the folder is missing: use that button.

options.label: 5. 'Your case is ready' email
options.does: If Summary → Needs attention lists '"Your case is ready" email not confirmed' for this case, open '🏠 Client portal' and press 'Resend portal access email →'.

options.label: 6. Payments tab
options.does: Milestone 1 is paid, and every later milestone has a trigger stage.

watch_out: Don't move the Case Stage back and forth to 'restart' things: every move into Document Collection Started emails the client again.

steps.title: Upload a file the client sent by email
steps.summary: Staff cannot upload from the case page, the document review page or the staff view of the portal. Use the client's documents page: the upload marks the document Received, as if the client had uploaded it.
steps.where: Type the address /documents/<case number>?staff=1 in the browser (no staff button links to it; it takes you through the Monday sign-in if needed) → the document → '⬆ Upload' (or '🔄 Re-upload')
steps.access: Staff signed in with Monday, or the client using their own emailed link (it carries their access code). With the team key alone the page asks you to sign in with Monday.
before: The case has a document checklist.
You have the file saved on your computer (up to 50 MB).

options.label: ⬆ Upload
options.does: On a document not uploaded yet: pick the file. The row becomes Received.

options.label: 🔄 Re-upload
options.does: On a document already uploaded or sent back for rework: adds the new file. The row becomes Received.

options.label: Case Reference Number → 'Access My Documents →' (on /documents)
options.does: The front page of the documents site: type the case number (copy it from the top of the case page) and press the button to open that case's upload page — the same as typing /documents/<case number>. A wrong number comes back with 'No documents found for case "<number>". Please check your case reference number.'

options.label: Step buttons across the top (one per family member, or one per document category)
options.does: The page is split into steps. Click a step button to jump to that person's or that category's documents; a family member's step shows a count of what is uploaded, and any step shows ⚠️ when something there needs re-upload. A document's upload buttons are only on its own step. '← Back' / 'Next →' move between steps ('✅ Done' on the last one).

next: The same notes as a client upload are posted ('📄 Document Uploaded by Client'), with a link to review it.
Then review it as usual and press '✓ Mark reviewed'.
watch_out: The note says 'Uploaded by Client' even though you uploaded it. Post your own update on the case saying you uploaded it and where it came from.
Never give this address to a client. Clients use their own emailed link, which carries their access code; without it the page only says to open the email.
Putting the file straight into OneDrive does NOT mark the document Received. The checklist never counts it.

Reviewed and Not Applicable documents have no upload button. First press '↺ Undo' on the document review page (for a Reviewed document) or '↩ Applies again' on the case page (for a Not Applicable one).
Don't type in the reply box on that page: it posts a 'Client Reply' note.
If your Monday sign-in runs out while the page is open, an upload answers "Your Monday sign-in has expired — reload this page and sign in again."

steps.title: Review the second questionnaire form
steps.summary: PNP cases (AAIP, OINP, NSNP, BCPNP, RCIP, Manitoba PNP, RNIP, SNIP), Federal PR, and Canadian Experience Class cases with profile + ITA + submission have two questionnaire forms. The case page buttons show only the first one. Exception: OINP cases with a Workforce Priority Stream sub type have only one form.
steps.where: Case page → Questionnaire tab → 'Open full page →' → in the browser address bar add '&formKey=additional' to the end (or '?formKey=additional' if the address has no '?') → Enter
steps.access: All staff who can open the case. Flags need Sign in with Monday.

options.label: …/review?formKey=additional
options.does: Opens the second form for review. On a family case it shows every member's second form on one page.

options.label: 🚩 Flag / Send Correction Request
options.does: Work the same way as on the first form.

watch_out: Without this, staff believe they reviewed the whole questionnaire when half of it was never shown.
The family 'Questionnaire Submitted' note links only the first form.

steps.title: Use the client portal as staff (Case Review)
steps.summary: Opening the client's portal from the case page shows a staff version called 'Case Review'. It is a read-only overview of what the client sees, with a few staff-only lines and buttons. Staff cannot upload here.
steps.where: Case page → '🏠 Client portal' (/client/<case number>), or Monday → Cases board → 'Client Portal' link column
steps.access: Staff signed in with Monday. Without a Monday sign-in, the link first asks you to sign in. Resending the portal email also needs a Monday sign-in.

options.label: 'N documents awaiting your review' / 'flagged for rework — awaiting client re-upload'
options.does: Staff-only lines under Case status: what is waiting for you, and what is waiting for the client.

options.label: 'Questionnaire is filled in but not yet submitted by the client' / 'N of M family members have not submitted yet'
options.does: The client still has to press Submit.

options.label: '✅ Nothing pending — case is on track.'
options.does: Nothing is waiting.

options.label: Open Review Form → / Open Document Review →
options.does: Open the questionnaire review page and the document review page.

options.label: 'Due at this stage — no e-Transfer request sent yet'
options.does: A milestone is due: send the request from the case page or the consultation page.

options.label: Resend portal access email →
options.does: Re-sends the client's link (see 'Resend the client's portal access email').

options.label: 'Part-paid — the $X received covers this milestone (plan amended). Use “Mark settled” on the payment row.'
options.does: Staff-only line under a milestone when the plan was lowered below what the client already paid: go to the case page → Payments tab and press 'Mark settled for <first name>' on that row. Other staff lines: 'Part-paid — $X received, $Y outstanding (ref …)' and 'Requested — awaiting the client's e-Transfer (ref …)'.

watch_out: There are no upload buttons for staff. To add a file the client emailed, see 'Upload a file the client sent by email'.

Staff wording you will see: '📝 Questionnaire is N% complete — client still has fields to finish'; the stage pill shows the real Case Stage (the client sees a plain journey label); on family cases '👥 Applicants: N / M submitted'; document rows read 'Not applicable — confirmed by staff', 'Optional — counts once uploaded', 'Needs a new copy · uploaded <date>', 'From your case officer: <note>'; the Documents card says 'N documents on this case (N not applicable) (N optional, not sent)'.

steps.title: The case did not move on: check these
steps.summary: The app moves a case to Internal Review, then to Submission Preparation, by itself. If it has not moved, go through these checks in order.
steps.where: Case page → Overview tab; Monday → Cases board → Case Stage and Automation Lock
steps.access: All staff who can open the case

options.label: 1. Case Stage
options.does: Must be exactly Document Collection Started (for Internal Review) or Internal Review (for Submission Preparation). A case in Stuck never moves by itself.

options.label: 2. Automation Lock
options.does: Must be No. While it is Yes, the automatic moves are off.

options.label: 3. 🧾 Questionnaire members
options.does: Every section must say Submitted. Filled in is not enough.

options.label: 4. Documents marked Reviewed
options.does: Uploaded is not enough. Reviewed documents must reach the target (80% unless set otherwise) for Internal Review, and 100% for Submission Preparation.

options.label: 5. Nothing blocking
options.does: Required documents or questions still outstanding stop both moves (to Internal Review and to Submission Preparation).

options.label: 6. All at 100% and still not moved?
options.does: Known gap: if the last thing done was a document review, the app does not move it. Set the Case Stage by hand in Monday.

watch_out: Never set the stage back to Document Collection Started to 'nudge' it: that emails the client 'Your case is ready' again.
source: guide steps submission-reach-internal-review, submission-reach-sub-prep, case-readiness-overview; automatic auto-gate-internal-review, auto-gate-submission-prep

steps.title: Use the staff guide page
steps.summary: The 📘 Guide button in the top bar opens this guide, 'How TDOT works'. It shows the whole client journey as a picture, a step-by-step list, your department's first-day list and the 'How do I…?' questions.
steps.where: Top bar → '📘 Guide' (/admin/guide)
steps.access: All staff (signed in with the team key or with Monday).
before: You are signed in. Without a sign-in the page says 'Please sign in first — The staff guide is for TDOT staff. Sign in, then open the guide again from the 📘 Guide button.'

options.label: ← Back to the app
options.does: Returns to the Consultations page.

options.label: Search a task, button or status…
options.does: Finds a step or a 'How do I…?' question as you type. Escape clears the box; the down arrow moves into the results.

options.label: Workflow / Map / Step by step
options.does: Three views of the same content: the journey picture, a stage-by-department map, and the full step list.

options.label: My department (chips)
options.does: Dims every box that is not your department's; 'Everyone' shows all. The choice is remembered on this computer.

options.label: Your first day → pick your department
options.does: Shows the few things that department does most, each linked to its step.

options.label: Follow (scenario buttons) · ◀ · ▶ Play / ❚❚ Pause · ▶
options.does: A scenario button lights up that client's path (press it again to clear). Play walks through it one box every few seconds with a caption; ◀ ▶ step by hand.

options.label: My boxes ‹ ›
options.does: Jumps between the boxes of the chosen department (shown only when a department is chosen).

options.label: − · + · Whole journey · Go to · More →
options.does: Zoom in and out, fit the whole picture, scroll to a stage, or pan right. You can also drag the picture and use Ctrl/⌘ + scroll to zoom.

options.label: (click a box)
options.does: Opens that step in a side panel: where to click, every option, what happens next and the mistakes to avoid. Close or Escape shuts it.

options.label: 'How do I…?' filter · 'Filter by stage' · 'Filter by recipient'
options.does: Narrow the question list, the 'What the app does by itself' table and the 'Emails the app sends' table (Everyone / To the client / To the team).

options.label: Print (browser)
options.does: Prints a step-by-step booklet for the chosen department, titled 'How TDOT works — <department>', with the golden rules. The picture, the map and the reference tables are left out (the Needs attention table stays in for Management and Everyone).

watch_out: 'The guide could not load — Please refresh the page in a moment.' means the content could not be fetched; refresh.
The guide is built from the app and shows the version it was built from at the bottom of the page.

steps.title: Find a case on the Cases board in Monday
steps.summary: A few steps in this guide are done in Monday, not in the app (they say 'In Monday'). This is how to reach the case's row and the four columns those steps touch.
steps.where: Monday → Cases board (called 'Client Master' in Monday) → search the case number (for example 2026-CEC-012) or the client's name → the case's row
steps.access: Anyone with Monday access to the Cases board.
before: You have the case number (top of the case page) or the client's name.

options.label: Case Sub Type
options.does: Pick exactly one value — one the note on the case names (the column's list mixes every case type's labels, so another type's label can be picked by mistake). A blank or wrong one stops the document checklist. On a paid case at Document Collection Started the checklist then builds by itself; otherwise also set Re-seed Checklist → Run.

options.label: Re-seed Checklist → Run
options.does: Rebuilds the document checklist (missing rows added, uploads kept). The column flips to 'Done ✓' or 'Failed ⚠' and a note on the case says what happened.

options.label: Case Stage
options.does: The stage the case is at. Change it only where this guide says so (for example 'Submitted' after filing). Moving a paid case into Document Collection Started again emails the client 'Your case is ready' again.

options.label: Payment Status
options.does: Prefer 'Record payment' in the app: setting 'Paid' here saves only a date, so the milestone still shows unpaid and an admin later has to clear the date. An admin may set it to 'Not Paid' only as the first step of undoing a wrong payment.

next: The app reads the change within a few seconds and posts a note on the case where it acts. Back in the app, press ↻ Refresh (Cases) or Check now (Summary) to see the result.
watch_out: Only touch the columns a step names. Other columns are written by the app and are overwritten.
The same board is the app's 'Cases page' — most reading is easier there.

branches.title: Phone-in or walk-in caller
branches.summary: Front desk adds the lead by hand (warnings for duplicates or Not Wanted), sets where the client is, then sends the booking invite from the lead page.

branches.title: An email to info@ becomes a lead
branches.summary: New senders become leads automatically (source Email). Set 'In Canada now?' and the address, check the details, then send the invite.

branches.title: Request through the public /consultation form
branches.summary: This separate form saves to its own Monday board and never enters the Leads list (no lead, no booking invite). Someone must pick it up from that board — for example by adding a lead by hand.

branches.title: Returning client skips the consultation
branches.summary: Convert the lead to a direct retainer: the Consultations page opens the direct-retainer window filled in from the lead. It continues in the retainer stage.

branches.title: Client never books
branches.summary: Two reminder emails go out, then Current status shows 'Expired' (nothing else happens). Post remarks on your calls and set an Outcome (Follow-Up / Newsletter / Not Wanted).

branches.title: Held time ran out unpaid
branches.summary: Booking becomes 'Abandoned' ('Booking not finished'); the client can use the same link again. A late payment posts an update — confirm the time with the client.

branches.title: Free consultations
branches.summary: When consultations are set to free, the booking is confirmed without payment.

branches.title: Fee paid by cash, e-transfer or team invoice — or waived
branches.summary: Record it on the consultation record instead of the online booking link. When recording with the booking is on, also enter the time and choose whether to email the package (video makes a Teams meeting); otherwise it is a record only and 'Review & send' sends the package.

branches.title: Consultation package held or not sent automatically
branches.summary: Blank address → add it with 'Save address' and the package sends itself. Same-time clash, late payment, interrupted send or time already passed → a person checks, then 'Review & send'.

branches.title: E-signing turned off or failed
branches.summary: The consultation agreement goes out as a PDF link to read instead of a Documenso signing request; there is no countersign step for it.

branches.title: Person is Not Wanted
branches.summary: Outcome Not Wanted with a reason puts them on the Not Wanted list; staff are warned if they come back (nothing is blocked); only a named admin can remove them.

branches.title: Follow-Up or Newsletter after the consultation
branches.summary: The client stays on 'Retainers & follow-ups' with no stage. Set a follow-up date in 'Attribution & follow-up', use the 'Follow-up: Due' filter and post remarks on each call.

branches.title: Walk-in / referral direct retainer (no booking, no consultation)
branches.summary: Staff create the client from the Consultations page popup (or convert a lead, or start from a previous case). The case opens at once (Pre-Onboarding, Payment Status empty) and the retainer is sent from the same Retainer plan. They show on Retainers & follow-ups with a "direct" tag and never get a consultation package. They may pay milestone 1 before the agreement goes out.

branches.title: Paid before the agreement is fully signed
branches.summary: The payment is recorded but onboarding waits until the client's signature (and, for Documenso signings, the RCIC countersignature) is in; it then starts by itself, once.

branches.title: Retainer Signed typed on a Follow-Up / Newsletter / Not Wanted lead
branches.summary: The date is kept but held: no case and no payment request until the outcome becomes Retain. Never clear the date.

branches.title: Two client-side signers (PA + Inviter / Sponsor / Dependent)
branches.summary: Both signers are emailed the agreement at once and sign in parallel; it completes only when both have signed. Missing co-signer details hold the send.

branches.title: E-signing off or failed
branches.summary: The client gets a PDF link, signs and emails it back; staff press "Mark retainer signed"; there is no RCIC countersign wait.

branches.title: Part-payment of milestone 1
branches.summary: The first part-payment starts the case like a full payment; the balance is collected before submission.

branches.title: A payment recorded in error
branches.summary: Staff report it with "Flag as wrong"; a named admin undoes it or corrects the amount.

branches.title: Returning client, new application
branches.summary: A second application gets its own new case through the direct retainer popup; the old case is left untouched and both get a note. (An earlier case still unpaid at Not Started / Pre-Onboarding with the same case type is reused instead.)

branches.title: Sponsor / inviter on the same portal link
branches.summary: Spousal, worker-spouse, Super Visa and visitor cases: the sponsor gets their own email and their own section on the client's portal link.

branches.title: Paid, but onboarding did not start
branches.summary: A note on the case says why (not Paid, signatures missing, set-up could not be written, Sub Type missing, past Document Collection). Fix the cause, then restart from the Cases board.

branches.title: A requested document does not exist for this client
branches.summary: Mark it "does not apply" with a reason (Monday sign-in needed). It leaves every count; "Applies again" puts it back. Undo first if it was already Reviewed or sent back.

branches.title: A document is sent back and uploaded again
branches.summary: Request rework → the client is emailed about 2 minutes later → the client uploads a new copy (status Received) → you review it again.

branches.title: Questionnaire answers need correcting
branches.summary: Mark the answers → Send Correction Request → the client fixes or replies and submits again.

branches.title: A family member is added after the case opened
branches.summary: Add them from the case page (section, board row and documents in one go). If their documents did not appear, set the Case Sub Type and run Re-seed Checklist in Monday.

branches.title: The case is complete but the stage did not move
branches.summary: The automatic moves need the questionnaire submitted and documents marked Reviewed; at 100% after a final document review, or with a questionnaire submitted below 100%, set the stage by hand in Monday.

branches.title: Case parked in Stuck
branches.summary: Nothing moves it out automatically; set the stage back by hand when the problem is solved.

branches.title: Team key and Monday sign-in
branches.summary: Staff open the pages with the shared team key (counts as an admin, sees everything). They also sign in with Monday when an action must carry their own name, or needs a named admin (undo or correct a payment).

branches.title: Working the Needs attention list each morning
branches.summary: Open Summary, work each group from the top, fix the problem using the item's "What to do", then press Check now; press Mark handled only when the item truly does not apply, or when it is still listed after the check. Press Check now to re-check after fixes. The item types are listed in the Needs attention section of this guide.

automatic.setting_note: The AI second opinion only runs when the AI service is set up; everything else always runs.
automatic.name: Website intake form becomes a lead
automatic.when: As soon as a client submits the website intake form (/lead/new)
automatic.does: Creates the lead on the Lead Board (Source "Website", Conversion Status "New"), with a personal booking-link code and a OneDrive lead folder. Saves the answers and any uploads. Sets Priority, Tier and Priority Reasons by the firm's rules. Emails the client "We received your inquiry — TDOT Immigration" (no booking link yet). Posts a full summary note. Asks the AI for a second opinion (not for existing clients); that second opinion also sets Conversion Status to "Qualified".

automatic.setting_note: The alert email goes only if an alert address is set up; the note on the lead is always posted.
automatic.name: Priority rules and the critical-lead alert
automatic.when: When a website intake form is submitted
automatic.does: Critical (T0): removal order, CBSA/IRCC letter, CBSA/hearing deadline, restoration ending within 14 days, ITA due within 30 days, passport deadline within 7 days, CRS above 500. High (T1): ITA 31–60 days, status expiring within 30 days, restoration 15–30 days, refusal within 60 days, PNP/employer/passport deadlines, CRS 471–500, any deadline within 7 days. Low (T3): CRS 450 or less with no urgency. Otherwise Medium (T2). An existing client with an active application gets "Existing Client" and no tier. A critical lead (or enforcement on an existing client) gets the note "🚨 CRITICAL LEAD — immediate review required" and an alert email to the office alert address.

automatic.name: Consultation request form saved to its own board
automatic.when: When someone submits the separate public consultation request form (/consultation)
automatic.does: Saves it as a row on its own Monday board (NOT the Lead Board, so it does not appear on the Leads page) and emails the person "We received your TDOT Immigration consultation request".

automatic.setting_note: On unless switched off; it does nothing until Microsoft has given the app permission to read the office inbox (info@tdotimm.com unless set otherwise).
automatic.name: Office inbox email becomes a lead or a note
automatic.when: Every 5 minutes (at 2, 7, 12 … minutes past the hour)
automatic.does: Reads new emails in the office inbox (read only — never moves or deletes mail, never reads the old backlog). Someone new becomes a lead named after the sender (Source "Email") with the note "📧 New lead from an email" and a reminder to set "In Canada now?". Someone known gets "📧 Email received" as a note on their open case(s) (up to 3), else on their newest case or lead. Skips staff, no-reply senders, newsletters, auto-replies, bounces, government and payment notices. A Not Wanted match adds a warning note.

automatic.name: Leads list "Current status" kept up to date
automatic.when: 30 seconds after the app starts, then every 10 minutes (a full re-read every 6 hours)
automatic.does: Reads the last 45 days of Lead Board notes so the Leads list can show each lead's "Current status" (invite sent, reminders, remarks, Expired after 7 days, and so on). It changes nothing in Monday.

automatic.name: Standard invite text saved as a draft
automatic.when: The first time an un-invited, un-booked lead's page is opened
automatic.does: Saves the standard booking paragraph as the lead's invite draft. A draft you cleared is never filled in again.

automatic.name: Booking invite email goes out
automatic.when: When the lead's Booking Invite becomes "Send" (the app's "Send booking invite" button, or set by hand in Monday)
automatic.does: Emails the client "Book your consultation with TDOT Immigration" with their booking link, then sets Booking Invite to "Sent" with the date and posts a note. If the email fails it sets "Failed" and posts a note.

automatic.setting_note: On unless switched off.
automatic.name: Booking reminders (48 hours and 5 days)
automatic.when: Every hour at 19 minutes past; reminder 1 at 48 hours and reminder 2 at 5 days after the FIRST invite
automatic.does: Emails a person who was invited but has not booked (once per person, even with duplicate lead rows). The reminders stop when any of these is true: one of their leads is booked, held or paid; an Outcome is set; a retainer or case exists; Booking Invite is no longer "Sent"; there is no email; the lead is archived; or they are on the Not Wanted list. Never within a day of an invite, never more than a day late. Notes "Booking reminder N of 2 emailed" are the record; a failure is retried up to 3 times.

automatic.name: A time is held while the client pays
automatic.when: When the client picks a time on the booking page
automatic.does: Refuses the time if another client holds or booked it with the same consultant. Otherwise sets Booking Status "Slot Held" with the time, consultant, meeting type, chosen length and fee, plus a hold-until time. The hold is 15 minutes, 24 hours, 72 hours or 7 days — the further away the consultation, the longer the hold.

automatic.name: Expired time holds are released
automatic.when: Every 5 minutes
automatic.does: A lead still "Slot Held" after its hold time becomes "Abandoned" and the time is freed. An unpaid Square consultation invoice is cancelled first; if that fails, a ⚠️ note asks staff to cancel it in Square. Never touches a lead that has since booked or held a new time.

automatic.name: Square payment confirms the booking
automatic.when: As soon as Square reports a completed payment (the 5-minute safety net catches any it missed)
automatic.does: Matches the payment to the lead. For a consultation fee: corrects the recorded length and fee to what was actually paid, saves the payment, sets Booking Status and Conversion Status to "Booked", then sets up the consultation (meeting, Square calendar, package). Posts a note on the lead when something looks wrong — staff must act on these themselves: "🚨 Possible DOUBLE PAYMENT on the consultation" · "💳 Consultation payment received on a booking set to \"Booked\" by hand" (no meeting, appointment or package is made) · a staff payment record was already there · "🚨 Two clients are booked for the same time" (on both leads) · "💳 Paid after the slot hold had expired" · "⚠️ Consultation payment amount needs a look". A payment on an old Square retainer link records the retainer as paid (new retainers are paid by e-Transfer).

automatic.name: Square payment safety net
automatic.when: Every 5 minutes
automatic.does: Looks at completed Square payments from the last 6 hours and processes any that were missed, through the same steps (consultation booking confirmed; legacy retainer payment). Harmless if already done.

automatic.setting_note: Teams or Zoom is a setting (Zoom unless set to Teams). With Zoom the app sends no calendar invitation.
automatic.name: Video meeting created for a virtual consultation
automatic.when: Right after an online payment is confirmed, and when staff record a fee with a video booking
automatic.does: For a virtual consultation: creates a Teams calendar invitation (subject "Consultation: <client> — TDOT Immigration") for the client and the routed consultant — or a Zoom meeting — and saves the Meeting Link. For every meeting type it fills Consultation Held with the consultation date.

automatic.setting_note: Only when Square Appointments is set up for consultations.
automatic.name: Paid consultation added to the Square calendar
automatic.when: Right after an online payment is confirmed (best effort)
automatic.does: Creates a Square appointment for the client with the consultant. If it fails, posts "⚠️ Square appointment not added automatically — please add this consultation to the Square calendar manually". Not done for bookings staff enter themselves.

automatic.setting_note: Only when the automatic package is turned on (off unless switched on — staff then use "Review & send"). Sending after a staff-recorded fee needs a second setting as well.
automatic.name: Consultation package sent automatically
automatic.when: At three moments: an online payment is confirmed; staff save the address on a held lead; or staff record a cash / e-Transfer / waived fee and choose to send
automatic.does: Emails the client the package once ("Your TDOT Immigration consultation — details, form & agreement": details, pre-consultation form and agreement). HOLDS it with a note in three cases: the residential address is blank ("⚠ Consultation package HELD — no residential address"); another client has the same time; or the client paid after the hold ran out. Not sent once the consultation time has begun. On failure: "⚠ Consultation package NOT sent automatically — … use Review & send".

automatic.setting_note: Only when the automatic package is turned on.
automatic.name: Consultation package safety net
automatic.when: Every 15 minutes (at 9, 24, 39 and 54 minutes past the hour)
automatic.does: Sends a package that was held for a blank address once the address has been typed into Monday (up to 3 tries). A send interrupted for more than 10 minutes is handed to staff once with a note ("⚠ Consultation package: the automatic send was interrupted … check the client's inbox and Documenso, then use Review & send"). Never re-sends on its own.

automatic.setting_note: Only when e-signing is turned on.
automatic.name: Client signs the consultation agreement → consultant asked to countersign
automatic.when: As soon as e-signing (Documenso) reports the client's consultation agreement is signed
automatic.does: Fills Consult Agreement Signed, saves the signed PDF in OneDrive, posts a note, and sends the consultant the countersign request (note "🖋️ Countersign request sent to the consultant", or a warning to click "Sign as consultant").

automatic.setting_note: Only when e-signing is turned on.
automatic.name: Consultant countersigns → client gets the signed copy
automatic.when: As soon as e-signing (Documenso) reports the consultant has signed
automatic.does: Saves the countersign date, emails the client the fully signed PDF ("Your fully signed TDOT Immigration consultation agreement") and posts "✍️ Consultation agreement countersigned by the consultant …".

automatic.name: 24-hour consultation reminder
automatic.when: Every hour, for Booked consultations 23–25 hours away
automatic.does: Emails the client "Reminder: your TDOT consultation (<date time> Toronto)" with the office address, phone note or join link, and posts "⏰ 24h reminder sent" on the lead so it goes once.

automatic.name: 1-hour consultation reminder
automatic.when: Every 15 minutes, for consultations 30–90 minutes away
automatic.does: Same email as the 24-hour reminder; posts "⏰ 1h reminder sent".

automatic.name: Pre-consultation form chase
automatic.when: Every 2 hours, for consultations 1–24 hours away
automatic.does: If the pre-consultation form is not submitted, emails the client "Please complete your pre-consultation form" with their link, once (note "📋 pre-consult chase sent"). Skipped when staff chose not to email the client when recording the fee.

automatic.name: "Set the Outcome" reminder note
automatic.when: Every 15 minutes; from 45 minutes after the booked start, up to 72 hours later
automatic.does: If no Outcome is set and there is no "Consultation held" note, posts "✅ Consultation time has passed … Next step: set the Outcome …" on the lead, once.

automatic.setting_note: Only when the mailbox whose OneDrive holds the Teams recordings is set up (Teams meetings).
automatic.name: Teams recording found and linked
automatic.when: Every 30 minutes
automatic.does: Looks in the recorder's OneDrive "Recordings" folder for a recording with the client's name made within 48 hours of the consultation; writes a view link (anyone in the firm) to Consultation Recording and posts "🎬 Consultation recording is ready (Teams)".

automatic.setting_note: Only when Teams transcripts have been set up with Microsoft.
automatic.name: Teams transcript saved
automatic.when: Twice an hour (10 and 40 minutes past), up to 3 days after the meeting
automatic.does: Downloads the meeting transcript (if transcription was on), saves it in the client's OneDrive folder, links it in Consultation Transcript and posts "📝 Consultation transcript is ready (Teams)". Does nothing until Microsoft permissions are set up.

automatic.setting_note: Only when consultations use Zoom.
automatic.name: Zoom meeting ended / recording ready
automatic.when: When Zoom reports the meeting ended or the recording is ready (Zoom meetings only)
automatic.does: Meeting ended: sets Consultation Held to the real date and posts "✅ Consultation held … Next step: set the Outcome column". Recording ready: saves the recording link on the lead and posts "🎬 Consultation recording is ready" (with the passcode).

automatic.name: Outcome changed on the Lead Board
automatic.when: As soon as the lead's Outcome changes (from the app or in Monday)
automatic.does: Retain: starts the retainer step (the agreement goes once a Retainer Fee is also set). Not Wanted: adds the person to the Not Wanted list (no reason is known when set in Monday). Other outcomes: nothing.

automatic.setting_note: Only when a list of staff addresses for outcome emails is set up.
automatic.name: Team told about an outcome
automatic.when: When an outcome is set or changed from the app (and it really changed)
automatic.does: Emails the outcome list "🏁 Outcome: <outcome> — <name> (<case type>)" with the case type, consultant, fee and a link to the record.

automatic.name: Not Wanted list backstop
automatic.when: Every 15 minutes (at 3, 18, 33 and 48 minutes past)
automatic.does: Adds to the Not Wanted list any lead whose Outcome is Not Wanted and has no list entry yet (up to 20 per run). An admin's removal stands. Does nothing if the list board is not set up.

automatic.setting_note: E-signing or email depends on whether e-signing is turned on. Which agreement is built (the generic one-page agreement or TDOT's real templates from the retainer plan) is a setting.
automatic.name: Retainer agreement sends itself
automatic.when: When the Outcome becomes Retain or a Retainer Fee (CAD) is entered, and both are now set
automatic.does: Sends the agreement once, either by e-signing (Documenso) or as an email with a PDF link. It sends only when the Outcome is Retain, a fee is set, and the agreement was not already sent or signed. With the newer retainer templates it also needs a complete plan and complete co-signer details. If those are missing, the agreement is held. When setting the Outcome started the send, a note on the lead says what is missing; when entering the fee started it, there is no note. Conversion Status becomes "Consulted" for clients who had a consultation.

automatic.setting_note: Only when e-signing is turned on. The staff email goes only if a list of addresses is set up.
automatic.name: Signed retainer captured
automatic.when: As soon as e-signing (Documenso) reports a retainer signing request completed
automatic.does: Client signed: stamps Retainer Signed, saves the signed PDF to OneDrive, opens the case (as "Mark retainer signed" would), emails the staff list "✍️ Retainer signed — …" the first time, and sends the consultant the countersign request. Consultant countersigned: records it, emails the client the fully signed copy, and starts onboarding if the retainer is already paid. Completions of voided agreements are ignored.

automatic.name: First payment request emailed at signing
automatic.when: Right after the case is created at signing (or when the fee is entered later on a signed lead)
automatic.does: Emails the client the milestone 1 e-Transfer request ("Your TDOT Immigration payment — <milestone>") once. At signing it is not sent if the retainer is already recorded as paid or no fee is set (a note says so), or if milestone 1 was already requested (no note), or if a part-payment is already on file for it (a note says the request was not sent because the client owes only the balance). It also waits while a typed Retainer Signed date is on hold because the outcome is not Retain.

automatic.setting_note: "Retained by" is filled only for consultants whose Monday account is set up in the app.
automatic.name: Client marked Retained (signed AND paid)
automatic.when: Whichever comes second: the retainer is signed or the retainer is paid
automatic.does: Sets the lead's Conversion Status to "Retained" with the note "🎉 Client retained", and fills "Retained by" on the case with the retaining consultant if empty (which also lets them see the case).

automatic.name: Case only starts when signed, countersigned and paid
automatic.when: When a retainer payment is recorded, the client signs, or the consultant countersigns
automatic.does: Sets the case's Payment Status to "Paid" and moves it to the active group — but only once all three are done: the client has signed; the consultant has countersigned (for e-signed agreements); and the retainer is paid. Until then it posts a hold note on the lead saying what is still missing.

automatic.setting_note: The onboarding restart part is on unless switched off.
automatic.name: Retainer / payment status kept in step
automatic.when: Every 15 minutes (at 7, 22, 37 and 52 minutes past)
automatic.does: Keeps the case's Payment Status and the lead's retainer dates in step. It can move a case up to Paid or "Signed (Unpaid)", and fills the lead's Retainer Paid date when staff set Paid on the board. It never moves a status backwards, and never overwrites "Not Paid" or "Working on it"; it reports those as a conflict instead. Then starts onboarding once for any case marked Paid before it was fully signed, now that signatures are complete.

automatic.setting_note: A returning client's new application gets a new case (on unless switched off).
automatic.name: Case created when the retainer is signed
automatic.when: When the Retainer Signed date is set (button, e-signing, or typed in Monday) on a lead with Outcome Retain or no outcome yet. An e-signature or a direct-retainer client always counts. A date typed by hand on a Follow-Up, Newsletter or Not Wanted lead is held until the outcome is set to Retain.
automatic.does: Creates (or reuses an early one for a walk-in) the Cases-board row named after the client: Client Email, phone, Payment Status "Signed (Unpaid)", Case Stage "Pre-Onboarding", in the pending group, the OneDrive folder carried over from the lead. Copies the lead's updates ("📋 Conversation history imported…"), notes the consultant, links the client account, then sets Primary Case Type (and Sub Type) so the case number is given. The lead becomes "Retained — Awaiting Payment".

automatic.name: Walk-in (direct retainer) case catches up when signed
automatic.when: When the client signs a direct-retainer agreement (their case already exists)
automatic.does: Sets Payment Status to "Signed (Unpaid)" (never over Paid) and the lead to "Retained — Awaiting Payment", and creates the Family Members rows from the retainer panel. If the case is already paid and fully signed, onboarding starts.

automatic.name: Portal access code made for a new case
automatic.when: When a row is created on the Cases board
automatic.does: Creates the access code used in the client's portal links.

automatic.setting_note: The sponsor part only when sponsor emails are turned on.
automatic.name: Case number given
automatic.when: When a Primary Case Type is set on a case without a number
automatic.does: Gives the number (YEAR-ABBREVIATION-NNN; a number is never reused) and fills the Sub Type hint. Writes the staff Client Portal link. Renames the OneDrive folder to "<name> - <case number>" and adds the 4 working folders. Creates the Family Members rows and prepares the sponsor row. If the case was paid before its type was set, it also starts onboarding.

automatic.name: Paid → Document Collection Started (the app does this, not a Monday rule)
automatic.when: When a case's Payment Status becomes "Paid" (set by staff or by the app)
automatic.does: First payment at an early stage: Case Stage → Document Collection Started, payment date, Stage Start Date, checklist/questionnaire "applied" set to No, reminder clock reset — then onboarding runs. Still waiting for signatures: the same set-up without the Stage Start Date, plus a hold note. Already past Document Collection: only the payment date, plus a note "💵 Payment marked while the case is at …" (nothing is reset and no email is sent). Also fills the lead's Retainer Paid date so every page shows paid.

automatic.setting_note: The sponsor email only when sponsor emails are turned on. Which checklist source is used is a setting.
automatic.name: Onboarding at Document Collection Started
automatic.when: When the Case Stage becomes Document Collection Started on a case that is Paid and fully signed
automatic.does: Starts the reminder clock if it is blank. Emails the client "Action Required — Your <Case Type> Case Is Ready (<case number>)" and sends the sponsor email. Builds the document checklist (the OneDrive category folders and the checklist rows) and pre-fills the questionnaire. Sets Checklist Template Applied and Questionnaire Template Applied to Yes. Moving a Paid case into this stage again sends the client email again (the checklist is not rebuilt and the sponsor is not emailed twice). If not Paid or not fully signed it posts a note instead ("⏸ Onboarding deferred: …", "⏸ Onboarding NOT started: the payment status could not be verified…", or "⛔ Onboarding deferred: missing …").

automatic.setting_note: On unless switched off; when off, a "needs a manual start" note is posted instead.
automatic.name: Held onboarding starts once the last signature lands
automatic.when: When the last signature lands on a case already marked Paid (the 15-minute status sync is the backstop)
automatic.does: Posts "▶️ Onboarding started automatically.", restarts the reminder clock, sends the client and sponsor emails and builds the checklist — once per case. If onboarding seems to have run another way, posts a staff note instead.

automatic.setting_note: The sponsor email only when sponsor emails are turned on.
automatic.name: Checklist built when the Sub Type is set late
automatic.when: When the Case Sub Type gets a value
automatic.does: If the case is Paid, at Document Collection Started and has no checklist yet, builds the checklist now and sends the sponsor email.

automatic.name: "Case is ready" email re-sent after a Client Email correction
automatic.when: When the Client Email is changed on a Paid case at Document Collection Started, Internal Review, Submission Preparation or Submission Ready (the app does not check that the first email ever went out)
automatic.does: Re-sends the "case is ready" email to the corrected address with a note; on a case still on hold, waits.

automatic.setting_note: On unless switched off.
automatic.name: Lost Client Portal link put back
automatic.when: Every hour at 27 minutes past
automatic.does: Puts back the staff "Client Portal" link on a case row that has a case number and access code but lost its link (two checks in a row). Never makes a new access code.

automatic.name: Family member added in the background
automatic.when: When staff press "➕ Add family member" on the case page
automatic.does: Runs the add (about a minute) while the page checks progress every 3 seconds for up to 5 minutes. Only one add per case at a time.

automatic.setting_note: Whether optional documents count only once uploaded is a setting.
automatic.name: Readiness numbers recounted
automatic.when: On every client upload, every document status change, and overnight. A questionnaire Submit does not recount: it runs its own stage check with the numbers already on the case.
automatic.does: Writes Documents Readiness % (share reviewed), Documents Uploaded %, the blocking count and Missing Required on the case. At Document Collection Started, Internal Review, Submission Preparation and Stuck it also updates the status columns and can move the stage. Other open stages get the four numbers only. Finished and locked cases are left alone.

automatic.name: "Document received" Monday notification
automatic.when: When a document's status becomes Received (the client uploaded it)
automatic.does: Sends a Monday bell notification to the row's reviewer and the case's Case Manager, Ops Supervisor, Case Support Officer, Stage Owner and Submission Team.

automatic.name: Saved upload marked Received after a hiccup
automatic.when: 1, 5 and 15 minutes after an upload whose status could not be written
automatic.does: Re-posts the upload note and marks the row Received, unless staff changed it meanwhile.

automatic.setting_note: A review note reopening a Reviewed or Received document is a setting (off unless switched on).
automatic.name: Rework requested — what follows
automatic.when: When a document becomes Rework Required. Also, if that setting is switched on, when a review note is typed on it
automatic.does: Adds 1 to Rework Count, sets the row's Escalation to "Triggered by Rework", sets the case's Escalation Required to Yes with a reason, sends Monday notifications to the Case Manager and Ops Supervisor, posts notes on the row and the case, and queues the client email.

automatic.name: One combined correction email to the client
automatic.when: 2 minutes after the last rework or clarification on a case (the wait restarts with each new one; survives a restart)
automatic.does: Sends one email per case — "Action Required: N item(s) need(s) your attention — Case <case number>" — listing every document sent back, each with its note, and an "Upload Documents →" button. Questionnaire corrections are not part of it: they go out at once by "Send Correction Request". Rows marked Not Applicable meanwhile are dropped.

automatic.name: Document Reviewed — what follows
automatic.when: When a document's status becomes Reviewed
automatic.does: Sets Review Completed Date to today and Review Required to No, then recounts readiness.

automatic.name: Questionnaire progress sent to Monday
automatic.when: On every client save (a manual save within seconds; autosave at most once every 5 minutes per case)
automatic.does: Updates Q Readiness % from every family member's saved answers and sets Q Completion Status to "Working on it" unless already Done. Keeps one current draft PDF per form in the case's OneDrive Questionnaire folder.

automatic.name: Questionnaire submitted
automatic.when: When the client presses Submit (allowed from 80% complete)
automatic.does: Sets Q Completion Status to Done once every family member has submitted. Posts a note with the staff review link and saves the submission PDF. Then checks whether the case can move on: from Document Collection Started to Internal Review, or from Internal Review to Submission Preparation (that one only when everything is at 100%).

automatic.name: "Information still needed" email
automatic.when: When the client clicks Save Progress with empty fields (at most once a day) or submits with empty fields; never on autosave
automatic.does: Emails the client "Information Still Needed for Your Case — <case number>" listing the sections still missing.

automatic.setting_note: Moving rows after a Sub Type change is on unless switched off.
automatic.name: Re-seed Checklist → Run
automatic.when: When staff set the case's "Re-seed Checklist" column to Run in Monday
automatic.does: Adds any missing checklist rows. If the Sub Type was changed, it moves the old Sub Type's rows over to the new one instead of making duplicates. This move can clear a Not Applicable decision. It also deletes rows of another Sub Type that are still empty. Then it sets the column to "Done ✓" or "Failed ⚠" and posts a note.

automatic.name: Overnight check 1 — Case Readiness
automatic.when: Every night at about 3:00 a.m. Toronto time in summer (2:00 a.m. in winter) — the app's own clock reads 07:00 then
automatic.does: For every case with a case number and Automation Lock not Yes: recounts document readiness, blocking items and missing required documents and writes them to the Cases board. Moves a case to Internal Review or Submission Preparation when the rules are met (see the submission stage).

automatic.name: Overnight check 2 — SLA & Risk
automatic.when: Every night at about 3:00 a.m. Toronto time in summer (2:00 a.m. in winter) — the app's own clock reads 07:00 then
automatic.does: For cases at Document Collection Started, Internal Review, Submission Preparation or Stuck that have a Stage Start Date. It reads the case type's row on the SLA Config board (when nothing is set there: 60 days in total, Orange at 60% of the time used, Red at 80%, expiry warning 90 days). It then writes Days Elapsed, SLA Total Days, Expected Readiness, SLA Risk Band, a first Case Health, the risk and expiry flags, and the Hard, Soft and Submission Prep deadlines. A close passport / IELTS / medical expiry raises the band to Orange (Red within 30 days).

automatic.name: Overnight check 3 — Expiry Risk
automatic.when: Every night at about 3:00 a.m. Toronto time in summer (2:00 a.m. in winter) — the app's own clock reads 07:00 then
automatic.does: Checks whether a passport, IELTS or medical expiry date falls inside the case type's warning window (90 days unless set otherwise). If it does, the app sets Expiry Risk Flag "Flagged", Expiry Alert Sent "Warning Sent" and Escalation Required Yes with the reason "<document> expiry in N days", and sends one email to the Ops Supervisor and Case Manager. Within 30 days: "Critical Sent" and a critical email. Clears the flag when the date is no longer close.

automatic.name: Overnight check 4 — Case Health
automatic.when: Every night at about 3:00 a.m. Toronto time in summer (2:00 a.m. in winter) — the app's own clock reads 07:00 then
automatic.does: Writes four things on the case. Client-Blocked Status: Yes when the Chasing Stage is Client Blocked. Client Delay Level: High when the client is blocked, has had 3 or more reminders, or has been inactive for more than 21 days; Medium when Reminder 2 or the Final Notice was sent, 2 or more reminders went out, or the client has been inactive for more than 10 days; otherwise Low. Client Responsiveness Score (0–100). Case Health: Red when the client is blocked, the SLA is Red, a hard deadline is under 7 days away, or a blocking item has a deadline under 14 days away; Orange when the SLA is Orange, an expiry is flagged, there is any blocking item, delay is High, 2 or more reminders went out, or a deadline is under 30 days away; otherwise Green.

automatic.name: Overnight check 5 — Escalation Routing
automatic.when: Every night at about 3:00 a.m. Toronto time in summer (2:00 a.m. in winter) — the app's own clock reads 07:00 then
automatic.does: For active cases whose SLA Risk Band is Orange or Red (cases on Manual Override are skipped; locked cases are skipped unless they are Stuck). The app finds the matching rule on the Escalation Routing Matrix board (by stage, band and case type) and waits the time the rule gives. Then it does what the rule says. A rule can: send Monday notifications to the supervisor, director, case support or case manager; raise the Priority Score; lock the case; reassign it to the supervisor; add SLA days; change Escalation Required or the Case Stage; create a supervisor task; or email the client a reminder ("Important update regarding your case – <case number>") or a final notice ("Final Notice — Immediate action required — <case number>"). Records Escalation Last Notified.

automatic.name: Overnight check 6 — Document reminders to the client
automatic.when: Every night at about 3:00 a.m. Toronto time in summer (2:00 a.m. in winter) — the app's own clock reads 07:00 then; days counted from the Stage Start Date (SLA Config board, defaults 7 / 14 / 21 / 30)
automatic.does: Runs only for cases that: are at Document Collection Started; have Payment Status Paid; are not locked and not on Manual Override; have a case number and a Stage Start Date; and have had no client activity in the last 24 hours. Blank or "Pending" → Reminder 1 email ("Reminder 1 Sent"); then Reminder 2 ("Reminder 2 Sent"); then Final Notice ("Final Notice Sent"); then, with no email, "Client Blocked" and Escalation Required Yes ("Client unresponsive for N days — case blocked"). Each email adds 1 to Reminder Count. Marked "Resolved" once the questionnaire is submitted at 100% and Documents Readiness is 100% (every counted document marked Reviewed by staff, not just uploaded).

automatic.name: Case moves to Internal Review
automatic.when: When all four are true: the questionnaire is submitted (Q Completion Done); the questionnaire % and the reviewed-documents % both reach the case type's minimum (SLA Config board; 80% unless set otherwise); there are no blocking items; and the case is at Document Collection Started. Checked when the client submits the questionnaire, after document reviews and overnight. If a case at Document Collection Started is already 100% complete, only the client's questionnaire submit moves it; a document review or the overnight check will not.
automatic.does: Sets Case Stage Internal Review, Stage Start Date today, Ready for Review Done, Doc Threshold Met Yes, Chasing Stage Resolved; posts "📋 Case Ready for Internal Review … Action required (Ops Supervisor): assign the Case Manager / reviewer"; emails the Ops Supervisor and Case Manager "Internal Review — Please Assign Reviewer — <case number>".

automatic.name: Case moves to Submission Preparation
automatic.when: When the case is at Internal Review, the questionnaire is submitted at 100%, documents are 100% reviewed and nothing is blocking
automatic.does: Sets Case Stage Submission Preparation, Stage Start Date today, Ready for Sub Prep Done; posts "✅ Case Ready for Submission Preparation … assign the Submission Team"; emails the Ops Supervisor and Case Manager "Submission Prep — Please Assign Submission Team — <case number>".

automatic.name: Stage clock reset
automatic.when: When the Case Stage is set (by hand or by the app) to Internal Review or Submission Preparation
automatic.does: Stage Start Date = today, Chasing Stage = Resolved, Reminder Count = 0 (a fresh time limit for the new stage).

automatic.name: Submission Ready locks the case
automatic.when: When the Case Stage is set to Submission Ready (by hand)
automatic.does: Sets Automation Lock Yes, posts "🔒 Case Locked — Submission Ready", and emails the Submission Team and Case Manager "Submission Ready — Filing Can Begin — <case number>".

automatic.name: Finished stages lock the case
automatic.when: When the Case Stage is set to Submitted, Approved, Refused, Closed, Withdrawn, Cancelled or Archived
automatic.does: Sets Automation Lock Yes, Chasing Stage Resolved, Escalation Required No (reason cleared), and posts "🔒 Case <stage> … all automated engines … will now skip this case." ("Application Submitted" does not lock the case.)

automatic.name: Lead Board copy refreshed for the list pages
automatic.when: 5 seconds after the app starts, then every 3 minutes
automatic.does: Refreshes the copy of the Lead Board behind the Leads, Consultations and Retainers lists, the Reporting figures and the booking page's taken-times check. Lists can be a few minutes behind Monday.

automatic.name: Needs attention list worked out
automatic.when: Every morning at 7:00 Toronto time; also on "Check now" and on the first visit after the app restarts
automatic.does: Reads every Cases-board row, its notes, the document checklists, Family Members, OneDrive folders and part-paid balances, and rebuilds the Needs attention list on the Summary page. It changes nothing and emails nobody.

automatic.name: The six overnight case checks
automatic.when: Every night at about 3:00 a.m. Toronto time in summer (2:00 a.m. in winter) — the app's own clock reads 07:00 then. Each check may take up to 5 minutes; skipped if the previous run is still going.
automatic.does: Runs in order: Case Readiness → SLA & Risk → Expiry Risk → Case Health → Escalation Routing → Document reminders. A failure in one does not stop the next. (Staff can run them by hand on Engine Controls.)

automatic.setting_note: The email goes only if an alert address is set up.
automatic.name: Case-type list check
automatic.when: Every night at about 2:45 a.m. Toronto time in summer (1:45 a.m. in winter) — 06:45 in the app's settings's UTC clock
automatic.does: Treats the Cases board's Primary Case Type list as the standard and adds missing options to the Lead Board case-type dropdown. Emails "TDOT automation: case-type list drift needs attention" when a new type has no case-number abbreviation (its numbers would read "MISC") or the lists disagree.

automatic.name: Person told they were assigned to a case
automatic.when: When someone is added as Case Manager, Case Support Officer, Ops Supervisor, Stage Owner or Submission Team on a case
automatic.does: Sends everyone now in that column a Monday notification: "You have been assigned as <role> for case: \"<name>\"" — so people already in the column get it again when someone is added or removed.

automatic.name: Supervisor alerts on health, expiry, blocked and escalation
automatic.when: When Case Health turns Red, Expiry Risk Flag turns Flagged, Client-Blocked Status turns Yes, or Escalation Required changes
automatic.does: Monday notifications: Red health → Ops Supervisor; expiry flagged → Ops Supervisor and Case Manager; client blocked → Ops Supervisor and Case Manager; Escalation Required Yes → Ops Supervisor. Escalation Required set to No clears the Escalation Reason.
