emails.subject: Submission Ready — Filing Can Begin — <case number>

emails.setting_note: Only when an alert address is set up.
emails.name: Case-type list needs attention
emails.when: The nightly case-type check finds the lists out of line
emails.subject: TDOT automation: case-type list drift needs attention

needs_attention.means: One case number is on two or more cases, so the portal and the case folder can mix them up.
needs_attention.do: Tell an admin — the admin gives one of them a new case number. (If your view is limited to your own cases you see "Case number <n> is also on another case that is not assigned to you.")

needs_attention.means: A live case has no case number. Either no Primary Case Type is set (the item appears after 2 days), or the type is set but no number was given (the item appears after 30 minutes).
needs_attention.do: No Primary Case Type: set the Primary Case Type on the Cases board — the case number is then created automatically. Type set but no number: clear the Primary Case Type and select it again — the number is then given automatically; if it stays blank, tell an admin.

needs_attention.problem: A leftover test folder has this case number
needs_attention.means: A OneDrive folder that looks like a test folder ends with this client's case number, so the client's files could be saved there.
needs_attention.do: Tell an admin — the admin renames the test folder. The app then makes the client's own folder when it is needed.

needs_attention.problem: Payment noted, but not marked Paid
needs_attention.means: A note on the case says the client paid (for example "payment received", "e-transfer received"), but Payment Status is not Paid, so onboarding never started. Notes like "no payment received yet" or "awaiting payment" are ignored. Only for cases up to Document Collection Started.
needs_attention.do: If the client has paid, record it with 'Record payment' (case page → Payments tab, or the client's consultation page). That records the amount and reference and lets the case start by itself. Only if the Payments tab says 'No linked lead record' (older cases), set Payment Status to Paid on the Cases board instead. (The item's own text on the Summary page says to set Payment Status to Paid.) If the client has not paid, mark this handled.

needs_attention.means: A retainer milestone was only part-paid and the case has reached Submission Preparation or later (it stays listed on a submitted case until paid).
needs_attention.do: Collect the balance from the client before the application is submitted, then record it on the case page (Payments → Record balance / part-payment). If it was agreed otherwise, mark this handled. A new part-payment brings the item back even if it was marked handled before.

needs_attention.problem: Case Sub Type needed for the checklist
needs_attention.means: The document checklist was not made because the Case Sub Type is blank (and the case type has more than one checklist) or does not fit the case type.
needs_attention.do: Set the correct Case Sub Type on this case. At Document Collection Started the checklist then builds by itself; otherwise flip Re-seed Checklist → Run. If the Sub Type was already corrected: flip Re-seed Checklist → Run on this case; if it fails, tell an admin.

needs_attention.means: The case is Paid but has no document checklist. Possible reasons: the build failed; it was marked Paid after being moved past Document Collection; onboarding was not restarted; or it simply never started. Listed 1 day after the paid date (2 hours for a brand-new case).
needs_attention.do: Build failed: flip Re-seed Checklist → Run; if it fails again, tell an admin. At Document Collection Started: flip Re-seed Checklist → Run to build the checklist. Then check that the client received "Your case is ready"; if not, resend it from the client portal page (case page → "🏠 Client portal" → Client access card → "Resend portal access email →"; needs a Monday sign-in). At an earlier stage: set the Case Stage to Document Collection Started — the welcome email, checklist and questionnaire then start by themselves. Marked Paid after moving past Document Collection (or onboarding not restarted): check whether the agreement is fully signed and the client still has documents to send. If yes: flip Re-seed Checklist → Run, and resend "Your case is ready" from the client portal page if they never got it. If no: mark this handled.

needs_attention.problem: Signed and paid, but onboarding did not start
needs_attention.means: The app tried to start onboarding but could not, and left a note on the case saying why.
needs_attention.do: Wrong Case Stage: set the Case Stage to Document Collection Started — the welcome email, checklist and questionnaire then start by themselves. No case number: set the Primary Case Type — the number is given and onboarding then starts by itself. No client email: add the client's email on the case — onboarding then starts by itself. Switched off: set the Case Stage to Pre-Onboarding and then back to Document Collection Started (please don't switch the Payment Status off and on). Anything else: read the app's note on the case in Monday, or tell an admin.

needs_attention.means: The Case Sub Type says the family comes along (for example "Accompanying Spouse & Child") but no spouse or child is recorded, so the questionnaire and/or documents cover the main applicant only. Listed 1 day after the paid date. The wording changes slightly depending on what the checklist and questionnaire already list.
needs_attention.do: On the case page, use "➕ Add family member" (Family card) for each accompanying spouse or child. If the client is in fact applying alone, correct the Case Sub Type. Where the item says so, also flip Re-seed Checklist → Run so the document list matches it.

needs_attention.problem: Super Visa: second parent not on the case
needs_attention.means: A Super Visa case named for two people ("A & B", "A and B", "A / B") has no second parent (or grandparent) recorded.
needs_attention.do: No second parent: on the case page, Family card → "➕ Add family member" → "Second parent" (or grandparent), with their full name. If only one parent is applying, press Mark handled. Second parent entered as "Parent": tell an admin — the member must be changed from "Parent" to the second parent, then flip Re-seed Checklist → Run. Do not add them again — they would be listed twice.

needs_attention.means: The case is Paid but onboarding is on hold until the retainer is fully signed (the client's signature and/or the consultant's countersignature).
needs_attention.do: Missing client signature: remind the client to sign the retainer agreement. Missing countersignature: the consultant countersigns it (Consultations page → open the client → Sign retainer as consultant). Onboarding then starts by itself. If the case was already moved on by hand, check whether the agreement is fully signed now. If it is, and the client still has documents to send: flip Re-seed Checklist → Run, then resend the portal email from the client portal page (case page → "🏠 Client portal" → Client access card → "Resend portal access email →"; needs a Monday sign-in). If not, mark this handled.

needs_attention.problem: "Your case is ready" email not confirmed
needs_attention.means: Onboarding started but there is no record that the client's "Your case is ready" email went out, or it failed.
needs_attention.do: Not confirmed: if the client never received it, resend it from the client portal page (case page → "🏠 Client portal" → Client access card → "Resend portal access email →"; needs a Monday sign-in). If the document checklist is also missing, flip Re-seed Checklist → Run. Failed: resend it the same way to send the client their link.

needs_attention.means: The sponsor / inviter's portal email was not sent (listed 10 minutes after the failure, if nothing was sent later).
needs_attention.do: Open the case page → Sponsor / inviter card → add the sponsor's email if it is missing, then press Send sponsor link.

needs_attention.means: Someone flagged a payment as recorded in error, or undoing a payment did not finish cleanly. Shown even on finished cases.
needs_attention.do: Flagged: an admin checks the payment and uses Undo on the payment row if it is wrong. Undo did not finish: an admin checks the client's Retainer Paid date and payment row now. The item clears itself once a "Payment record removed" / "Retainer Paid date removed" note follows.

needs_attention.problem: Ready for the next step, nobody assigned
needs_attention.means: The app moved the case to Internal Review with no Case Manager, or to Submission Preparation with no Submission Team.
needs_attention.do: Internal review: the Ops Supervisor assigns a Case Manager on the Cases board. Submission preparation: the Ops Supervisor assigns the Submission Team on the Cases board. (The person assigned gets a Monday notification.)

needs_attention.means: Two or more OneDrive folders end with this case number, so the client's files can be split between them.
needs_attention.do: Ask an admin to merge them into one folder.

needs_attention.means: App warnings on the case that nothing has answered yet.
needs_attention.do: Family members not covered by the checklist: if they are accompanying this application, change the Case Sub Type to the accompanying variant and flip Re-seed Checklist → Run. A checklist re-seed failed: fix what the note names, then flip Re-seed Checklist → Run again; if it keeps failing, tell an admin. Working folders could not be made: add them by hand (1-Coordinator-Working, 2-Case-Manager-Draft, 3-AW-Analyst-Final-RCIC, 4-Submitted-IRCC), or tell an admin. Intake folder not renamed: move those documents into the case folder by hand, or tell an admin. Files could not be moved into the client's own folder: tell an admin — the note on the case lists the files. Record of used case numbers not saved, or number given while OneDrive could not be checked: tell an admin.

golden_rules.rule: Sign in with the team key (the box says "Admin API Key"), and also "Sign in with Monday" whenever an action needs your name. The document review page and questionnaire flags always need the Monday sign-in.

Do the work in the app. A few steps exist only in Monday (for example the case stage after review, Case Sub Type, Re-seed Checklist); this guide marks them "in Monday". Don't use Monday for anything else.
If the top bar says "Monday API Offline" or a page says it is showing the last copy, don't act on what you see. Wait and refresh.
If a page says a request "may still go through", reload before you press anything again. A second press can send a second email.
The Leads and Consultations lists can be up to 3 minutes behind Monday; press refresh. On Cases and Summary, press ↻ Refresh, then again a few seconds later.
Set "In Canada now?" before you send the booking invite. If it is blank, HST is charged.
Don't send a booking invite to a client whose fee is already recorded. The link asks them to pay again.
After changing a client's email, send the booking invite again. Reminders only go to the address the invite went to.
Act on 🚨 and 💳 booking notes yourself (double payment, same-time clash, late payment). Nothing is refunded or moved automatically.
When the app says the person already exists, open the existing lead instead of adding a new one. In the walk-in popup, use "Link to existing lead".
Requests from the public website consultation form are not on the Leads page. Check their Monday board.
Set an outcome for every consultation once it has happened. Clear the "⚠ Needs outcome" box.

For Retain, use "Retain & send agreement" in the retainer panel. The outcome buttons are for Follow-Up, Newsletter and Not Wanted. (Only a lead holding a Retainer Signed date is set to Retain in Monday.)
Set the fee, save the plan, then send. Any edit means you must save again before sending.
Pick the right Sub Type before sending. A blank or wrong one stops the document checklist.
To change terms after sending: ✎ Amend, save, then 🔄 Void & re-issue (unsigned only). Amend alone sends nothing.
A follow-up date sends no reminder. Check it yourself: Consultations → 'Retainers & follow-ups' → the follow-up dropdown → 'Due (today or earlier)'.
Record payments with "Record payment" in the app, not by setting Paid on the Cases board.
Enter the consultation fee before HST. The agreement adds the HST.
Never record a fee that was paid through the booking link. Refunds are done in Square.
Check an e-Transfer really came from this client, and never record the same one twice.
A wrong retainer payment: press "Flag as wrong". Only named admins, signed in with Monday, can Undo or Correct amount. A wrong consultation-fee record: use Change record or Remove record.
Read the whole preview before "Delete permanently". It removes Monday rows and the OneDrive folder.
Copy files into the working folders (1-Coordinator-Working …). Never move or delete them from the client's own folders: the app and the client portal read them there.
Open every file before you accept it, and mark each document Reviewed. Uploaded alone never moves the case on.
Write rework notes for the client. They are emailed word for word.

Use "⊘ Does not apply" (Not Applicable) only for a document that does not exist for this client. If the client emailed you a file, upload it into that document instead (see "Upload a file the client sent by email").
Press "Add family member" once and wait. Check the Family list before ever pressing it again.

If the app says the Case Sub Type is missing or wrong, set it on the Cases board from the column's own list. A wrong one stops the checklist. On a paid case at Document Collection Started the checklist then builds itself; at any other stage also set Re-seed Checklist → Run.
Open Summary every morning and work the Needs attention list from the top.

When you fix a problem, it drops off the list at the next check. Use Mark handled only for an item that needs no fix, or one still listed after your fix and Check now: it hides that item, and a new one appears if the situation changes.
Press Check now after fixing things instead of waiting for the next morning.
Only a named admin signed in with Monday can take someone off the Not Wanted list. Always give the reason.
Each Reporting figure counts by its own date, so the steps in one month are not always the same clients.
Upload each document into its own place on the list (up to 50 MB per file).
Keep the portal email. The link never changes and every earlier copy keeps working.
Moving a paid case into Document Collection Started emails the client "Your case is ready" again. Don't move it back and forth.
After filing with IRCC, set Case Stage to "Submitted". "Application Submitted" does not lock the case.
The consultation fee is typed before HST. A milestone payment is typed as received, including HST.
Only milestone 1 is requested automatically. Check the Payments tab for DUE milestones and send each request yourself.
Give every milestone a trigger stage. One left at "— when due —" never shows as due, so nobody is prompted to collect it.

nodes.title: Client gets in touch
nodes.detail: A new person contacts TDOT. Almost every way in ends up as a lead on the Leads list (the public consultation request form has its own Monday board).

nodes.title: Fills website intake form
nodes.detail: The website intake form creates the lead by itself. (The separate public consultation request form saves to its own Monday board and does not appear on the Leads list.)

nodes.title: Add lead
nodes.detail: Front desk adds the caller with ＋ Add lead. Only Full name is required. The app warns if the person is already in the system or on the Not Wanted list.

nodes.title: Email to info@ → lead
nodes.detail: A new sender becomes a lead; a known client's email is added as a note on their lead or case.

nodes.title: Lead on the Leads list
nodes.detail: For website-form leads the app sets the priority (and alerts on critical leads). For every lead it keeps the Leads list's Current status up to date.

nodes.title: Check the lead
nodes.detail: Open the lead, correct the details, set the Lead owner, and answer "In Canada now?". If you leave it blank, HST (sales tax) is added to the consultation fee. Post a remark for what you did.

nodes.title: What does the client want?
nodes.detail: Most leads book a consultation first. A walk-in, referral or returning client who is ready to sign goes straight to a direct retainer.

nodes.title: Send the booking invite
nodes.detail: Choose the consultant, check the message, and send. If the client's fee is already recorded, don't send it: the invite link would ask the client to pay again. The client says it never arrived? See 'The client did not get the booking invite'.

nodes.title: Booking reminders
nodes.detail: If the client hasn't booked, the app emails reminders 48 hours and 5 days after the first invite, once per person. After 7 days the lead's Current status shows "Expired". This is only a label; nothing else changes. If the client never books, set an outcome on the lead page (for example Newsletter). Setting any outcome stops the reminders. Recording the fee, or adding the person to the Not Wanted list, also stops them.

nodes.title: Picks a time
nodes.detail: On the booking page the client picks how to meet, the length and a time. The time is held while they pay.

nodes.title: How is the fee paid?
nodes.detail: Most clients pay online through the booking link. Cash, e-Transfer, an invoice from the team, or a waived fee is recorded by staff instead.

nodes.title: Pays online (Square)
nodes.detail: Square (the online payment service) tells the app the payment went through, and the app confirms the booking. The client is not sent back to TDOT's site afterwards; they stay on Square's receipt page.

nodes.title: Record consultation fee
nodes.sub: cash, e-Transfer, waived + book · front desk too
nodes.detail: Use this instead of the booking invite. Record the fee (the amount before HST) and how it was paid. Then enter the booking time yourself in the same window. You can choose to email the consultation package. Never record a fee that was paid through the booking link. Front desk can do this too (all staff can).

nodes.title: Booking confirmed
nodes.detail: For a video consultation the app creates the meeting (Teams or Zoom, a setting). It emails the consultation package — details, pre-consultation form and agreement — once. The app holds the package back, with a note, in three cases: the client's address is blank, another client has the same time, or the client paid after their held time ran out. The app adds the booking to the Square calendar only when the client paid online. If staff recorded the booking, add it to Square yourself. If you record a fee without a booking, the app only saves the record and does nothing else.

nodes.title: Release a held package
nodes.detail: If the package was held or automatic sending is off, fix the cause (e.g. add the address) and press Review & send. Act on 🚨 and 💳 alerts yourself — nothing is refunded or moved automatically.

nodes.title: Signs the agreement
nodes.detail: The client signs the consultation agreement (e-signing) and fills the pre-consultation form. Online signing of the agreement only works when e-signing is turned on. The consultation goes ahead whether or not the client has signed.

nodes.title: Countersign the agreement
nodes.detail: After the client signs, the consultant is asked to countersign. The client then gets the fully signed copy.

nodes.title: Meeting reminders
nodes.detail: The client gets reminders 24 hours and 1 hour before, and a chase if the pre-consultation form is not done.

nodes.title: Meet the client
nodes.sub: consultation: video, in person or phone
nodes.detail: Open the consultation record and hold the meeting. Teams recordings and transcripts are linked automatically when set up. After the meeting time has passed, a note on the lead reminds you to set the outcome. Set it with the outcome buttons on the page, not in the Outcome column in Monday.

nodes.title: Outcome?
nodes.detail: Every consultation gets an outcome: Retain, Follow-Up, Newsletter or Not Wanted. Retain goes through "Retain & send agreement"; the outcome buttons are for the other three. For a new client, do not set Retain in the Outcome column in Monday. If you do, the agreement is emailed by itself as soon as a fee is set, and the app skips its check that the Sub Type is filled in. Use Retain in Monday only to release a signature date that is on hold (see Follow-Up).

nodes.title: Check follow-ups yourself
nodes.detail: Follow-Up clients sit on the Retainers & follow-ups list. A follow-up date sends no reminder: check the Follow-up filter → "Due (today or earlier)" yourself. If the client later wants to go ahead and has NOT signed anything, retain them (fee, plan, Retain & send). If they already signed, someone typed a Retainer Signed date while the outcome was still Follow-Up. The app keeps that date on hold, and "Retain & send" will not work. Instead, go to the Lead Board in Monday and set the Outcome column to Retain. The case then opens with that date, and no new agreement is sent. Never clear the date.

nodes.title: Newsletter
nodes.detail: The person stays on the Leads list with the Newsletter outcome.

nodes.title: Not Wanted
nodes.detail: Use the page button so the reason is recorded. Staff are warned if the person comes back. Only a named admin can remove someone from the list. The list only warns staff. It cancels nothing, and the person is not told. If a retainer was already sent, they can still sign it and a case will open, so void (cancel) it in Documenso. A booked time stays booked, so cancel it in Square yourself. If they pay through the booking link, they still get the package, the Teams invite and the reminders. Changing the outcome later does not take them off the list: only a named admin can.

nodes.title: Add direct retainer client
nodes.detail: For a walk-in, referral or returning client: ＋ Direct retainer client (or convert the lead). The app warns about existing records and the Not Wanted list, and creates the lead and the case at once.

nodes.title: Build the retainer plan
nodes.detail: Set the fee, choose the template, case type and Sub Type, list the family members (tick "Accomp." for each one who is on the application and needs their own document list), add the co-signer if there is one, and set the milestones (the payment instalments). Preview and save.

nodes.title: Retain & send agreement
nodes.sub: amend or void & re-issue if needed
nodes.detail: Sends the retainer agreement once (e-signing, or an email with a PDF link). To change the terms after it is sent: press Amend, save, then press Void & re-issue. This only works while the client has not signed.

nodes.title: Signs the retainer
nodes.detail: The client (and a co-signer, if the plan has one) sign. The signed copy is saved to OneDrive automatically.

nodes.title: Case set up (not started)
nodes.detail: As soon as the client signs, the app creates the case on the Cases board. This happens before the consultant countersigns and before payment. The case starts with Payment Status "Signed (Unpaid)" and stage Pre-Onboarding. The app gives it a case number based on the case type, renames the client's folder, and adds the 4 working folders and the family rows. It also emails the client the e-Transfer request for milestone 1 (the first payment), but only if the retainer fee is set and milestone 1 is not already paid. Walk-in / direct retainer: the case already exists — signing sets it to Signed (Unpaid) and adds the family rows.

nodes.title: Mark retainer signed
nodes.sub: client signed on paper or PDF
nodes.detail: Use when e-signing is off or the client signed a paper or emailed PDF copy. It records the client's signature and opens the case. The consultant does not need to countersign. It only works when the outcome is Retain. Never clear a Retainer Signed date that is held.

nodes.title: Countersign the retainer
nodes.detail: When the client e-signs, the consultant is emailed a countersign request automatically — sign from that email (or "Sign retainer as consultant"). Not needed when the client signed on paper.

nodes.title: Pays by e-Transfer
nodes.detail: The client sends the e-Transfer to the address in the payment request.

nodes.title: Record retainer payment
nodes.detail: Check the e-Transfer came from this client, then press Record payment (not Paid on the Cases board). If the client pays only part of milestone 1, that first part-payment still starts the case, just like a full payment, once the agreement is signed. If a payment was recorded by mistake, press Flag as wrong; only named admins can then Undo it or Correct amount. Later milestones are never requested automatically: check which are due and send the request yourself.

nodes.title: Signed and paid?
nodes.detail: The case only starts when the client has signed and milestone 1 is paid (a part-payment counts). For an e-signed retainer the RCIC countersignature is needed too. Until then the app posts a hold note saying what is missing. The client is marked Retained once signed and paid. If the client pays before signing, record the payment anyway; the app then does not email a payment request when they sign. Whether walk-in or consultation client, the case starts at the moment the last signature lands (a check every 15 minutes catches anything missed).

nodes.title: Case waits
nodes.sub: hold note says what is missing
nodes.detail: The case waits until all of these are done: the client has signed, milestone 1 is paid, and (for e-signed retainers) the RCIC has countersigned. Until then, the app posts a hold note on the lead that says what is still missing. When the last piece arrives, the app starts the case by itself. A check that runs every 15 minutes catches anything it missed.

nodes.title: Case starts
nodes.detail: Payment Status Paid → Case Stage Document Collection Started. The app builds the document checklist, pre-fills the questionnaire, starts the reminder clock and emails the client "Your case is ready". Moving a paid case into this stage again re-sends that email. Careful: if someone sets Paid on the Cases board before every signature is in, the case still shows Paid and Document Collection Started, but nothing has actually started: no email and no checklist. Look for the ⛔ "onboarding is on hold" note. Onboarding starts by itself when the last signature arrives.

nodes.title: "Your case is ready"
nodes.detail: The client gets the email with their Client Portal link. If the case has a sponsor or inviter, they get their own email with the same portal link when sponsor emails are turned on. If sponsor emails are turned off, send it yourself from the case page.

nodes.title: Check the new case
nodes.detail: Make sure the Case Sub Type is right (a wrong one stops the checklist), all family members are on it, the sponsor is set, and the OneDrive folder exists. Work through 'First checks on a new case'.

nodes.title: Uploads documents
nodes.detail: The client uploads each document into its own place (up to 50 MB per file) and fills the questionnaire. Submit is allowed from 80% complete.

nodes.title: Overnight checks
nodes.detail: Every night at about 3 a.m. Toronto time (2 a.m. in winter), the app checks the open cases. It updates readiness (and may move a case to Internal Review), time limits (SLA), expiring documents, case health and escalations. It also emails reminders (Reminder 1, Reminder 2, Final Notice) to clients at Document Collection who have not finished.

nodes.title: Review each document
nodes.detail: Open the case page or the full review page, open each file and decide. Also check the questionnaire and flag answers that need correcting. Some PR cases have a second questionnaire form; a file the client emailed is uploaded on their documents page.

nodes.title: Document OK?
nodes.detail: Accept it (Reviewed), send it back for a new copy (rework, with a note the client reads word for word), or mark it "does not apply" when it doesn't exist for this client.

nodes.title: Correction email to client
nodes.detail: The app waits 2 minutes, then sends the client one email listing every document sent back in that time, each with your note word for word. Pressing Undo during those 2 minutes does not stop the email. Marking the document "does not apply" during that time does. Questionnaire corrections are separate: "Send Correction Request" emails at once.

nodes.title: Mark it Reviewed
nodes.detail: Only Reviewed documents count toward Documents Readiness — uploaded alone never moves the case on.

nodes.title: Mark "does not apply"
nodes.detail: For a document that doesn't exist for this client. A file received by email is uploaded into the document instead.

nodes.title: Moves to Internal Review
nodes.detail: The case moves by itself when the questionnaire is submitted and two numbers reach the case type's target (80% unless set otherwise): how complete the questionnaire is, and how many documents staff have marked Reviewed. Also, no document marked as blocking may be waiting for review. The app checks this when the client submits the questionnaire, after each document review, and overnight. Known gap: if the submitted questionnaire is already at 100% and a review brings the documents to 100% Reviewed, the app does not move the case, not even overnight. Move it to Internal Review by hand.

nodes.title: Review the whole file
nodes.detail: The Ops Supervisor assigns the reviewer, who checks the whole file. The app does not wait for this review to finish. Once everything is at 100%, it moves the case to Submission Preparation by itself. So finish the review before the last documents are marked Reviewed, or move the stage back by hand. If no Ops Supervisor and no Case Manager is named on the case, nobody is emailed.

nodes.title: Moves to Submission Prep
nodes.detail: The case moves by itself when four things are true: it is at Internal Review, the submitted questionnaire is 100% complete, every document is marked Reviewed, and nothing is blocking. The app checks after reviews, when the questionnaire is submitted, and overnight. If the questionnaire stays below 100%, move the case by hand.

nodes.title: Prepare the application
nodes.detail: Prepare the application in the 4 working folders. Copy files from the client's folders — never move them, or they vanish from the app and the portal.

nodes.title: Set Submission Ready
nodes.detail: Set Case Stage to Submission Ready in Monday. It locks the case (the automatic checks skip it) and emails the Submission Team and Case Manager.

nodes.title: File with IRCC
nodes.detail: Filing happens on the IRCC site. Then set Case Stage to "Submitted" — not "Application Submitted", which does not lock the case.

nodes.title: Decision
nodes.detail: Record the decision and close the case.

nodes.title: Management: every stage
nodes.sub: Summary every morning: Needs attention, workload
nodes.detail: Open Summary every morning and work the Needs attention list from the top. When you fix a problem, it drops off the list at the next check — press Check now instead of waiting for the morning. Use Mark handled only for an item that needs no fix, or one still listed after your fix and Check now; it hides that item and leaves a note on the case.

glossary.plain: A tick box in the retainer plan's family list. Tick it for each family member who is on the application. Only ticked people get their own document list and questionnaire section.

A card on the lead page and the consultation record with a computer-written second opinion on a website lead: talking points, priority reasons and compliance flags. Priority and Tier come from fixed rules, not from these notes.
A Cases board setting. While it is Yes, the app skips the case for readiness checks, automatic stage moves and reminders, until someone sets it back to No.
A document (or questionnaire part) marked as blocking on the checklist. While even one is outstanding, the case cannot move to Internal Review or Submission Preparation, whatever the percentages say.
A Booking Status set by staff in Monday when a time was arranged outside the booking link. No meeting, Square appointment or consultation package is made for it automatically.
The email that sends the client their personal link to pick a consultation time and pay. Staff send it; it never goes out by itself.
A Lead Board column: Not Yet, Slot Held, Booked or Abandoned (a held time ran out unpaid).
A signed client's application file. Each case is one row on the Cases board and has its own case page.
A Green, Orange or Red light on each case, worked out every night from time used, deadlines, expiring documents and client delays.
The case reference, made from the year, a short case-type code and a number (for example 2026-CEC-012). A number is never used twice.
The app page with everything about one case: stage, payments, family, documents, questionnaire and history. Opening it changes nothing.
The Cases board column that shows where the case is, such as Pre-Onboarding, Document Collection Started, Internal Review, Submission Preparation or Submitted.
The Monday board with one row per case. Its name in Monday is 'Client Master'.

Immigration words you will see in leads. CBSA is the border agency. CRS is the Express Entry points score. ITA is an invitation to apply. PNP is a provincial nominee program. H&C means humanitarian and compassionate grounds.

A Cases board column that shows how far the document reminders have gone for this client: blank or Pending, Reminder 1 Sent, Reminder 2 Sent, Final Notice Sent, Client Blocked, or Resolved (nothing left to chase). The app sets it; you only read it.
One row per person on the Clients board in Monday. It links every lead and case that person has had, so the app can warn when an email or phone already belongs to someone.
The client's own web page for their case: questionnaire, document uploads and payments. The link never changes. Staff see a read-only version called 'Case Review'.
The first meeting where a consultant reviews the client's situation, by video, in person or by phone. It is usually paid; the fee can be waived.
The short agreement the client signs online before the consultation; it is part of the consultation package and states what they paid. The consultant countersigns it afterwards. Not the retainer.
One email with the booking details, the meeting link or office address, the pre-consultation form and the consultation agreement.

The app page for one client from booking to retainer: meeting links, answers, outcome, fee and the retainer plan. Open it from the Consultations page, or from a lead page via 'Open consultation view' (shown as 'Open retainer view' for a direct retainer client).
A Lead Board column showing how far a lead has got toward becoming a client: New, Qualified, Booked, Consulted, Retained — Awaiting Payment, Retained.
The consultant (RCIC) signs an agreement after the client has signed it online, so it is fully signed. Not needed for a paper signature.
A column on the Leads page showing where the lead is with TDOT (for example Invite sent or Booking not finished). It is not the person's immigration status.
A walk-in, referral or returning client who skips the consultation and goes straight to a retainer. Their case opens at once.
The online signing service. Clients and consultants sign agreements in the browser, and the app saves the signed copy.
The list of documents this client must provide, one row per document. It is built from the case type and Sub Type.
The Monday board (called 'Document Checklist Execution' in Monday) with one row per document a client must provide. The case page and the document review page show these rows.
The case stage where the client uploads documents and fills in the questionnaire. Moving a paid case into it emails the client again.
The share of documents staff have marked Reviewed. It decides the automatic moves. Not the same as the uploaded % on the case page's Overview tab.

The share of countable documents the client has uploaded at least once. It is the number on the Cases board column and on the case page's '📂 Document readiness' meter, but it does not move the case; only Documents Readiness % (marked Reviewed) does.
The PDF summary of the client's pre-consultation answers, opened from the paper icon ("Dossier PDF") on the consultation record. The same answers show in the Eligibility profile card.
An Interac bank-to-bank email payment. Clients pay retainer milestones this way, with the reference code from the payment request.
An app page (address /admin/engines; it is not in the top bar) where the six night checks can be run straight away, the Monday connection tested, and one client's "case is ready" email resent.
The e-signing service's word for one signing request. "Countersign envelope issued" just means the signing request was sent to the consultant; "voided" means its links no longer work.
Raising a case to a supervisor because something is wrong, such as a rework, an expiring document or a client who does not respond.
A Monday board of rules: for a stage, risk band and case type it says who to notify and what to do when a case is running late. The overnight escalation check follows these rules.

The Monday board with one row per spouse, child, parent or sponsor on a case. Rows are created when the case gets its number and when staff press Add family member; the questionnaire and checklist read them.
The small funnel-shaped button on each column header of the Leads page. It opens a panel to filter that column, with counts.
The outcome for a client who is not ready to go ahead (also used when not eligible). A follow-up date sends no reminder; check the list yourself.
The date the app works out every night from the Stage Start Date and the case type's time limit. It is shown as "Deadline" on the case page and feeds Case Health.
The app paused a step on purpose and posted a note saying why. It goes ahead once the problem is fixed, or when staff press the button.
Harmonized Sales Tax, 13% in Ontario, added on top of TDOT's fees for clients in Canada. Example: a $200 consultation costs $226 with HST.
A question on the lead page. If it is Yes or left blank, HST is added to the consultation fee. Clients outside Canada pay no HST.
The stage where the whole file is checked once enough is done. The app moves cases here by itself.
Immigration, Refugees and Citizenship Canada: the government department that receives and decides applications.
The headline figures on the Reporting tab of the Consultations page: consultations held, consultation fees, retainers signed and the lead-to-paid funnel. Each figure counts by its own date.
A person who has contacted TDOT but is not yet a client with a case. Each lead is one row on the Lead Board.
The Monday board that holds every lead, from first contact until the retainer is signed. The Leads and Consultations pages are built from it.
A Cases board switch (Yes/No). While it is Yes, the overnight escalation and reminder checks leave the case alone so a person can handle it by hand.
Takes one item off the Needs attention list and leaves a note on the case. Use it only when no fix is needed. If the situation changes, a new item can appear.
One instalment of the retainer fee, due when the case reaches its Trigger stage. Milestone 1 is the non-refundable admin fee, requested when the client signs.
The online spreadsheet-style system where TDOT keeps its records. The app reads and writes Monday for you.

A staff member on the app's admin list who is also signed in with Monday. Only they can delete records, run the overnight checks by hand, undo or correct payments, and take people off the Not Wanted list.
A list on the Summary page of cases where a step was missed, each with what is wrong and what to do. It is rebuilt every morning at 7:00 Toronto time.

The six checks the app runs on every open case at about 3 a.m. Toronto time (2 a.m. in winter): readiness, time limits (SLA), expiring documents, case health, escalation and document reminders. The Engine Controls page calls them engines.
Marks a document that does not exist for this client, with a reason. It leaves every count and the client sees "Not needed".
A list of people TDOT does not want to work with. It only warns staff if the person comes back; it cancels nothing and the person is not told.
A message the app or a person posts on a lead or case in Monday. Monday calls it an update; this guide calls it a note. A remark is a note a staff member types from the Outcome & remarks box.
What the app does when a case starts: the "Your case is ready" email, the document checklist, the questionnaire and the reminder clock.
TDOT's Microsoft file storage. Each client has one folder, named with their case number, with their uploads and signed papers.
The result recorded after a consultation: Retain, Follow-Up, Newsletter or Not Wanted. Every consultation must get one.
The client paid only some of a milestone. The app keeps the payment and shows the balance still owed.

A Cases board column: blank, Signed (Unpaid), Paid, Not Paid or Working on it. New rows may also show 'Alreaday Sent' (spelled that way), put there by a Monday rule; it means nothing yet. When it becomes Paid and every signature is in, the case starts.

The seven Cases board columns that name staff on a case: Stage Owner, Ops Supervisor, Case Support Officer, Case Manager, Submission Team, Retained by and Override Approved By. They decide who gets Monday notifications and, when visibility is limited, who can open the case.
The first case stage: the case exists but has not started, usually because a payment or a signature is missing.
The Cases board column that says what kind of application this is (for example Express Entry). Setting it is what gives the case its case number.
A number on the case that the overnight escalation rules can raise so the case sorts higher. Staff do not set it.
A Cases board column for the questionnaire: Working on it while anyone is still filling it in, Done once every family member has pressed Submit. Only Done lets the case move on.
How much of the questionnaire is filled in, across every family member. It rises with each save. A high number alone never moves the case; the questionnaire must also be submitted.
Regulated Canadian Immigration Consultant: the licensed adviser who holds consultations and signs agreements for TDOT.
A Cases board column you set to Run to add missing document rows, for example after the Sub Type was set or changed.
Received means the client uploaded the document and it waits for staff. Reviewed means staff opened it and accepted it. Only Reviewed counts toward moving the case on.
A button on the consultation record that re-sends the client their meeting link and pre-consultation form link. It does not send a new agreement.
The outcome for a client who wants TDOT to take their case. Set it with 'Retain & send agreement'; there is no Retain button.
The client has signed the retainer and paid milestone 1. They leave the Consultations lists and appear on Cases.
The contract that hires TDOT to handle the application. It sets the fee and the payment plan.
The panel on the consultation record where you set up the retainer: fee, template, case type and Sub Type, family, co-signer and milestones.

The Lead Board date showing the client signed the retainer. Setting it opens the case. If the outcome is Follow-Up, Newsletter or Not Wanted, the date is kept on hold until the outcome becomes Retain.
The button on the consultation record that emails the consultation package by hand. Use it when the package was not sent automatically, after checking the meeting details are right.
The column on the Document Checklist board where the staff note for a document is kept. The rework email to the client uses whatever is in it, word for word.
Sending a document back to the client for a new copy, with a note. The client reads the note word for word.
Right of Permanent Residence Fee: a government fee for permanent residence that can be added in the retainer plan.
A page attached to the retainer that lists exactly which services TDOT will provide for this case.
Signing in with your own Monday account so the app records your name. Needed for the document review page, questionnaire flags and payment corrections.
Which agreement wording is used, and so who must sign: the main applicant only, the main applicant plus an inviter, sponsor or dependent, or an employer.
Payment Status for a client who signed the retainer but whose milestone 1 is not recorded as paid yet.
The time limit TDOT sets for each case type. The SLA Risk Band (Green, Orange, Red) shows how much of it is used up.

A Monday board with one row per case type that sets its time limit, the Orange and Red warning points, the expiry warning window, the reminder days and the 80% minimum for moving on. Admins change it; the night checks read it.
A person in Canada who supports the application, such as a spouse or the child inviting a parent. They use the same portal link, with their own documents.
The payment service clients use to pay the consultation fee online. It also holds the consultation calendar. Refunds are done there.

The Cases board date on which the case entered its current stage. The app counts reminder days, time limits and deadlines from it. It is set when the case starts Document Collection and reset to today when the case moves to Internal Review or Submission Preparation; other stage changes leave it alone.
A stage for a case that cannot move forward. The app does not move a Stuck case on to Internal Review or Submission Preparation; when the problem is solved, set the stage back by hand.
The exact version of the case type (for example with or without family coming). It decides the document checklist; blank or wrong means no checklist.
The stage where staff prepare the application in the working folders. The app moves cases here when everything is at 100%.
The stage to set after filing on the IRCC site. Use 'Submitted', not 'Application Submitted' (which does not lock the case).

The shared password every staff member types to open the staff pages (the box says 'Admin API Key'). It does not tell the app who you are, so it cannot delete records, undo payments or run the overnight checks — those need a named admin.
Microsoft Teams: the video meeting service used for virtual consultations. The app makes the meeting and calendar invitation, and picks up the recording and transcript afterwards.
Two Yes/No columns on the Cases board, Checklist Template Applied and Questionnaire Template Applied. Yes means onboarding built the checklist or questionnaire for this case.
T0 to T3 on a website lead, worked out from the Priority: Critical = T0, High = T1, Medium = T2, Low = T3. T0 leads get urgent slots. Staff-added and email leads have no Tier.
The case stage at which a retainer milestone becomes due. A milestone with no trigger never becomes due.
Four staff-only folders inside the client's folder (1-Coordinator-Working to 4-Submitted-IRCC) for preparing the application. Copy files in; never move files out of the client's own folders.
The other video meeting service the app can use instead of Teams. Which one is used is an app setting; with Zoom no calendar invitation is sent.

howto.q: How do I sign in?
howto.answer: Type the shared team key in the 'Admin API Key' box. For anything that needs your name (document review, questionnaire flags, payment fixes) also use 'Sign in with Monday'.

howto.q: Why does a page say I must sign in with Monday?
howto.answer: The team key does not say who you are. Some actions record your name, so they need your own Monday sign-in.

howto.q: How do I move between the main pages?
howto.answer: Use the top bar: Leads, Consultations, Cases and Summary.

howto.q: What does a word in this guide mean?
howto.answer: Look it up in the glossary. The main words used on the staff pages are explained there in a line or two.

howto.q: Where do I see or post notes on a lead or case?
howto.answer: Every lead, consultation record and case page has a '💬 Updates' area. The app posts its notes there too.

howto.q: The page says 'Monday API Offline'. What do I do?
howto.answer: Don't act on what the page shows. Wait a little, then refresh.

howto.q: Which cases can I see?
howto.answer: Normally every case. If the firm turns on "assigned only", you see only cases where you or your team are named on the case.

howto.q: A person phones about a work permit. How do I add them?
howto.answer: Leads page → '＋ Add lead'. Only the name is required, but always ask for email, phone, home address and 'In Canada now?', and pick 'How they reached us' = Phone.

howto.q: What must I ask a caller before I hang up?
howto.answer: Email (no invite without it), phone, full home address (it prints on the agreement), whether they are in Canada now (decides HST), and what they need.

howto.q: The app says the person is already in the system. What do I do?
howto.answer: Open the existing lead or case from the link and work there. Don't create a second lead.

howto.q: The app warns this person is on the Not Wanted list. What now?
howto.answer: It is a warning only: nothing is blocked and the client is never told. Check with your manager before you go ahead.

howto.q: How do I send the client a link to book a consultation?
howto.answer: Open the lead → card 'Booking invite email' → choose the consultant → 'Send booking invite'. Set 'In Canada now?' first.

howto.q: Which consultant should I choose?
howto.answer: The app marks its suggestion; normally keep it. Removal orders, urgent deadlines, Express Entry with a score above 470, provincial nominee (PNP), humanitarian and refugee cases go to Shafoli (the senior RCIC). Everything else goes to Shermin. Choose before you send the invite: it decides whose calendar and fee the client sees.

howto.q: The client says they didn't get the booking email.
howto.answer: Check the Invite column and the email spelling, ask them to look in junk mail, then send again only if it is safe. If they already booked, use 'Resend links'.

howto.q: What happens if the client never books?
howto.answer: The app sends reminders at 48 hours and 5 days. After 7 days the status shows 'Expired'. Then set an outcome (for example Newsletter).

howto.q: Current status says 'Booking not finished'. What does it mean?
howto.answer: The client held a time but did not pay in time. They can pick a time again on the same link.

howto.q: What does each Current status value mean?
howto.answer: It shows where the lead is with us (not their immigration status). The Statuses list explains each value and what to do next.

howto.q: How do I find this week's Instagram leads that have not booked?
howto.answer: Leads page → the filter icon on the Source column → tick Instagram; the Received column filter → Last 7 days; the Booking column filter → Not Yet. Instagram only shows for leads where staff chose it when adding or editing the lead.

howto.q: A walk-in paid the consultation fee in cash. What do I do?
howto.answer: Add the lead (with email, address and 'In Canada now?'). Don't send a booking invite. On the lead press 'Record payment / Waived (and book)', choose Cash, type the fee before HST, enter the booking and choose whether to email the package. Then add the time to Square yourself.

howto.q: How much do I type as the fee if the client paid $226?
howto.answer: Type the fee before HST: $226 ÷ 1.13 = $200. If the client is outside Canada, there is no HST, so type what they paid.

howto.q: A client wants to sign up now without a consultation. What do I do?
howto.answer: Already a lead → '→ Convert to direct retainer'. Had a case before → '➕ New application' on that case. Brand new → '＋ Direct retainer client' on the Consultations page. Then tell the consultant to build the retainer.

howto.q: A website lead says Priority "Existing Client". What do I do?
howto.answer: It is a current client, not a sales lead. Find their case and pass the request to the case team. Don't send a booking invite.

howto.q: The consultation package says HELD. How do I release it?
howto.answer: Read the grey line on the consultation record. If the address is missing, save the address and it sends itself. Otherwise fix the cause and press 'Review & send'.

howto.q: I see a 🚨 or ⚠ note about a booking or payment. What do I do?
howto.answer: These notes are the only alert; nothing is fixed automatically. Look up the note in the booking alerts list and do what it says.

howto.q: I see a 🚨 double payment note. What do I do?
howto.answer: Check Square to see whether both payments really went through. If they did, have one refunded in Square (the app never refunds). The staff record can't be changed or removed once the client has paid online, so post a remark on the lead saying which payment was refunded, how and by whom.

howto.q: The client lost their meeting link. How do I resend it?
howto.answer: Consultation record → 'Resend links' (or lead page → 'Resend meeting + pre-consult links'). No new meeting is made.

howto.q: How do I record what I did for a lead?
howto.answer: Lead page → 'Remarks' → pick a ready-made remark or type your own. A remark does not stop booking reminders.

howto.q: Where are requests from the website consultation form?
howto.answer: They are not on the Leads list. They are on their own board in Monday.

howto.q: How do I delete a duplicate or test lead?
howto.answer: Leads page → bin icon at the end of the row → read the preview → type DELETE → 'Delete permanently'. Only for real duplicates or tests.

howto.q: Where do I see my consultations for today?
howto.answer: Consultations page → 'Consultations' tab → 'Today' → choose your name in the consultant filter → click a row.

howto.q: What should I read before the consultation?
howto.answer: On the consultation record: Intake context, the pre-consultation answers (Dossier PDF) and the AI triage notes.

howto.q: How do I join the video consultation?
howto.answer: Press 'Join meeting' on the consultation record or use the Teams invite. You let the client in from the lobby.

howto.q: Where are the recording and transcript?
howto.answer: On the consultation record (Recording / Transcript icons) and on the case page's Meetings tab, once the app finds them.

howto.q: Which outcome do I pick?
howto.answer: Wants to go ahead → build the retainer and press 'Retain & send agreement'. Not ready or not eligible now → Follow-Up (and a follow-up date). Nothing to do now → Newsletter. We will not work with them → Not Wanted with a reason.

howto.q: How do I record the outcome?
howto.answer: Consultation record → 'Record outcome' → Follow-Up, Newsletter or Not Wanted. Retain is set by 'Retain & send agreement' in the Retainer plan.

howto.q: How do I change an outcome I set by mistake?
howto.answer: Click the right outcome; the last click wins. A Not Wanted mistake also needs a named admin to remove the person from the list.

howto.q: How do I build the retainer plan and send it?
howto.answer: Retainer plan: set the fee → choose template, case type, Sub Type and scope annex → family list → co-signer if any → milestones (with a Trigger each) → Preview → 'Save retainer plan' → 'Retain & send agreement'.

howto.q: Which Sub Type should I choose?
howto.answer: The one that matches the client (for example with or without family coming). It decides the document checklist; a blank or wrong one means no checklist.

howto.q: I made a mistake in the fee after sending. How do I fix it?
howto.answer: If the client has not signed: '✎ Amend' → fix → 'Save retainer plan' → '🔄 Void & re-issue'. If they already signed, the agreement cannot be re-issued; talk to your manager.

howto.q: The client signed online. What do I do now?
howto.answer: You get a countersign email: sign it. The app records it, sends the client the fully signed copy and starts the case once milestone 1 is paid.

howto.q: The client signed a paper copy in the office. What do I do?
howto.answer: With the outcome set to Retain, press 'Mark retainer signed'. It opens the case and emails the first payment request. No countersign is needed.

howto.q: The client signed but nothing happened. Why?
howto.answer: If someone typed the Retainer Signed date while the outcome was Follow-Up, Newsletter or Not Wanted, the date is on hold. Set the Outcome column to Retain on the Lead Board in Monday. Never clear the date.

howto.q: The client is not sure yet. How do I keep track?
howto.answer: Set Follow-Up and save a follow-up date in 'Attribution & follow-up'. Every morning, open the Retainers & follow-ups tab and set the Follow-up filter to 'Due (today or earlier)'. The app sends no reminder.

howto.q: We do not want this client. What do I do?
howto.answer: Press 'Not Wanted' and give the reason. It only warns staff later; cancel any booked time in Square and void a sent retainer yourself.

howto.q: How do I countersign the consultation agreement?
howto.answer: Sign from the email you receive, or press 'Sign as consultant' on the consultation record.

howto.q: Which consultations still need an outcome?
howto.answer: The amber '⚠ Needs outcome' box on the Consultations tab lists them.

howto.q: A client paid the consultation fee by e-Transfer. How do I record it?
howto.answer: Consultation record → 'Consultation fee' → 'Record payment / Waived' → e-Transfer → fee before HST, date, reference → 'Record'.

howto.q: I recorded a consultation fee wrongly. How do I fix it?
howto.answer: Consultation record → 'Consultation fee' → 'Change record' or 'Remove record'.

howto.q: A milestone e-Transfer arrived. How do I record it?
howto.answer: Check the reference code matches, then 'Record payment' on the milestone (case page → Payments, or the consultation page). Type the amount including HST.

howto.q: Why is the consultation fee typed before HST but a milestone including HST?
howto.answer: The consultation fee box asks for the fee before HST; the milestone box asks for what was received, which includes HST. Follow the box label.

howto.q: What happens after I record milestone 1?
howto.answer: If every signature is in, the case starts by itself (welcome email and checklist). If not, a hold note says what is missing and the case starts when it arrives.

howto.q: The client paid only half of a milestone.
howto.answer: Record the smaller amount. The row shows Part-paid with the balance. A first part-payment on milestone 1 still starts the case. Chase the balance yourself.

howto.q: How do I ask the client for the next milestone?
howto.answer: Case page → Payments → 'Send e-Transfer request' on a DUE row. Later milestones are never sent automatically.

howto.q: How do I know which milestones are due?
howto.answer: Open each active case's Payments tab and look for the amber DUE label.

howto.q: I recorded a payment on the wrong client. How do I undo it?
howto.answer: Press 'Flag as wrong' on that row. A named admin then uses 'Undo…'. Record the payment again on the right client.

howto.q: The amount recorded was too high. How do I correct it?
howto.answer: A named admin uses 'Correct amount…' on the row. Others press 'Flag as wrong'.

howto.q: Someone set Paid on the Cases board. Is that OK?
howto.answer: It records only a date, not the payment. Record the real payment with 'Record payment' and check for a hold note. Older cases with no linked lead record can only be marked on the board.

howto.q: Who still owes a balance?
howto.answer: Summary → Needs attention → 'Balance owed before submission' (only from Submission Preparation on). For earlier cases, check each case's Payments tab.

howto.q: How do I delete a duplicate or test case safely?
howto.answer: Cases page → bin icon → read the whole preview → type the case number → 'Delete permanently'. Admins only.

howto.q: What payment emails does the client get?
howto.answer: Online consultation fee: Square's receipt and the package. Retainer: a payment request per milestone, a receipt (when receipts are on), and 'Your case is ready' when the case starts.

howto.q: A new case just opened. What do I check first?
howto.answer: Sub Type, family, sponsor, OneDrive folder, the welcome email and the milestone triggers.

howto.q: The case has no document checklist. Why?
howto.answer: Usually the Case Sub Type is blank or wrong, or the case is not paid yet. Set the Sub Type on the Cases board in Monday. If the case is already at Document Collection Started, the checklist builds by itself; if not, also set Re-seed Checklist to Run.

howto.q: The client can't see the questionnaire or upload page.
howto.answer: Check the message they see. Then sign in with Monday, open the case page → '🏠 Client portal' → 'Resend portal access email →'. It sends the same link again; older emails keep working.

howto.q: How do I review an uploaded document?
howto.answer: Case page → Documents → open the file → '✓ Mark reviewed', or '⟲ Request rework' with a note for the client.

howto.q: I pressed the wrong review button. How do I undo it?
howto.answer: Use '↺ Undo' on the full document review page (not on the case page).

howto.q: A document does not apply to this client.
howto.answer: Press '⊘ Does not apply' and give a reason. Only for a document that does not exist for this client.

howto.q: The client emailed me a document. How do I add it?
howto.answer: Type the client's documents page address in your browser: /documents/ followed by the case number (no button links to it). Find the right document → '⬆ Upload'. Then post an update on the case saying you uploaded it and where it came from. Never give this address to the client.

howto.q: I need to add the client's spouse to the case.
howto.answer: Case page → Overview → '👪 Family on this case' → Spouse → '➕ Add family member' once, and wait.

howto.q: The questionnaire has a wrong answer. How do I ask the client to fix it?
howto.answer: Sign in with Monday first. Case page → Questionnaire tab → 'Open full page →' → '🚩 Flag' the answer and write a note → 'Save Flag' → 'Send Correction Request'. Staff cannot change answers. The client may see a saved note before you send, so write it for them.

howto.q: How do I see the second questionnaire form on a PNP, Federal PR or Canadian Experience Class case?
howto.answer: Case page → Questionnaire tab → 'Open full page →'. In the browser's address bar, add &formKey=additional to the end (or ?formKey=additional if the address has no ?) and press Enter. The case page buttons show only the first form.

howto.q: How do I send the sponsor their email?
howto.answer: Case page → Overview → the '🤝 Sponsor / inviter' card → 'Send sponsor link'. The first send works once the case is Paid and at Document Collection Started, Internal Review, Submission Preparation or Submission Ready, with the Case Sub Type set. A re-send works at any stage.

howto.q: The case folder is missing in OneDrive.
howto.answer: Press '📁 Case folder…' at the top of the case page.

howto.q: When does the case move to Internal Review, and what if it does not?
howto.answer: When the questionnaire is submitted and enough documents are marked Reviewed. If it does not move, go through the checks.

howto.q: Where do I prepare the application files?
howto.answer: In the four working folders in the case's OneDrive folder. Copy files in; never move them out of the client's folders.

howto.q: We filed with IRCC. What do I set?
howto.answer: In Monday, set Case Stage to exactly 'Submitted' (not 'Application Submitted').

howto.q: What does 'Stuck' mean?
howto.answer: A case that cannot move forward. The app keeps updating its numbers but never moves it out of Stuck on its own (only a special escalation rule can). Read the case notes, fix the problem, then set the Case Stage back by hand in Monday. Setting it back to Document Collection Started emails the client the 'Your case is ready' email again.

howto.q: What reminders does a client get if they do not upload?
howto.answer: Only for a Paid case at Document Collection Started. Counting from the day that stage started: Reminder 1 around day 7, Reminder 2 around day 14, a Final Notice around day 21, and around day 30 the case is marked Client Blocked (no email). The days can differ by case type. These reminders may not be going out at the moment (see 'What happens automatically overnight?'), so watch the Chasing Stage column on the Cases board and chase the client yourself if it does not change.

howto.q: What can I do on the client portal as staff?
howto.answer: Read what the client sees, see what is waiting, open the review pages and resend the portal email. You can't upload there.

howto.q: How do I find a case?
howto.answer: Cases page → type in the search box, or filter by stage, health or manager → click the row.

howto.q: A returning client wants a new application.
howto.answer: On their old case press '➕ New application'. It opens a new direct retainer form filled in from that case.

howto.q: What should I check every morning?
howto.answer: Summary → Needs attention (top down) → Action Required → Consultations 'Needs outcome' → Retainers & follow-ups with the Follow-up filter set to 'Due (today or earlier)'.

howto.q: What does each Needs attention line mean and who fixes it?
howto.answer: Each item says what is wrong and what to do; the lane says which team. After fixing, press Check now.

howto.q: When do I use Mark handled?
howto.answer: When the item needs no fix, or when you fixed it and it is still listed after 'Check now'. It takes the item off the list and leaves a note on the case. It fixes nothing by itself.

howto.q: How many consultations, retainers and fees did we have this month?
howto.answer: Consultations page → Reporting tab → Period. Revenue there is consultation fees before HST; retainer value is signed contracts, not money received.

howto.q: How do I see each case manager's workload?
howto.answer: Summary → '👥 Team Workload & Performance', or Cases page filtered by manager. Only Case Managers are counted.

howto.q: A case has been sitting for 2 weeks. How do I find it?
howto.answer: Summary → Action Required → 'No Activity 14d+', or sort the Cases page. Then work through the 'did not move on' checks.

howto.q: How do I remove someone from the Not Wanted list?
howto.answer: Find their lead (Leads or Consultations search), open it, and on the red banner press 'Remove from the list…'. Named admins only.

howto.q: What happens automatically overnight?
howto.answer: At about 3 a.m. Toronto time in summer (2 a.m. in winter) the app recounts readiness, deadlines, expiring documents, case health and escalations, and sends the document reminder emails (which may not be going out at the moment). The Engine Controls page says 07:00: that is the app's own clock, not Toronto time. The Needs attention list is rebuilt at 7:00 a.m. Toronto time.

howto.q: Who is an admin?
howto.answer: Anyone using the team key can open the staff pages and see every case, but is not an admin. Deleting records, running the overnight checks by hand, payment fixes (Undo, Correct amount) and Not Wanted removals need a named admin: signed in with Monday and on the admin list. Ask Faran who is on that list.

howto.q: The client says they paid, but nothing happened. What do I check?
howto.answer: Open the client from Consultations → 'Retainers & follow-ups' (the consultation record) and read the progress line and the Case status card. Then: (1) Which payment? The consultation fee is the 'Consultation fee' card (if it says 'Not recorded', use Record payment / Waived). A retainer payment is a milestone row under Milestone payments. (2) Milestone still 'Requested': match the e-Transfer reference against the bank and press Record payment. (3) Milestone 'Paid' but the case has not started: look for the hold note '⛔ … onboarding is on hold — missing: …' — a client signature or the consultant's countersign is missing; chase that. (4) Signed and paid: the Case Stage should be Document Collection Started, the checklist should exist (if not, set the Case Sub Type) and the client should have 'Your case is ready' (if not, Resend portal access email). (5) Still stuck: look the case up in Summary → Needs attention ('Payment noted, but not marked Paid', 'Paid, onboarding waiting for signatures', 'Paid, but no document checklist').

howto.q: Which emails has this client already received from us?
howto.answer: There is no single list. Before the case: the 💬 Updates on the lead page or the consultation record hold a note for most sends ('📧 Booking invite emailed to …', '⏰ Booking reminder N of 2 emailed', the package, agreement and countersign notes). After the case opens: the case page's Timeline tab lists the invite, agreements, retainer, payments and documents, and the Updates tab shows the notes ('✉️ Portal access email re-sent', rework emails). Document reminders show in the Chasing Stage column on the Cases board (Reminder 1 Sent, Reminder 2 Sent, Final Notice Sent). The 'Emails the app sends' table in this guide says what each email is called and when it goes.

howto.q: Received vs Reviewed: why is the case not moving?
howto.answer: Received = the client uploaded a file and it is waiting for staff. Reviewed = a staff member opened the file and accepted it. Only Reviewed documents count toward Documents Readiness %, move the case on and stop the reminders. The '📂 Document readiness' meter on the Overview tab shows the UPLOADED share, so it can read 100% while nothing has been reviewed. Watch the Received / Reviewed counts at the top of the document review page, and mark each document Reviewed — there is no mark-all.

howto.q: Where are my team's rules and daily routine?
howto.answer: Pick your department at the top of this guide (Front desk / Intake, Consultants, Accounts, Case managers, Management). 'Your first day' then lists the few things you will do most, and the Golden rules section shows your department's rules; the five 'All staff' rules apply to everyone. Not sure which team you are? Reception and booking = Front desk / Intake; RCICs = Consultants; money = Accounts; open cases = Case managers; dashboards and oversight = Management.

howto.q: How do I find a case on the Cases board in Monday?
howto.answer: Open Monday → the Cases board (Monday calls it 'Client Master') → search the case number from the top of the case page, or the client's name → the case's row. Touch only the column the step names: Case Sub Type, Re-seed Checklist, Case Stage or Payment Status. Then press ↻ Refresh in the app (or Check now on Summary).

howto.q: How do I use the staff guide page?
howto.answer: Press 📘 Guide in the top bar. Pick your department, press ▶ Play to watch a typical client move through the system, click any box for the details, or type in the search box. 'Step by step' lists everything; the browser's Print gives a booklet for your department.

firstday.intro: You handle new leads from first contact until the consultation is booked and paid.

items.text: Sign in with the team key, and also 'Sign in with Monday' so your name is recorded.
Open the Leads page and read the Current status of each new lead.
For a caller: '＋ Add lead' with email, phone, address and 'In Canada now?'.
Choose the consultant and send the booking invite from the lead page.
A walk-in who pays at the desk: record the fee and the booking yourself; no invite.
Read the 💬 Updates for 🚨 and ⚠ alerts and act on them.
Release held consultation packages with 'Review & send'.
Pass 'Existing Client' website leads to the case team.

firstday.intro: You hold consultations, record the outcome and set up the retainer.

items.text: Each morning: Consultations → 'Today' → your name.
Before the call, read the consultation record: intake, pre-consultation answers and AI notes.
Hold the meeting and let the client in from the Teams lobby.
Right after, set an outcome. Clear the ⚠ Needs outcome box.
For a client who signs: build the retainer plan, pick the right Sub Type and a Trigger for every milestone.
Save the plan, then 'Retain & send agreement'.
Countersign from the email when the client has signed online.
Every morning, on Retainers & follow-ups, set the Follow-up filter to 'Due (today or earlier)'.

firstday.intro: You record money that arrives, and fix payment mistakes.

items.text: Record consultation fees paid by cash, e-Transfer or invoice (before HST).
Match each e-Transfer reference code, then record the milestone payment.
Record part-payments and keep track of the balance.
Look for DUE milestones on active cases and send the e-Transfer request.
Recorded something wrongly? Press 'Flag as wrong'; a named admin undoes it.
Handle double consultation payments in Square.
Never set Paid on the Cases board when the app can record the payment.

firstday.intro: You run open cases: documents, questionnaire, review and submission.

items.text: Open your case from the Cases page.
On a new case, go through the first checks.
Open every uploaded file, then mark it Reviewed or request rework.
Flag wrong questionnaire answers (signed in with Monday) and send one correction request.
Upload files the client emailed on their documents page.
On PNP and PR cases, also review the second questionnaire form.
Case not moving? Work through the checks before changing the stage.
After filing, set Case Stage to 'Submitted'.

firstday.intro: You watch every stage and make sure nothing is missed.

items.text: Open Summary each morning and work Needs attention from the top.
After fixing items, press Check now.
Use Mark handled only when an item needs no fix, or is still listed after you fixed it and pressed Check now.
Look at Action Required and Cases Requiring Attention.
Check team workload on '👥 Team Workload & Performance'.
Read the monthly figures on the Reporting tab.
Know who can see what, and who counts as an admin.
